units.title: Paragraf soruları
units.description: Detay, çıkarım ve gönderim sorularını metne dayanarak hızla çözme
units.guide:
## Strateji
YDS ve YÖKDİL'in en çok puan getiren bölümü okuma parçalarıdır. Her parçaya genellikle 3–4 soru gelir ve bu sorular üç ana tipe ayrılır: **detay** (metinde açıkça yazan bir bilgiyi sorar), **çıkarım** (metinde doğrudan yazmayan ama metinden kesin olarak anlaşılan bilgiyi sorar) ve **gönderim** (*it, they, this, such* gibi bir sözcüğün neyi kastettiğini ya da bir kelimenin bağlamdaki anlamını sorar). Bunlara ek olarak sınavda *ana fikir* (*What is the passage mainly about?*), *yazarın amacı* (*The author mentions X in order to…*) ve *NOT mentioned / EXCEPT* soruları da çıkar. Altın kural şudur: **Cevap her zaman metindedir.** Kendi genel kültürünle doğru olan ama metinde dayanağı olmayan şık yanlıştır.

## Örnekler
- *According to the passage, the survey was conducted in rural areas.* — Metne göre anket kırsal bölgelerde yapıldı. (detay)
- *It can be inferred that the early models were less reliable.* — İlk modellerin daha az güvenilir olduğu sonucu çıkarılabilir. (çıkarım)
- *The word 'they' in paragraph 2 refers to the volunteers.* — İkinci paragraftaki 'they' gönüllüleri kastediyor. (gönderim)
- *As used in the passage, 'address' is closest in meaning to 'deal with'.* — Metindeki kullanımıyla 'address' en çok 'ele almak, çözmek' anlamına gelir. (bağlamda anlam)
- *The author mentions the butterfly count in order to provide evidence.* — Yazar kelebek sayımından kanıt sunmak için söz eder. (amaç)

## Nasıl çözülür
1. Önce soru kökünü oku ve tipini belirle: *According to the passage* = detay, *It can be inferred / It is implied* = çıkarım, *The word 'it' refers to* = gönderim, *closest in meaning* = bağlamda anlam.
2. Kökteki **anahtar kelimeyi** (özel ad, sayı, terim) seç ve metinde tara; eş anlamlısıyla da geçebileceğini unutma (*decline* ↔ *decrease*, *main worry* ↔ *main concern*).
3. Anahtar kelimenin geçtiği cümleyi ve bir önceki/sonraki cümleyi dikkatle oku; *however, nevertheless, unlike* gibi karşıtlık sözcükleri cevabın tam yanındadır.
4. Şıkları bu cümlelerle karşılaştır; aşırı genelleme (*all, always, never*) yapan veya metinde olmayan bilgi ekleyen şıkları ele.
5. Gönderim sorularında zamirin yerine adayları koy: tekil/çoğul uyumu ve anlam tutuyorsa cevap odur. Bağlamda anlam sorularında da şıkkı kelimenin yerine koyup cümleyi yeniden oku.

**Örnek çözüm:** Metin: *The Velan reservoir lost a third of its volume in 2019. Engineers blamed this on unusually low rainfall.* Soru: *The word 'this' refers to ----.* Adım 1: gönderim sorusu. Adım 3: önceki cümle hacim kaybını anlatıyor. Adım 5: *the loss of volume* yerine konunca cümle anlamlı olur (*Engineers blamed the loss of volume on low rainfall*); *engineers* çoğuldur ve *this* ile uyuşmaz, *low rainfall* ise zaten aynı cümlede nedendir. Cevap: hacim kaybı.

## Tuzaklar ve sık yapılan hatalar
- **Doğru ama metinde olmayan şık:** Genel bilginle mantıklı görünen şık, metin söylemiyorsa yanlıştır. ÖSYM bu çeldiriciyi çok sever.
- **Kelime tekrarı tuzağı:** Metindeki kelimeleri aynen tekrarlayan ama anlamı ters çeviren şık (ör. metin *not religious, as was first assumed* derken şıkta *religious texts*).
- **Çıkarımı abartmak:** Çıkarım, metinden *kesin* olarak çıkan sonuçtur; tahmin veya yorum değildir. *may, some* diyen metinden *all, certainly* sonucu çıkmaz.
- **Zamiri en yakın isme bağlamak:** Türkçede zamir sık düşer; İngilizcede *it* bazen iki cümle önceki ana konuyu gösterir. Tekil/çoğul uyumunu mutlaka kontrol et.
- **Kelimenin sözlükteki ilk anlamına takılmak:** *measure* (önlem), *address* (ele almak), *sound* (sağlam) gibi kelimelerin bağlamda farklı anlamı olabilir.
- **Yan bilgiyi ana fikir sanmak:** Metnin bir cümlesinde geçen ayrıntı, ana fikir sorusunda çeldirici olarak karşına çıkar.

## Sınav ipucu
YDS'de 80 sorunun yaklaşık 20'si okuma parçasıdır; süreni iyi kullan (soru başına ortalama 1,5 dakika). Önce soruları oku, sonra metne dön: böylece neyi aradığını bilerek okursun. Şıklarda metindeki kelimelerin aynen tekrarlandığı seçenek çoğu zaman tuzaktır; doğru cevap genellikle aynı fikri **başka kelimelerle** (paraphrase) söyler. *NOT mentioned* veya *EXCEPT* sorularında her şıkkı metinde tek tek işaretle. Bir soruda takılırsan işaretle ve geç; aynı parçanın diğer soruları metni anlamana yardım eder.

nodes.title: Okuma kelimeleri
nodes.description: Soru köklerindeki kalıplar ve metinlerde geçen akademik kelimeler

exercises.question: The excavation team had to ---- the site after heavy rains flooded the trenches.
options: resemble
exceed
abandon
assume
forage
exercises.explanation: Şiddetli yağmur hendekleri su basınca ekibin kazı alanını 'terk etmesi' gerekir; doğru şık 'abandon'. 'Exceed' (aşmak) ve 'resemble' (benzemek) bir yeri bırakma anlamı taşımaz; 'forage' ise hayvanların yiyecek araması için kullanılır.

exercises.question: Although the early results are ----, the researchers warn that more trials are needed before the method can be widely used.
options: encouraging
repetitive
short-lived
sceptical
unfounded
exercises.explanation: 'Although' karşıtlık kurar: sonuçlar olumlu ama yine de daha çok deneme gerekiyor. Bu yüzden 'encouraging' (umut verici) doğrudur. 'Sceptical' (kuşkulu) insanlar için kullanılır, sonuçlar için değil; 'unfounded' (asılsız) ise karşıtlık oluşturmaz.

exercises.text: The researchers ___ that the fibres had arrived through the air.
exercises.translation: Araştırmacılar, liflerin havadan geldiği sonucuna vardı.

exercises.question: Patients who experienced severe side effects were allowed to ---- from the trial at any time.
options: exceed
establish
reveal
resemble
withdraw
exercises.explanation: 'withdraw from' bir denemeden/çalışmadan 'çekilmek' demektir; ciddi yan etki yaşayan hastalar denemeden çekilebilir. Doğru şık 'withdraw'. 'Establish' (kurmak, saptamak) ve 'reveal' (ortaya çıkarmak) 'from the trial' ile anlamlı bir bütün oluşturmaz.

exercises.question: Fears that bilingual education would harm pupils' progress proved ----: their test scores were as high as those of their peers.
options: remarkable
unfounded
conventional
commercial
reflective
exercises.explanation: İki noktadan sonraki açıklama, korkuların gerçekleşmediğini gösterir; korkular 'asılsız' (unfounded) çıkmıştır. 'Remarkable' (dikkat çekici) olumlu bir şeyi niteler ve korkular için anlamsızdır; 'conventional' (alışılmış) bağlamla ilgisizdir.

exercises.text: Parents were initially ___ about the new school, but their fears soon disappeared.
exercises.translation: Veliler başlangıçta yeni okul konusunda kuşkuluydu, ama korkuları kısa sürede yok oldu.

exercises.question: Staff ---- fell sharply after the company introduced flexible working hours, saving it millions in recruitment costs.
options: pitch
coating
fragment
turnover
settlement
exercises.explanation: İşe alım maliyetlerinden tasarruf, personelin işten ayrılma hızının (turnover) düştüğünü gösterir; doğru şık 'turnover'. 'Pitch' ses perdesi, 'coating' kaplama, 'fragment' parça demektir; hiçbiri çalışanlarla ilgili bir oran değildir.

exercises.question: Unlike ---- dark roofs, the new white coatings reflect most of the sunlight that falls on them.
options: conventional
devastating
isolated
repetitive
significant
exercises.explanation: 'Unlike' yeni beyaz kaplamaları eski, alışılmış koyu çatılarla karşılaştırır; 'conventional' (geleneksel, alışılmış) doğrudur. 'Devastating' (yıkıcı) ve 'repetitive' (tekrarlayan) çatıyı anlamlı biçimde nitelemez.

exercises.question: The study ---- adults over sixty-five, so its results may not apply to older patients.
options: revealed
withdrew
excluded
attributed
foraged
exercises.explanation: Sonuçların yaşlı hastalara uymayabileceği söylendiğine göre çalışma 65 yaş üstünü 'dışarıda bırakmıştır' (excluded). 'Revealed' (ortaya çıkardı) bu sonuca yol açmaz; 'attributed' ise 'to' ile kullanılır ve anlam vermez.

nodes.title: Detay ve çıkarım
nodes.description: Anahtar kelime taraması ve It can be inferred… sorularında kesin sonucu bulma

exercises.passage: On the remote island of Tarsel, a small population of honey bees has lived in isolation for at least four centuries. Because no foreign colonies were ever brought to the island, the bees have remained free of the varroa mite, a parasite that has devastated hives elsewhere. In 2021, a team from the Northbridge Institute of Apiculture began monitoring 40 hives across the island. The researchers found that Tarsel bees forage at lower temperatures than mainland bees, starting their flights at around 8°C instead of the usual 12°C. They also discovered that the colonies produce noticeably less honey but survive harsh winters with far fewer losses. The team now hopes to study whether these traits could be bred into commercial hives without introducing new diseases to the island.
exercises.question: According to the passage, Tarsel bees have remained free of the varroa mite because ----.
options: they forage at lower temperatures than mainland bees
they produce less honey than other colonies
no foreign colonies have ever been brought to the island
researchers have been monitoring their hives closely every season since 2021
the island's harsh winters kill most parasites
exercises.explanation: Anahtar kelime 'varroa mite'. Geçtiği cümle 'Because no foreign colonies were ever brought to the island' diye başlar; neden açıkça budur, yani doğru şık 'no foreign colonies have ever been brought to the island'. Kışların parazitleri öldürdüğünü söyleyen şık metinde yoktur; düşük sıcaklıkta uçma ('forage at lower temperatures') ise ayrı bir bulgudur, akarla ilgisi kurulmamıştır.

exercises.passage: On the remote island of Tarsel, a small population of honey bees has lived in isolation for at least four centuries. Because no foreign colonies were ever brought to the island, the bees have remained free of the varroa mite, a parasite that has devastated hives elsewhere. In 2021, a team from the Northbridge Institute of Apiculture began monitoring 40 hives across the island. The researchers found that Tarsel bees forage at lower temperatures than mainland bees, starting their flights at around 8°C instead of the usual 12°C. They also discovered that the colonies produce noticeably less honey but survive harsh winters with far fewer losses. The team now hopes to study whether these traits could be bred into commercial hives without introducing new diseases to the island.
exercises.question: Which of the following is stated in the passage about Tarsel bees?
options: They start foraging at a lower temperature than mainland bees.
They produce more honey than commercial hives.
They lose more colonies during winter than other bees.
They were brought to the island by researchers four centuries ago.
Their traits have already been bred into commercial hives.
exercises.explanation: Metinde 'starting their flights at around 8°C instead of the usual 12°C' denir; bu 'They start foraging at a lower temperature' şıkkının başka kelimelerle söylenişidir. 'more honey' ve 'lose more colonies' şıkları metnin tersidir (less honey, fewer losses); 'already been bred into commercial hives' ise ekibin yalnızca 'hopes to study' dediği, henüz yapılmamış bir şeydir.

exercises.passage: A three-year study in the city of Merrow examined how different roofing materials affect indoor temperatures during summer. Researchers fitted sensors in 120 apartments, half of which had conventional dark roofs and half reflective white coatings. On the hottest days, top-floor apartments under white roofs were on average 3.5°C cooler than those under dark roofs. Interestingly, the difference was much smaller on lower floors, where it rarely exceeded 1°C. The study also found that residents of the cooler apartments used their air conditioners for about 40 percent fewer hours. However, the authors warn that white coatings lose much of their reflectivity within five years unless they are cleaned regularly, which may limit their long-term benefits.
exercises.question: According to the passage, the temperature difference between the two types of apartments was smallest ----.
options: on the hottest days of summer
in top-floor apartments
in apartments with air conditioners
during the first five years
on the lower floors of the buildings
exercises.explanation: Kökteki 'smallest' ifadesinin metindeki karşılığı 'much smaller'dır: 'the difference was much smaller on lower floors'. Doğru şık 'on the lower floors of the buildings'. 'in top-floor apartments' şıkkı tam tersidir; en büyük fark (3,5°C) üst katlarda ölçülmüştür.

exercises.passage: A three-year study in the city of Merrow examined how different roofing materials affect indoor temperatures during summer. Researchers fitted sensors in 120 apartments, half of which had conventional dark roofs and half reflective white coatings. On the hottest days, top-floor apartments under white roofs were on average 3.5°C cooler than those under dark roofs. Interestingly, the difference was much smaller on lower floors, where it rarely exceeded 1°C. The study also found that residents of the cooler apartments used their air conditioners for about 40 percent fewer hours. However, the authors warn that white coatings lose much of their reflectivity within five years unless they are cleaned regularly, which may limit their long-term benefits.
exercises.question: According to the passage, white roof coatings may not be beneficial in the long term because ----.
options: residents use their air conditioners less often
they lose reflectivity over time if they are not cleaned
they only work in top-floor apartments that receive direct sunlight all day
they are more expensive than dark roofs
they make apartments too cold in winter
exercises.explanation: Anahtar ifade 'long-term benefits' son cümlede geçer: kaplamalar düzenli temizlenmezse beş yıl içinde yansıtıcılığını kaybeder. Doğru şık 'they lose reflectivity over time if they are not cleaned'. Maliyet ('more expensive than dark roofs') ve kışın soğukluk ('too cold in winter') metinde hiç geçmez; klimaların daha az kullanılması ise bir avantajdır, dezavantaj değil.

exercises.passage: Researchers at the Halden Sleep Centre recently compared two groups of adults with mild insomnia. The first group used a smartphone application that played calming sounds at bedtime, while the second group followed a simple routine: going to bed and getting up at the same time every day, including weekends. After eight weeks, both groups reported falling asleep faster. However, only the routine group showed a significant improvement in total sleep time, gaining an average of 47 minutes per night. The application users, by contrast, gained only 9 minutes. The researchers also noted that nearly a third of the application users stopped using it after the first month, mainly because they found the sounds repetitive.
exercises.question: According to the passage, the participants in the routine group ----.
options: listened to calming music for half an hour before sleeping
kept the same sleeping and waking times every day
stopped following the routine after a month
gained only 9 minutes of sleep per night
did not fall asleep any faster than before
exercises.explanation: 'routine' kelimesini metinde tarayınca 'going to bed and getting up at the same time every day' açıklaması bulunur; 'kept the same sleeping and waking times every day' bunun paraphrase'idir. '9 minutes' bilgisi uygulama kullanan gruba aittir; 'did not fall asleep any faster' ise 'both groups reported falling asleep faster' ifadesiyle çelişir.

exercises.passage: Researchers at the Halden Sleep Centre recently compared two groups of adults with mild insomnia. The first group used a smartphone application that played calming sounds at bedtime, while the second group followed a simple routine: going to bed and getting up at the same time every day, including weekends. After eight weeks, both groups reported falling asleep faster. However, only the routine group showed a significant improvement in total sleep time, gaining an average of 47 minutes per night. The application users, by contrast, gained only 9 minutes. The researchers also noted that nearly a third of the application users stopped using it after the first month, mainly because they found the sounds repetitive.
exercises.question: According to the passage, many application users stopped using it because ----.
options: they found the sounds it played repetitive
it did not help them fall asleep faster
the researchers asked them to switch groups
they preferred following a fixed routine
it was too expensive after the first month
exercises.explanation: Kökteki 'stopped using it' ifadesi son cümlede aynen geçer ve neden 'mainly because they found the sounds repetitive' olarak verilir; doğru şık 'they found the sounds it played repetitive'. 'it did not help them fall asleep faster' diyen şık yanlıştır, çünkü metne göre her iki grup da daha hızlı uykuya dalmıştır.

exercises.passage: Fifty years ago, fewer than 300 people on the island of Orvel could speak Orvelish, and most of them were over sixty. In 1985, the local council opened the first nursery school in which all activities were conducted in the language. Parents were initially sceptical, fearing that their children would fall behind in the national language. Those fears proved unfounded: by the age of twelve, pupils from the Orvelish-medium schools performed as well as their peers in national tests. Today, around 4,000 islanders speak Orvelish, and the language is heard on local radio. Nevertheless, linguists point out that most young speakers use it mainly at school and switch to the national language when talking with friends.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that before 1985 ----.
options: Orvelish was taught in all schools on the island
most children on Orvel spoke Orvelish fluently
parents demanded more Orvelish-medium schools
no nursery school on Orvel conducted all its activities in Orvelish
Orvelish was regularly broadcast on local radio and television stations across the island
exercises.explanation: 1985'te açılan okul 'the first nursery school in which all activities were conducted in the language' olarak tanıtılır; 'first' kelimesi, bundan önce böyle bir okul olmadığını kesin olarak gösterir, yani 'no nursery school on Orvel conducted all its activities in Orvelish' doğrudur. 'most children ... spoke Orvelish fluently' metinle çelişir: konuşurların çoğu altmış yaşın üzerindeydi. 'parents demanded more ... schools' da yanlıştır; veliler başta kuşkuluydu (sceptical).

exercises.passage: Fifty years ago, fewer than 300 people on the island of Orvel could speak Orvelish, and most of them were over sixty. In 1985, the local council opened the first nursery school in which all activities were conducted in the language. Parents were initially sceptical, fearing that their children would fall behind in the national language. Those fears proved unfounded: by the age of twelve, pupils from the Orvelish-medium schools performed as well as their peers in national tests. Today, around 4,000 islanders speak Orvelish, and the language is heard on local radio. Nevertheless, linguists point out that most young speakers use it mainly at school and switch to the national language when talking with friends.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that the revival of Orvelish ----.
options: has been a complete failure
has increased the number of speakers but has not yet made the language part of young people's social life
has caused children to perform poorly in national tests
is opposed by most linguists on the island
has led to the disappearance of the national language on Orvel
exercises.explanation: Konuşur sayısı 300'den 4.000'e çıkmış, ama 'Nevertheless' ile gençlerin arkadaşlarıyla ulusal dili konuştuğu belirtilmiştir; iki bilgiyi birleştiren 'increased the number of speakers but has not yet made the language part of young people's social life' doğru çıkarımdır. 'a complete failure' aşırı olumsuzdur, 'perform poorly in national tests' ise testlerde eşit başarıyla çelişir. Dilbilimcilerin karşı çıktığını ('opposed by most linguists') gösteren hiçbir ifade yoktur.

exercises.passage: Excavations at Dunmere, a Bronze Age settlement on a river terrace, have uncovered the remains of 14 houses arranged in a circle around an open space. Unlike earlier settlements in the region, none of the houses was larger than the others, and all contained similar tools and pottery. Archaeologists also found a single large oven in the central space, with no evidence of cooking areas inside the houses. Animal bones discovered near the oven came from cattle, which would have provided far more meat than one household could eat before it spoiled. Radiocarbon dating suggests that the settlement was occupied for about 150 years before it was abandoned.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that the inhabitants of Dunmere ----.
options: probably prepared and shared food communally
were ruled by a single powerful family
kept no domestic animals
abandoned the settlement because of a flood
built their houses before they learned to make pottery
exercises.explanation: Evlerde mutfak yoktur, ortada tek büyük fırın vardır ve sığır eti tek bir hanenin tüketebileceğinden fazladır; bu üç ipucu yemeğin ortak hazırlanıp paylaşıldığını gösterir, yani 'prepared and shared food communally' doğrudur. 'ruled by a single powerful family' evlerin eşit büyüklükte olmasıyla çelişir; terk edilme nedeni ('because of a flood') metinde hiç verilmez.

exercises.passage: Excavations at Dunmere, a Bronze Age settlement on a river terrace, have uncovered the remains of 14 houses arranged in a circle around an open space. Unlike earlier settlements in the region, none of the houses was larger than the others, and all contained similar tools and pottery. Archaeologists also found a single large oven in the central space, with no evidence of cooking areas inside the houses. Animal bones discovered near the oven came from cattle, which would have provided far more meat than one household could eat before it spoiled. Radiocarbon dating suggests that the settlement was occupied for about 150 years before it was abandoned.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that in earlier settlements in the region ----.
options: houses were usually arranged in a circle
cattle were rarely eaten
there were no ovens at all
people stayed in one place for more than 150 years
some houses were larger than others
exercises.explanation: 'Unlike earlier settlements in the region, none of the houses was larger than the others' cümlesindeki 'unlike' karşıtlık kurar: önceki yerleşimlerde bazı evler daha büyüktü. Doğru şık 'some houses were larger than others'. 'arranged in a circle' diyen şık yanlıştır, çünkü 'unlike' yalnızca ev büyüklüğüyle ilgilidir; dairesel düzen hakkında önceki yerleşimler için bilgi yoktur.

exercises.passage: In a recent trial, the experimental drug Coralin was tested on 600 patients with chronic migraine. Half of the patients received Coralin and half received a placebo. Over six months, patients taking Coralin reported an average of four fewer migraine days per month, compared with one fewer day in the placebo group. Side effects were generally mild, although 8 percent of the Coralin group withdrew from the trial because of dizziness. The manufacturer has applied for approval, but regulators have asked for an additional study involving patients over sixty-five, a group that was excluded from the original trial.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that the regulators ----.
options: have rejected Coralin because of its side effects
believe that the placebo was more effective than Coralin
do not yet have enough evidence about how Coralin affects older patients
think that dizziness is a side effect that affects only patients over the age of sixty-five
have already approved Coralin for younger patients
exercises.explanation: Altmış beş yaş üstü hastalar ilk denemeye alınmamıştır ve düzenleyiciler bu grup için ek çalışma istemiştir; demek ki bu yaş grubu hakkında yeterli kanıt yoktur, yani 'do not yet have enough evidence' doğrudur. 'have rejected Coralin' ve 'have already approved Coralin' aşırı çıkarımdır: ilaç ne reddedilmiş ne de onaylanmıştır, başvuru hâlâ sürmektedir.

exercises.passage: In a recent trial, the experimental drug Coralin was tested on 600 patients with chronic migraine. Half of the patients received Coralin and half received a placebo. Over six months, patients taking Coralin reported an average of four fewer migraine days per month, compared with one fewer day in the placebo group. Side effects were generally mild, although 8 percent of the Coralin group withdrew from the trial because of dizziness. The manufacturer has applied for approval, but regulators have asked for an additional study involving patients over sixty-five, a group that was excluded from the original trial.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that some patients in the placebo group ----.
options: later received Coralin instead
withdrew from the trial because of dizziness
were over sixty-five years old
also experienced a reduction in the number of migraine days
had no migraines at all from the beginning to the end of the trial
exercises.explanation: Plasebo grubunda da ortalama ayda bir gün azalma görülmüştür; ortalama azaldıysa en azından bazı hastalarda azalma olmuştur, yani 'also experienced a reduction' doğrudur. 'withdrew from the trial because of dizziness' yanlıştır, baş dönmesiyle ayrılanlar Coralin grubundandır; 'were over sixty-five' de yanlıştır, 65 yaş üstü hastalar denemeye hiç alınmamıştır.

nodes.title: Gönderim ve bağlamda anlam
nodes.description: it, they, this gibi sözcüklerin neyi kastettiği ve kelimenin metindeki anlamı

exercises.passage: The Halvik Glacier in the northern highlands has retreated nearly two kilometres since measurements began in 1950. Most researchers attribute this to rising summer temperatures. However, a team led by glaciologist Mira Sand argues that dust from nearby quarries has also played a role. Darker particles settling on the ice absorb more sunlight, and they speed up melting even on relatively cool days. The team compared the glacier with a similar one forty kilometres away, where there are no quarries, and found that the latter had shrunk only half as much over the same period. Although their findings are still debated, they have prompted local authorities to review quarry permits.
exercises.question: The word 'this' in 'Most researchers attribute this to rising summer temperatures' refers to ----.
options: the northern highlands
the retreat of the Halvik Glacier
rising summer temperatures
the measurements made in 1950
the dust from nearby quarries
exercises.explanation: 'attribute X to Y' = X'i Y'ye bağlamak. Y zaten 'rising summer temperatures' olduğuna göre 'this' önceki cümledeki olayı, yani buzulun geri çekilmesini gösterir; doğru şık 'the retreat of the Halvik Glacier'. 'rising summer temperatures' aynı cümlede neden olarak geçtiği için 'this' olamaz; ocaklardan gelen toz ('the dust from nearby quarries') ise ancak sonraki cümlede gündeme gelir.

exercises.passage: The Halvik Glacier in the northern highlands has retreated nearly two kilometres since measurements began in 1950. Most researchers attribute this to rising summer temperatures. However, a team led by glaciologist Mira Sand argues that dust from nearby quarries has also played a role. Darker particles settling on the ice absorb more sunlight, and they speed up melting even on relatively cool days. The team compared the glacier with a similar one forty kilometres away, where there are no quarries, and found that the latter had shrunk only half as much over the same period. Although their findings are still debated, they have prompted local authorities to review quarry permits.
exercises.question: The word 'they' in 'and they speed up melting even on relatively cool days' refers to ----.
options: the researchers
the quarries
relatively cool days
the darker particles
the local authorities
exercises.explanation: Cümlenin ilk yarısının öznesi 'Darker particles'tır; ikinci yarıdaki 'they' aynı özneyi sürdürür: güneş ışığını emen parçacıklar erimeyi hızlandırır. Doğru cevap 'the darker particles'. 'Quarries' da çoğuldur ama erimeyi doğrudan hızlandıran şey ocaklar değil, buza konan tozdur; yerel yetkililer ise son cümlede geçer.

exercises.passage: In the market town of Brenford, shopkeepers long complained that a new out-of-town supermarket was drawing customers away from the high street. In 2018, the town council responded by closing the main street to cars on Saturdays and filling it with food stalls and live music. Critics predicted that the measure would hurt businesses even further, since shoppers could no longer park outside the shops. Their prediction proved wrong. Within two years, Saturday footfall had doubled, and several empty units had been reopened by new tenants. The scheme's success, however, owed much to a free shuttle bus that connected the high street with car parks on the edge of town.
exercises.question: The word 'Their' in 'Their prediction proved wrong' refers to ----.
options: the critics
the shopkeepers
the members of the town council
the shoppers
the new tenants
exercises.explanation: Bir önceki cümlede tahminde bulunan (predicted) kişiler 'Critics'tir; 'Their prediction' onların tahminini gösterir. Doğru şık 'the critics'. Esnaf ('the shopkeepers') şikâyet etmiş, tahmin yürütmemiştir; alışverişçiler ('the shoppers') ise tahminin konusu olan kişilerdir.

exercises.passage: In the market town of Brenford, shopkeepers long complained that a new out-of-town supermarket was drawing customers away from the high street. In 2018, the town council responded by closing the main street to cars on Saturdays and filling it with food stalls and live music. Critics predicted that the measure would hurt businesses even further, since shoppers could no longer park outside the shops. Their prediction proved wrong. Within two years, Saturday footfall had doubled, and several empty units had been reopened by new tenants. The scheme's success, however, owed much to a free shuttle bus that connected the high street with car parks on the edge of town.
exercises.question: The word 'measure' in the passage is closest in meaning to ----.
options: size
quantity
unit
instrument
course of action
exercises.explanation: 'the measure' burada belediyenin aldığı önlemi, yani caddeyi trafiğe kapatma kararını anlatır; 'course of action' (izlenen yol, eylem) doğrudur. 'Size', 'quantity' ve 'unit' kelimenin ölçü anlamına dayanan tuzaklardır; bağlamda ölçüm söz konusu değildir.

exercises.passage: A study conducted in two primary schools in the coastal region of Senmar Bay followed 220 children who spoke both a regional language and the national language at home. At the beginning of the study, the bilingual pupils had slightly smaller vocabularies in each language than their monolingual classmates. By the age of ten, however, the gap had closed in the national language and had virtually disappeared in the regional one. The researchers stress that a smaller vocabulary in each language should not be confused with a smaller vocabulary overall: when words from both languages were counted together, the bilingual children actually knew more of them.
exercises.question: The word 'them' in the last sentence refers to ----.
options: the researchers
the monolingual classmates
words from both languages
the two primary schools
the bilingual children
exercises.explanation: 'knew more of them' = onlardan daha fazlasını biliyorlardı; bilinen şey kelimelerdir. 'them' aynı cümledeki 'words from both languages' ifadesini gösterir, doğru şık budur. 'the bilingual children' cümlenin öznesidir; özne kendi nesnesi olamaz.

exercises.explanation: Önceki cümle iki dilli öğrencilerin kelime dağarcığının tek dilli sınıf arkadaşlarınınkinden küçük olduğunu söyler; 'the gap' bu farktır. exercises.passage: Engineers at a small start-up have developed a portable water filter that uses a membrane made from chitin, a substance extracted from discarded shrimp shells. The membrane traps bacteria and heavy metals while allowing water to pass through quickly. Its main appeal lies in its price: a single unit costs less than a tenth of comparable filters on the market. Early field tests in three rural districts were promising, but they also revealed a weakness. In very hot conditions, the membrane tends to become brittle and crack within a few months. The company is now experimenting with a coating that could address this problem without raising the cost significantly.
exercises.question: The word 'address' in the last sentence is closest in meaning to ----.
options: deal with
speak to
locate
send
describe
exercises.explanation: Şirket bir kaplamayla membranın çatlama sorununu 'çözmeye' çalışmaktadır; 'address a problem' = sorunu ele almak, 'deal with' doğrudur. 'Speak to' (hitap etmek) ve 'send' (göndermek) kelimenin başka bağlamlardaki anlamlarına dayanan tuzaklardır.

exercises.passage: When the Ostrel Canal opened in 1842, it reduced the journey between the inland mills and the port from four days to less than one. Mill owners quickly took advantage of it, and within a decade the volume of cloth exported from the port had tripled. The canal's fortunes, however, were short-lived. A railway line built along the same route in 1861 offered even faster transport, and most traders switched to it. By the end of the century, the waterway was used mainly by small boats carrying coal, and parts of it had been filled in. Today, a restored section attracts walkers and cyclists rather than merchants.
exercises.question: The word 'it' in 'most traders switched to it' refers to ----.
options: the Ostrel Canal
the railway line
the port
the same route
the inland mills
exercises.explanation: Tüccarlar daha hızlı ulaşım sunan yeni seçeneğe geçmiştir; 'switch to' bir şeyden ötekine geçmek demektir ve 'it' cümlenin öznesi olan 'A railway line'ı gösterir. Doğru şık 'the railway line'. 'the Ostrel Canal' tam tersidir: tüccarlar kanaldan demiryoluna geçmiştir.

exercises.passage: For years, scientists assumed that remote mountain lakes were among the cleanest freshwater environments on Earth. A survey of 34 lakes in the Serran Mountains has challenged that view. Every lake sampled contained microplastic fibres, including several situated more than 2,000 metres above the nearest road. Because none of these lakes receives sewage or industrial waste, the researchers concluded that the fibres must have arrived through the atmosphere, carried by wind and deposited by rain and snow. Interestingly, concentrations were highest not in the lakes closest to towns but in those facing the prevailing westerly winds, which pass over a large urban area before reaching the mountains. The findings suggest that airborne pollution may travel much further than previously thought. They also raise concerns for the lakes' ecosystems, since small invertebrates at the base of the food chain have been observed swallowing the fibres, although the long-term effects on these organisms remain unknown.
exercises.question: What is the passage mainly about?
options: evidence that microplastics can reach remote lakes through the air
the effects of sewage on mountain ecosystems
the growth of towns near the Serran Mountains
methods for removing plastic fibres from remote mountain lakes and rivers
how invertebrates adapt to polluted water
exercises.explanation: Metnin tamamı, kanalizasyon almayan uzak göllerde bulunan liflerin atmosfer yoluyla geldiği bulgusunu anlatır; ana fikir 'microplastics can reach remote lakes through the air'dir. 'the effects of sewage' diyen şık yanlıştır, çünkü göllerin kanalizasyon almadığı söylenir; omurgasızlarla ilgili şık ise son cümledeki bir ayrıntıdır ve orada uyum değil, lif yutma anlatılır.

options: were the ones closest to towns

were all located above 2,000 metres

exercises.explanation: 'highest' kelimesiyle taranınca 'in those facing the prevailing westerly winds, which pass over a large urban area' bulunur; doğru şık 'faced winds that had passed over an urban area'. are the main reason fish numbers are falling

exercises.passage: In 2016, faced with a severe budget shortfall, the rural district of Lorin County moved its schools to a four-day week, extending each school day by about an hour to keep total teaching time roughly the same. The district saved approximately 5 percent of its annual budget, mostly on transport and heating. Supporters also claimed that teachers would be easier to recruit, and applications for vacant posts did in fact rise. Yet a review published six years later painted a more complicated picture. Test scores in reading had remained stable, but mathematics results had fallen slightly, particularly among younger pupils, who seemed to struggle with longer days. Working parents, meanwhile, had to arrange childcare for the fifth day, a burden that fell most heavily on low-income families. The authors of the review do not recommend abandoning the policy, but they urge the district to offer supervised activities on the free day.
exercises.question: According to the passage, the four-day week was introduced mainly in order to ----.
options: improve pupils' test scores
help working parents with childcare
shorten each school day
attract more teachers to the district
deal with a lack of money
exercises.explanation: İlk cümledeki 'faced with a severe budget shortfall' asıl nedeni verir: ciddi bütçe açığı. Doğru şık 'deal with a lack of money'. 'attract more teachers' tuzaktır; öğretmen bulmanın kolaylaşacağı destekçilerin 'also' ile eklediği ikincil bir iddiadır. 'shorten each school day' ise metnin tersidir, günler uzatılmıştır.

exercises.question: Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the passage as a result of the policy?
options: lower spending on transport and heating
higher scores in reading tests
more applications for teaching posts
a slight decline in mathematics results
childcare difficulties for working parents
exercises.explanation: Metne göre okuma puanları 'remained stable', yani yükselmemiş, sabit kalmıştır; bu yüzden 'higher scores in reading tests' sonuçlar arasında yoktur. Diğer şıkların hepsi metinde geçer: ulaşım ve ısınma tasarrufu, başvuruların artması, matematikte düşüş ve çocuk bakımı yükü.

exercises.question: The authors of the review would most likely agree that ----.
options: the district should return to a five-day week immediately
the policy has had no negative effects so far
low-income families have benefited most from the policy because they save on childcare
the policy can continue if some of its drawbacks are reduced
mathematics is less important than reading

exercises.passage: Glass beads found at the coastal site of Amarel were long thought to have been made locally. Their style closely resembles that of pottery decorations from the same period, and no foreign objects had been found nearby. Chemical analysis carried out last year, however, has overturned this assumption. The beads contain a type of plant ash that does not occur anywhere in the region but is typical of glass produced roughly 3,000 kilometres to the east. Some archaeologists suggest that local craftsmen imported raw glass and then shaped and decorated it themselves, which would explain why the beads look local despite their foreign origin. Others argue that the finished beads were made abroad to suit local tastes. Whichever interpretation is correct, the analysis shows that Amarel was part of a long-distance exchange network much earlier than historians had believed.
exercises.question: The phrase 'this assumption' in the passage refers to the belief that ----.
options: the beads had been produced locally
the beads had been imported from the east
local pottery was decorated with glass
Amarel traded with distant regions
plant ash could be found in the region
exercises.explanation: Metnin ilk cümlesi boncukların uzun süre yerel üretim sanıldığını söyler; kimyasal analiz bu varsayımı çürütmüştür. Doğru şık 'the beads had been produced locally'. 'imported from the east' tam tersidir: doğudan gelme fikri analizin ortaya koyduğu yeni bulgudur, eski varsayım değil.

exercises.passage: Glass beads found at the coastal site of Amarel were long thought to have been made locally. The beads contain a type of plant ash that does not occur anywhere in the region but is typical of glass produced roughly 3,000 kilometres to the east. Some archaeologists suggest that local craftsmen imported raw glass and then shaped and decorated it themselves, which would explain why the beads look local despite their foreign origin. Others argue that the finished beads were made abroad to suit local tastes. Whichever interpretation is correct, the analysis shows that Amarel was part of a long-distance exchange network much earlier than historians had believed.
exercises.question: Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?
options: Archaeologists now agree on where the beads were shaped.
Amarel's pottery was also imported from the east.
Historians had underestimated how early Amarel was connected to distant regions.
The plant ash was carried to the east from Amarel.
Local craftsmen in Amarel were unable to work with glass of any kind before the beads arrived.
exercises.explanation: Son cümleye göre Amarel, tarihçilerin sandığından çok daha önce uzak mesafeli bir ağın parçasıydı; demek ki tarihçiler bu bağlantının ne kadar erken olduğunu küçümsemişti, doğru şık 'Historians had underestimated...'. 'Archaeologists now agree' yanlıştır, çünkü iki farklı yorum hâlâ tartışılmaktadır; 'unable to work with glass' da yanlıştır, bir görüşe göre yerel ustalar camı şekillendirmiştir.

exercises.passage: Citizen science projects, in which members of the public help collect scientific data, have grown rapidly over the past decade. Their advantages are obvious: volunteers can gather observations across areas far too large for professional teams to cover. Critics, however, have questioned whether data collected by untrained participants can be trusted. A recent analysis of the Northmoor Butterfly Count, which relies on more than 5,000 volunteers, offers a partial answer. When researchers compared volunteer records with those of professional surveyors working on the same sites, they found that volunteers identified common species almost as accurately as experts. For rare species, which are easily confused with similar ones, their error rate was considerably higher. The authors therefore suggest that projects should ask volunteers to submit photographs of unusual sightings so that experts can verify them.
exercises.question: The author mentions the Northmoor Butterfly Count in order to ----.
options: show that citizen science is too expensive
criticise the work of professional surveyors
argue that volunteers should not take part in research
describe how butterflies are counted
provide evidence on the reliability of volunteer data
exercises.explanation: Eleştirmenlerin sorusu gönüllü verisine güvenilip güvenilemeyeceğidir; kelebek sayımı bu soruya 'kısmi bir cevap' olarak sunulur. Yani amaç güvenilirlik konusunda kanıt vermektir, doğru şık 'provide evidence on the reliability of volunteer data'. 'volunteers should not take part' aşırıdır, yazar gönüllüleri dışlamayı değil fotoğrafla doğrulamayı önerir; 'describe how butterflies are counted' ise sayım yöntemini anlatmayan metin için yanlış bir amaçtır.

were checked by professional surveyors
included photographs of unusual sightings

'concerned common species' tam tersidir: yaygın türlerde gönüllüler neredeyse uzmanlar kadar doğrudur. Fotoğraflı kayıtlar ise henüz uygulanmamış bir öneridir.

exercises.question: The committee's decision to ---- the funding came as a shock to researchers who had relied on it for years.
options: withdraw
accelerate
resemble
consolidate
verify
exercises.explanation: Yıllardır bu paraya güvenen araştırmacılar için şok olan şey fonun 'geri çekilmesidir'; doğru şık 'withdraw'. 'Verify' (doğrulamak) ve 'consolidate' (pekiştirmek) bir şok yaratmaz; 'resemble' (benzemek) ise anlamsızdır.

exercises.question: By the time the survey results were published, the government ---- its policy.
options: had already changed
has already changed
is changing
will have changed
changes
exercises.explanation: 'By the time' + geçmiş zaman (were published), ana cümlede geçmişteki bir andan önce tamamlanmış eylemi, yani past perfect'i gerektirir: 'had already changed'. 'Has already changed' present perfect'tir ve geçmişteki bir zaman ifadesiyle uyuşmaz; 'will have changed' ise geleceğe aittir.

exercises.question: ---- the new filter is far cheaper than its competitors, it tends to crack in very hot weather.
options: Although
Because
Unless
As soon as
So that
exercises.explanation: Cümlenin iki yarısı arasında karşıtlık vardır: ucuz olması olumlu, çatlaması olumsuz bir özelliktir. Bu yüzden 'Although' doğrudur. 'Because' neden-sonuç kurar ve ucuzluk çatlamanın nedeni değildir; 'Unless' (-medikçe) koşul bildirir ve anlamı bozar.

exercises.passage: Farmers on the Ulven plateau have traditionally grown barley on narrow terraces cut into the hillsides. These terraces prevent soil from being washed away during heavy rains, but they are expensive to maintain, since their stone walls must be repaired almost every year. As younger people move to the cities, fewer families are able to carry out such work. Agricultural economists warn that if the terraces collapse, the resulting erosion could make the land unusable for decades, forcing the remaining farmers to abandon the plateau altogether.
exercises.question: The word 'their' in 'since their stone walls must be repaired almost every year' refers to ----.
options: the terraces
the farmers
heavy rains
younger people
the cities
exercises.explanation: Cümle teraslar hakkındadır (they are expensive to maintain); onarılması gereken taş duvarlar terasların duvarlarıdır, doğru cevap 'the terraces'. 'Farmers' de çoğuldur ama cümlenin öznesi teraslardır ve bakımı pahalı olan şeyin duvarları söz konusudur.

exercises.question: The phrase 'such work' in the passage refers to ----.
options: moving to the cities
repairing the terraces' stone walls
growing barley in urban areas
studying agricultural economics
preventing heavy rains
exercises.explanation: 'such' (böyle) bir önceki cümlede anlatılan işi gösterir: her yıl taş duvarların onarılması. Doğru şık 'repairing the terraces' stone walls'. 'moving to the cities' aynı cümlede geçse de gençlerin şehre göçü 'iş' değil, işi yapacak kimsenin kalmamasının nedenidir.

exercises.passage: In 2017, workers renovating a monastery in the Kessa valley found 63 manuscripts hidden behind a wall. Most of the documents date from the fifteenth century and are written in a local dialect that disappeared about 200 years ago. Linguists from three universities have since been working to translate them. So far, they have established that the majority of the texts are not religious, as was first assumed, but records of trade between the valley and coastal towns. The manuscripts list goods such as salt, wool and dried fish, along with their prices. Historians believe these records may reveal how a remote mountain community remained economically connected to the wider world.
exercises.question: According to the passage, most of the manuscripts turned out to be ----.
options: religious texts
letters between monks
translations of coastal poetry
records of commercial exchanges
dictionaries of a lost dialect
exercises.explanation: 'turned out' ifadesi metindeki 'they have established that the majority of the texts are...' cümlesine karşılık gelir: 'records of trade', yani ticari kayıtlar. Doğru şık 'records of commercial exchanges'. 'religious texts' tuzaktır: metin dini oldukları ilk başta sanıldığını ama öyle olmadığını söyler.

The manuscripts list goods such as salt, wool and dried fish, along with their prices. Historians believe these records may reveal how a remote mountain community remained economically connected to the wider world.
exercises.question: According to the passage, the dialect in which the manuscripts are written ----.
options: is still spoken by some people in the valley
was used only by monks
was first recorded in the seventeenth century
ceased to be spoken roughly two centuries ago
was translated into Latin by coastal traders
exercises.explanation: Anahtar kelime 'dialect': 'a local dialect that disappeared about 200 years ago'. 'Disappeared' ile 'ceased to be spoken', 'about' ile 'roughly' eş anlamlıdır; doğru şık 'ceased to be spoken roughly two centuries ago'. 'is still spoken by some people' metinle çelişir; keşişlerle ve Latince çeviriyle ilgili şıklar metinde hiç geçmeyen bilgiler ekler.

exercises.passage: Along the coast of the Pelan Archipelago, marine biologists have been testing a new method of reef restoration. Instead of attaching coral fragments to concrete blocks, they grow them on frames made from recycled glass, which slowly releases minerals that corals use to build their skeletons. Early results are encouraging: corals on the glass frames grew about 25 percent faster than those on concrete. The frames are also lighter, so local fishermen can install them from small boats without heavy equipment. The team's main concern is cost; producing the frames currently costs twice as much as making concrete blocks, although the researchers expect prices to fall if production increases.
exercises.question: According to the passage, one advantage of the glass frames is that ----.
options: they are cheaper to produce than concrete blocks
they do not need to be placed underwater
they are manufactured by local fishermen
they protect corals from damage caused by boats
they can be installed without heavy equipment
exercises.explanation: Avantajları arayınca 'The frames are also lighter, so local fishermen can install them ... without heavy equipment' cümlesi bulunur; doğru şık 'they can be installed without heavy equipment'. 'cheaper to produce' metnin tam tersidir (iki kat pahalı); 'manufactured by local fishermen' ise tuzaktır, balıkçılar çerçeveleri üretmez, yalnızca yerleştirir.

exercises.passage: Along the coast of the Pelan Archipelago, marine biologists have been testing a new method of reef restoration. Instead of attaching coral fragments to concrete blocks, they grow them on frames made from recycled glass, which slowly releases minerals that corals use to build their skeletons. Early results are encouraging: corals on the glass frames grew about 25 percent faster than those on concrete. The frames are also lighter, so local fishermen can install them from small boats without heavy equipment. The team's main concern is cost; producing the frames currently costs twice as much as making concrete blocks, although the researchers expect prices to fall if production increases.
exercises.question: According to the passage, the researchers' main worry about the new method is ----.
options: the slow growth of the corals
the weight of the frames
the cost of producing the frames
the minerals released by the glass
the opposition of local fishermen
exercises.explanation: Kökteki 'main worry' metindeki 'main concern' ile eşleşir: 'The team's main concern is cost'. Doğru şık 'the cost of producing the frames'. 'the slow growth of the corals' yanlıştır, mercanlar %25 daha hızlı büyümüştür; 'the weight of the frames' de yanlıştır, çerçeveler daha hafiftir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Despite having the largest budget in the region, the hospital still struggles to recruit enough nurses.
options: Because the hospital has the largest budget in the region, it can easily recruit enough nurses.
Although the hospital has the largest budget in the region, it still finds it difficult to recruit enough nurses.
The hospital struggles to recruit enough qualified nurses, which is exactly why its budget is the largest in the region.
If the hospital had a larger budget, it would be able to recruit enough nurses.
No hospital in the region recruits as many nurses as this one, despite its small budget.
exercises.explanation: 'Despite + -ing' yapısı 'Although + cümle' ile aynı karşıtlığı verir; 'struggle to' = 'find it difficult to'. Doğru şık 'Although ... it still finds it difficult to recruit'. 'Because' ile kurulan şık karşıtlığı neden-sonuca çevirir ve anlamı tersine döndürür; 'despite its small budget' diyen şık ise bütçenin küçük olduğunu ima eder, oysa bütçe bölgedeki en büyüğüdür.

exercises.passage:
Student: I've finished collecting the survey data, but nearly a third of the questionnaires are incomplete.
Supervisor: ----
Student: Then I'll report the response rate clearly and analyse only the complete ones.
Supervisor: Good. Just make sure you explain that decision in your methods section.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Great, so you can start writing your conclusion right away.
Why did you choose a questionnaire instead of interviews?
That's quite common, but you can't fill in the gaps yourself, so you need a transparent way of handling them.
In that case, you'll have to collect all the data again from the beginning.
I'm afraid I haven't had time to read your literature review yet, so could we discuss your results next week instead?
exercises.explanation: Öğrenci 'Then' ile cevap verip eksik anketleri nasıl ele alacağını açıklar; bu, danışmanın eksik verilerin şeffaf bir yolla ele alınması gerektiğini söylemesine uyar, doğru şık 'you need a transparent way of handling them'. 'collect all the data again' verinin baştan toplanmasını ister, ama öğrenci yeniden toplamayı değil, eldeki tam anketleri analiz etmeyi önerir; 'start writing your conclusion right away' ise sorunu yok sayar.

exercises.passage: Many people believe that bilingual road signs distract drivers and therefore increase the risk of accidents. ---- A five-year study in the province of Weld, where half of the main roads have signs in two languages, found no difference in accident rates between roads with single-language and bilingual signs. The researchers suggest that drivers quickly learn to focus on the language they know and simply ignore the other one. Officials in Weld have since decided to extend bilingual signage to all main roads in the province.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Road signs were first introduced in the late nineteenth century.
Therefore, all bilingual signs should be removed as soon as possible.
Drivers in Weld are known for driving faster than the speed limit.
Many drivers also listen to the radio while they are driving.
The available evidence, however, does not support this concern.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan önce yaygın bir inanç, sonra bu inancı çürüten bir araştırma gelir; araya ancak 'however' ile karşıtlık kuran ve kanıtın endişeyi desteklemediğini söyleyen 'The available evidence, however, does not support this concern' girebilir. 'all bilingual signs should be removed' inancı doğru kabul eder ve araştırma bulgusuyla çelişir; yol levhalarının tarihini anlatan şık ise konudan sapar.

exercises.passage: (I) Sleep plays a crucial role in consolidating memories formed during the day. (II) During deep sleep, the brain appears to replay recent experiences, strengthening the connections between the neurons involved. (III) In one experiment, students who slept after learning a list of words remembered more of them the next day than those who stayed awake. (IV) Coffee is one of the most widely traded agricultural products in the world. (V) These findings suggest that sacrificing sleep in order to study longer may actually be counterproductive.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: Paragraf uykunun bellek üzerindeki etkisini anlatır: ana fikir (I), mekanizma (II), deney (III) ve sonuç (V). IV. cümle ise kahvenin dünya ticaretindeki yerinden söz ederek konudan tamamen kopar; doğru cevap IV. V. cümledeki 'These findings' III'teki deneye bağlandığı için akışın parçasıdır.

exercises.passage: Over the past two decades, ornithologists in the city of Calder Vale have recorded a remarkable change in the songs of urban blackbirds. Birds living near busy roads now sing at a noticeably higher pitch than those in quiet parks only a few kilometres away. Recordings from the 1990s show no such difference. Because traffic noise consists mainly of low-frequency sounds, the researchers argue that higher songs are easier for other birds to hear. They also found that females in noisy areas responded more strongly to high-pitched songs, whereas females in parks showed no clear preference.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that the difference in song pitch between road and park blackbirds ----.
options: has existed for many centuries
is caused by differences in the birds' diet
is found only among female blackbirds
makes birds in parks harder to hear
has developed within roughly the last twenty years
exercises.explanation: Metin değişimin son yirmi yılda kaydedildiğini ve 1990'lardaki kayıtlarda böyle bir fark olmadığını söyler; buradan farkın yakın zamanda ortaya çıktığı sonucu çıkar, yani 'has developed within roughly the last twenty years' doğrudur. 'has existed for many centuries' bu bilgiyle çelişir; beslenme ('the birds' diet') metinde hiç geçmez.

exercises.passage: Over the past two decades, ornithologists in the city of Calder Vale have recorded a remarkable change in the songs of urban blackbirds. Birds living near busy roads now sing at a noticeably higher pitch than those in quiet parks only a few kilometres away. Recordings from the 1990s show no such difference. Because traffic noise consists mainly of low-frequency sounds, the researchers argue that higher songs are easier for other birds to hear. They also found that females in noisy areas responded more strongly to high-pitched songs, whereas females in parks showed no clear preference.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that a male blackbird with a low-pitched song ----.
options: would attract more females if it lived near a busy road
would be unable to sing in a quiet park
would probably have more difficulty attracting a mate near a busy road
would immediately raise the pitch of its song after moving to a quiet park
would be clearly preferred by females living in parks
exercises.explanation: Gürültülü bölgelerdeki dişiler yüksek perdeli ötüşe daha güçlü tepki verdiğine göre, alçak perdeli öten bir erkek yol kenarında dezavantajlı olur; doğru şık 'would probably have more difficulty attracting a mate near a busy road'. 'clearly preferred by females living in parks' yanlıştır, çünkü parktaki dişilerin belirgin bir tercihi yoktur; 'would attract more females' ise metnin tam tersidir.

exercises.passage: When the software firm Brightloom allowed its 900 employees to work from home three days a week, managers expected productivity to fall. Instead, the number of completed projects rose slightly during the first year. Staff turnover, which had been around 18 percent annually, dropped to 7 percent. However, a survey revealed that newly hired employees felt less connected to their teams than those who had joined before the policy began. In response, the company now requires new staff to spend their first three months working in the office full-time.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that before the new policy ----.
options: Brightloom had fewer than 900 employees
Brightloom employees generally worked from the office
managers believed working from home would raise productivity
new employees felt more isolated than older employees
staff turnover at Brightloom was below 7 percent
exercises.explanation: Şirket çalışanlarına haftada üç gün evden çalışma izni 'verdiğine' (allowed) göre, politikadan önce çalışanlar genellikle ofisten çalışıyordu; doğru şık 'employees generally worked from the office'. 'turnover ... below 7 percent' yanlıştır, devir oranı önceden %18'di; 'managers believed working from home would raise productivity' de yanlıştır, yöneticiler verimliliğin düşmesini bekliyordu.

exercises.passage: When the software firm Brightloom allowed its 900 employees to work from home three days a week, managers expected productivity to fall. Instead, the number of completed projects rose slightly during the first year. Staff turnover, which had been around 18 percent annually, dropped to 7 percent. However, a survey revealed that newly hired employees felt less connected to their teams than those who had joined before the policy began. In response, the company now requires new staff to spend their first three months working in the office full-time.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that the company believes ----.
options: working from home reduces productivity
older employees should also return to the office at least three days a week
staff turnover is still a serious problem
time spent in the office helps new employees bond with their teams
the results of the survey were unreliable
exercises.explanation: Yeni çalışanların kendini ekibe daha az bağlı hissettiği ortaya çıkınca şirket onları ilk üç ay ofiste çalıştırmaya karar vermiştir; bu önlem, ofiste geçen zamanın bağ kurmaya yardım ettiğine inandığını gösterir, yani 'time spent in the office helps new employees bond' doğrudur. 'working from home reduces productivity' verimliliğin arttığı bilgisiyle çelişir; 'older employees should also return' için metinde dayanak yoktur, kural yalnızca yeni çalışanlar içindir.

nodes.title: Ünite ödülü
nodes.description: Üniteyi bitir, bonus XP kazan

units.title: Diyalog tamamlama
units.description: Boş repliği önceki ve sonraki konuşmaya göre seçme
units.guide:
## Strateji
Diyalog tamamlama sorularında iki kişi arasında geçen 4–6 replikten biri boş bırakılır (----) ve beş seçenekten konuşmanın akışına uyanı istenir. Bu sorular aslında bir **mantık** sorusudur: boşluk hem kendinden önceki repliğe **cevap** vermeli hem de kendinden sonraki repliğin **sebebi** olmalıdır. Çoğu aday yalnızca önceki cümleye bakar; oysa ÖSYM çeldiricileri tam da buna göre kurar. Önceki repliğe mükemmel uyan ama sonraki replikle çelişen şık yanlıştır. Ayrıca konuşmacıların **tonu** (onay, itiraz, öneri, şaşkınlık, özür, kibar ret) diyalog boyunca tutarlı olmalıdır. Akademik ve iş bağlamındaki diyaloglarda (danışman–öğrenci, yönetici–çalışan, editör–yazar) problem → öneri → değerlendirme sırası çok sık görülür.

## Örnekler
- *I couldn't agree more.* — Kesinlikle katılıyorum. (güçlü onay)
- *I see your point, but…* — Ne demek istediğini anlıyorum ama… (kibar itiraz)
- *Why don't we postpone the meeting?* — Toplantıyı ertelesek mi? (öneri)
- *Fair enough.* — Haklısın, makul. (karşı tarafın itirazını kabul)
- *That's a good idea. / Good thinking.* — İyi fikir. (bir öneriye verilen cevap: boşlukta öneri olmalı)
- *I wasn't aware of that.* — Bundan haberim yoktu. (boşlukta yeni bir bilgi verilmiş olmalı)

## Nasıl çözülür
1. Önce **boşluktan sonraki** repliği oku. *That's a good idea* öneri, *I didn't know that* yeni bilgi, *No, it will be done remotely* evet/hayır sorusu, *Partly* bir neden tahmini ister.
2. Sonra **boşluktan önceki** repliği oku: soru mu, sorun mu, iddia mı? Boşluk ona cevap vermeli.
3. Sonraki replikteki zamirleri kontrol et: *them, it, they, that* boşluktaki bir isme gönderme yapıyorsa o isim şıkta bulunmalı.
4. Tonu belirle: sonraki konuşmacı *True, but…* diyorsa boşlukta bir itiraz ya da farklı bir görüş vardır; *Exactly* diyorsa onay vardır.
5. Kalan şıkları sırayla boşluğa koy ve diyaloğu baştan sona sesli okur gibi oku; konudan sapan veya sonraki repliği anlamsız kılan şıkları ele.

**Örnek çözüm:**
*Kerem: Would you like to join our study group? / Leyla: ---- / Kerem: No problem. If you change your mind, we meet every Thursday.*
Adım 1: 'No problem. If you change your mind' bir **ret** cevabına verilir. Adım 2: Önceki replik bir davettir. Adım 4: Ton kibar olmalı. Böylece *Thanks for asking, but I prefer studying on my own* doğru olur. *Yes, I'd love to!* önceki repliğe uyar ama 'If you change your mind' ile çelişir; bu tipik ÖSYM çeldiricisidir.

## Tuzaklar ve sık yapılan hatalar
- **Yalnızca önceki repliğe bakmak:** En yaygın hata budur. Şık önceki cümleye cevap verir ama sonraki cümleyle uyuşmaz.
- **Anahtar kelime tuzağı:** Diyalogda geçen bir kelimeyi (ör. *lecture, printer, conference*) tekrar eden ama konuyu ilerletmeyen şık. Kelime aynı diye anlam aynı değildir.
- **Ton uyumsuzluğu:** Türkçede *Bence olmaz* gibi doğrudan itirazlar yaygındır; İngilizce akademik diyaloglarda itiraz genellikle *I'm not sure…, I doubt it…, That's true, but…* ile yumuşatılır. Kaba ya da aşırı kesin şıklar çoğu zaman çeldiricidir.
- **Genel doğruyu seçmek:** *Printers are much cheaper these days* gibi kendi başına doğru ama diyaloğa katkısı olmayan şıklar.
- **Soru tipi uyumsuzluğu:** *When…?* sorusuna yer bildiren, *Yes/No* sorusuna açıklama yapan cevap; ya da sonraki replik *No* ile başlıyorsa boşlukta evet/hayır sorusu olmaması.

## Sınav ipucu
YDS'de genellikle 5 diyalog sorusu gelir ve bunlar okuma bölümüne göre hızlı çözülür; soru başına 45–60 saniye hedefle. Diyaloğun **son repliği** çoğu zaman cevabın anahtarıdır, bu yüzden onu iki kez oku. Şıkları elerken her birini bir cümleyle gerekçelendir: 'önceye uyar, sonraya uymaz' gibi. İki şık arasında kalırsan sonraki replikteki zamirin ve bağlacın (*then, so, but, that*) hangi şıkla daha iyi bağlandığına bak.

nodes.title: Diyalog kalıpları
nodes.description: Onay, itiraz, öneri, özür ve ret bildiren kelime ve kalıplar

exercises.question: Thanks for the offer, but I'll have to ---- it; I'm already busy that evening.
options: submit
interrupt
recommend
decline
extend
exercises.explanation: Konuşmacı meşgul olduğu için teklifi kibarca 'reddetmek' zorundadır; doğru şık 'decline'. 'Recommend' (tavsiye etmek) ve 'extend' (uzatmak) 'but' ile kurulan ret anlamını vermez.

exercises.question: We can't finish the survey by Friday, so we'll have to ---- the meeting until next week.
options: accept
postpone
persuade
apologise
deny
exercises.explanation: Anket yetişmeyeceği için toplantı gelecek haftaya 'ertelenmelidir'; 'postpone ... until' kalıbı doğrudur. 'Apologise' (özür dilemek) nesne almaz ve 'for' ister; 'deny' (inkâr etmek) bağlama uymaz.

exercises.text: Why ___ we ask the professor for an extension?

exercises.question: Could you ---- what you mean by 'sample bias'? I didn't quite follow.
options: deny
decline
submit
postpone
clarify
exercises.explanation: Konuşmacı anlamadığını söylüyor ve açıklama istiyor; 'clarify' (açıklığa kavuşturmak) doğrudur. 'Submit' (teslim etmek) ve 'postpone' (ertelemek) 'ne demek istediğinizi' nesnesiyle anlamsızdır.

exercises.question: The supervisor asked the student to ---- a first draft of the chapter by the end of the month.
options: submit
apologise
object
complain
refuse
exercises.explanation: Bir taslağı belli bir tarihe kadar 'teslim etmek' = 'submit'. 'Object' ve 'complain' nesne almadan 'to/about' ile kullanılır; 'refuse' ise danışmanın isteğiyle mantıksal olarak çelişir.

exercises.question: When the customer ---- about the late delivery, the company offered a full refund.
options: persuaded
recommended
suggested
admitted
complained
exercises.explanation: Geç teslimat 'hakkında' (about) yapılan şey şikâyettir ve şirketin para iadesi teklif etmesine yol açar; 'complained' doğrudur. 'Suggested' ve 'recommended' 'about' ile kullanılmaz; 'persuaded' ise bir nesne ister.

exercises.text: I couldn't ___ more; that's exactly what I was thinking.
exercises.translation: Kesinlikle katılıyorum; tam da düşündüğüm buydu.

exercises.question: I see your point, but I'm not entirely ---- that the new schedule will work.
options: reluctant
convinced
eager
available
responsible
exercises.explanation: 'I see your point, but' kibar bir itirazı başlatır; 'not entirely convinced that' = tam olarak ikna olmuş değilim. Doğru şık 'convinced'. 'Reluctant' ve 'eager' that-cümlesiyle değil, 'to' ile kullanılır; 'available' ise anlamsızdır.

exercises.question: The professor ---- that we read the article before the seminar, as it would make the discussion easier.
options: persuaded
apologised
refused
suggested
objected
exercises.explanation: 'suggest that + özne + yalın fiil' öneri kalıbıdır (that we read); doğru şık 'suggested'. 'Persuaded' bir nesne ister (persuaded us that); 'objected' ise 'to' ile kullanılır ve okumayı kolaylaştıran bir öneriyle anlamca çelişir.

nodes.title: Soru–cevap uyumu ve ton
nodes.description: Boşluğu önceki ve sonraki repliğe göre seçme; onay, itiraz ve öneri tonları

exercises.passage:
Derya: Have you decided which topic you're going to choose for your term paper?
Tom: ----
Derya: Climate migration? That sounds interesting, but isn't it a bit broad?
Tom: Maybe. I'll narrow it down after talking to the professor.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: I submitted it to the professor last week.
Yes, I'm thinking of writing about how climate change forces people to move.
No, I've never taken a course on economics.
The library closes at eight on weekdays.
I'd rather work in a group than on my own, so I'm still waiting to hear from the others.
exercises.explanation: Derya'nın sonraki repliği 'Climate migration?' diye konuyu tekrar eder; demek ki Tom boşlukta iklim değişikliği ve göç konusunu söylemiştir, doğru şık 'I'm thinking of writing about how climate change forces people to move'. 'I submitted it to the professor' önceki soruya uyuyor gibi görünse de ödevi teslim ettiyse konuyu daraltmaktan söz etmesi anlamsızdır.

exercises.passage:
Selin: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the conference hall?
Receptionist: ----
Selin: Thanks. And is there a lift, or do I have to take the stairs?
Receptionist: There's a lift right next to the stairs.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: The conference starts at nine and finishes at five.
I'm afraid all our rooms are fully booked tonight.
You can register online for next year's conference using the form on the main page of our website.
Go up to the second floor and turn left; it's the large room at the end of the corridor.
The keynote speaker has just cancelled his talk.
exercises.explanation: Selin yol soruyor; sonraki replikte asansör ya da merdiven sorması, salonun üst katta olduğunu öğrendiğini gösterir. Bu yüzden 'Go up to the second floor and turn left' doğrudur. Konferans saatlerini veren şık salonla ilgili ama 'how to get to' sorusuna cevap vermez; 'all our rooms are fully booked' ise otel odalarıyla ilgilidir.

exercises.passage:
Murat: I think we should cancel the field trip because only half of the students have paid.
Elif: ----
Murat: That's a good idea. If they still haven't paid by then, we can decide.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: I'm not sure that's necessary. Why don't we give them one more week?
You're absolutely right; let's cancel it right now and tell the students this afternoon.
The bus company has already confirmed our booking.
Most of the students enjoyed last year's trip.
I paid for my own ticket yesterday.
exercises.explanation: 'That's a good idea' bir öneriye, 'by then' ise belli bir süreye gönderme yapar; boşlukta hem kibar itiraz hem bir hafta süre öneren 'Why don't we give them one more week?' gelmelidir. 'You're absolutely right' diyen şık Murat'ın görüşünü onaylar ama 'by then' ile kurulan süre anlamı karşılıksız kalır.

exercises.passage:
Professor Hale: In my view, students learn more when they explain ideas to each other than when they simply listen to lectures.
Can: ----
Professor Hale: Exactly. That's why I'm planning to include more group discussions this term.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: I disagree; lectures are the only reliable way to learn, and group work usually wastes a lot of valuable time.
When does tomorrow's lecture begin?
I've lost my notes from last week's lecture.
Group discussions are usually held in Room 12.
I couldn't agree more. Explaining something to others really shows whether you've understood it.
exercises.explanation: Profesörün 'Exactly' demesi, Can'ın onu onayladığını gösterir; güçlü onay bildiren 'I couldn't agree more' ile başlayan şık doğrudur. 'I disagree; lectures are the only reliable way' itiraz eder ve 'Exactly' ile çelişir; yarınki derse ve kaybolan notlara değinen şıklar 'lecture' kelimesini tekrar eden ama konuyu ilerletmeyen çeldiricilerdir.

exercises.passage:
Aylin: I can't concentrate in the dormitory; it's always too noisy.
Ben: ----
Aylin: I hadn't thought of that. Is it open late?
Ben: Until midnight during exam weeks.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: I usually go to bed very early on weekdays.
The dormitory was built in the 1970s.
Why don't you try the study room on the top floor of the library?
You should move to another city.
Noise pollution is a serious problem in big cities, especially in areas close to the airport.
exercises.explanation: Aylin'in 'Is it open late?' sorusu, boşlukta açılış saati olan bir yer önerildiğini gösterir: kütüphanenin çalışma odası. Doğru şık 'Why don't you try the study room ...?'. 'You should move to another city' de bir öneridir ama bir şehir 'geç saate kadar açık' olmaz; 'Noise pollution is a serious problem' ise konuyla ilgili genel bir doğrudur, öneri değildir.

exercises.passage:
Nurse: When did you first notice the pain in your knee?
Patient: ----
Nurse: And has it got worse since then?
Patient: Yes, especially when I climb stairs.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: About two weeks ago, after I went running on a wet track.
I usually go to the gym three times a week.
My knee doesn't hurt at all, actually.
Should I take these tablets before or after meals, or does it not really matter?
My brother had the same operation last year.
exercises.explanation: 'When' sorusu bir zaman cevabı ister ve hemşirenin 'since then' demesi boşlukta bir zaman noktası verildiğini gösterir; doğru şık 'About two weeks ago, after I went running'. 'My knee doesn't hurt at all' ağrıyı inkâr eder ve hastanın son repliğiyle çelişir; spor salonuna gitmekten söz eden şık zaman bildirmez, alışkanlık bildirir.

exercises.passage:
Kerem: Would you like to join our study group for the statistics exam?
Leyla: ----
Kerem: No problem. If you change your mind, we meet every Thursday.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Yes, I'd love to! When do you meet, and could I bring a friend from my class along?
The exam has been postponed until next month.
Statistics was my favourite subject at school.
Thanks for asking, but I prefer studying on my own for that subject.
I've already joined; see you on Thursday.
exercises.explanation: 'No problem. If you change your mind' kibar bir rede verilen cevaptır; doğru şık 'Thanks for asking, but I prefer studying on my own'. 'Yes, I'd love to!' daveti kabul eder ve 'fikrini değiştirirsen' ifadesini anlamsız kılar; 'I've already joined' de zaten katıldığını söylediği için aynı nedenle yanlıştır.

exercises.passage:
Manager: The client wants the report by Friday, but we're still waiting for the sales figures.
Ece: ----
Manager: Good thinking. Let me know what they say.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Friday is a public holiday this year.
Shall I call the sales department and ask them to send the figures today?
I've never really enjoyed writing reports.
The client was very satisfied with our last project.
Sales figures are usually published once a year, at the end of the financial year in December.
exercises.explanation: 'Good thinking' bir çözüm önerisine, 'what they say' ise konuşulacak bir gruba işaret eder; satış bölümünü arayıp rakamları istemeyi öneren 'Shall I call the sales department...?' doğrudur. Cuma tatilinden ve satış rakamlarının yayın sıklığından söz eden şıklar sorunla ilgili bilgi verir ama öneri içermez, ayrıca 'they' için uygun bir gönderim sunmaz.

exercises.passage:
Ahmet: Did you hear that the university is going to stop printing the student newspaper?
Zeynep: ----
Ahmet: Apparently, it'll only be published online from now on.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Yes, I've been writing for it for two years.
I'll buy a printed copy this afternoon.
Printing costs have fallen recently.
The editor's name is on the first page, just below the title and the date.
Really? Does that mean it'll disappear completely?
exercises.explanation: Ahmet'in 'Apparently, it'll only be published online' cevabı, Zeynep'in gazetenin tamamen kapanıp kapanmayacağını sorduğunu gösterir; şaşkınlık ve soru içeren 'Really? Does that mean it'll disappear completely?' doğrudur. 'I'll buy a printed copy' basılı nüshanın kalkacağı haberiyle çelişir; 'I've been writing for it for two years' ise sonraki açıklamayı gereksiz kılar.

exercises.passage:
Doctor: Your blood pressure is a bit high. Do you add a lot of salt to your food?
Patient: ----
Doctor: Well, processed foods often contain a lot of hidden salt, so try to cook fresh meals instead.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Yes, and I've already cut down on sugar.
My father also had high blood pressure.
Not really, but I eat ready meals most days because I don't have time to cook.
I usually go for a walk after dinner.
I've never had my blood pressure measured before.
exercises.explanation: Doktor 'Well' diyerek hazır gıdalardaki gizli tuzdan söz ediyor; bu, hastanın tuz eklemediğini ama hazır yemek yediğini söylemesine verilen bir cevaptır. Doğru şık 'Not really, but I eat ready meals most days'. Babasının yüksek tansiyonundan söz eden şık konuyla ilgili ama doktorun hazır yemek uyarısını açıklamaz; 'I've never had my blood pressure measured' ise doktorun tuzla ilgili sorusuna cevap vermez ve hazır gıda uyarısını açıklamaz.

exercises.passage:
Hakan: I'm sure online courses will soon replace traditional universities completely.
Professor Lin: ----
Hakan: That's true. I hadn't thought about lab work and clinical practice.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Absolutely. Campuses will be empty within ten years.
I doubt it. Fields like medicine and chemistry still require hands-on training on campus.
I'm teaching an online course myself this semester.
Universities were first founded in the Middle Ages.
Most students prefer to live at home with their families while they are studying at university.
exercises.explanation: Hakan'ın 'I hadn't thought about lab work and clinical practice' demesi, profesörün uygulamalı eğitim gerektiren alanları örnek gösterdiğini kanıtlar; kibar itiraz bildiren 'I doubt it. Fields like medicine and chemistry...' doğrudur. 'Absolutely. Campuses will be empty' onay bildirir ve sonraki repliği anlamsız kılar; profesörün kendi çevrimiçi dersinden söz eden şık ise konuyla ilgili ama Hakan'ın vardığı sonucu açıklamaz.

exercises.passage:
Librarian: I'm sorry, but this book can't be taken out of the library.
Student: ----
Librarian: Yes, of course. The photocopiers are on the ground floor.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
