options: Then I'll borrow it for two weeks instead, if that's all right with you.
Where can I return the books I borrowed?
Do you know who wrote this book?
I see. Would it be possible to copy a few pages, then?
I've already read it twice, actually.
exercises.explanation: Kütüphanecinin fotokopi makinelerinin yerini söylemesi, öğrencinin kitaptan sayfa kopyalayıp kopyalayamayacağını sorduğunu gösterir; doğru şık 'Would it be possible to copy a few pages, then?'. 'Then I'll borrow it for two weeks' kütüphanecinin 'dışarı çıkarılamaz' uyarısıyla çelişir; 'Where can I return the books...?' ise 'Yes, of course' cevabıyla uyuşmayan bir 'where' sorusudur.

nodes.title: Akademik ve iş diyalogları
nodes.description: Danışman, yönetici, editör ve müşteri diyaloglarında problem–öneri akışı

exercises.passage:
Professor Hale: I've read your second chapter. The data are interesting, but your argument isn't always clear.
Derya: ----
Professor Hale: Yes, start each section with a sentence that states its main claim.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Thank you, I'm glad you found the argument so clear.
I haven't started collecting the data yet.
Could you suggest how I might make it easier to follow?
Should I add more data from other countries?
The third chapter will be about methodology and the design of the questionnaire.
exercises.explanation: Profesör somut bir yazım tekniği öneriyor; bu, Derya'nın argümanı nasıl daha anlaşılır yapabileceğini sorduğunu gösterir, doğru şık 'Could you suggest how I might make it easier to follow?'. 'Should I add more data...?' de bir evet/hayır sorusudur, ama profesörün cevabı veri eklemekle değil açıklıkla ilgilidir; 'I'm glad you found the argument so clear' ise profesörün eleştirisini yanlış anlar.

exercises.passage:
Tom: Our sales in the northern region dropped by 15 percent last quarter.
Selin: ----
Tom: Partly, but the main problem was a new competitor offering lower prices.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: That's great news; we should celebrate.
We opened our first office in the north in 2010, and it has grown steadily ever since.
Let's raise our prices to make up for it.
The southern region performed even worse.
Was that because of the delivery delays we had in March?
exercises.explanation: 'Partly, but the main problem was...' bir neden tahminine verilen cevaptır; Selin düşüşün nedenini sormuş olmalıdır, doğru şık 'Was that because of the delivery delays...?'. 'Let's raise our prices' bir öneridir ve 'Partly' cevabına uymaz; 'That's great news' ise düşüşü iyi haber sayarak tona aykırıdır.

exercises.passage:
Lab technician: These samples need to be stored at minus twenty degrees, or the results won't be reliable.
Researcher: ----
Lab technician: Then we'll have to borrow some space in the biology department's freezer.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Great, I'll leave them on the bench overnight.
Unfortunately, our freezer broke down this morning.
We've already published the results.
How many samples did you collect in total?
Room temperature is usually about twenty degrees.
exercises.explanation: Teknisyenin 'Then we'll have to borrow ... freezer' demesi, kendi dondurucularının kullanılamaz olduğunu öğrendiğini gösterir; doğru şık 'our freezer broke down this morning'. Oda sıcaklığından söz eden şık 'twenty degrees' ifadesini tekrar eden bir kelime tuzağıdır; 'I'll leave them on the bench overnight' ise teknisyenin uyarısıyla çelişir.

exercises.passage:
Interviewer: Why do you want to leave your current position?
Candidate: ----
Interviewer: I understand. Our company offers plenty of opportunities for promotion.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: I enjoy my job, but there's little room for career development there.
I've worked there for five years as a project manager in the marketing department.
My office is only ten minutes from my home.
I'd like to start as soon as possible.
Your company was founded in 1998, wasn't it?
exercises.explanation: 'Why' sorusu bir neden ister; görüşmecinin terfi olanaklarından söz etmesi de adayın kariyer gelişimi eksikliğinden yakındığını gösterir, doğru şık 'there's little room for career development there'. 'I've worked there for five years' bilgi verir ama ayrılma nedenini söylemez; ofisin eve yakınlığı ise ayrılmak için değil kalmak için bir nedendir.

exercises.passage:
Organiser: We've had so many submissions that we may have to reject half of them.
Professor Lin: ----
Organiser: That's a good idea. Shorter talks would let us accept more papers.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Then we should accept all of them without any review.
I submitted my own paper two days after the deadline.
Last year's conference was held in a different city.
What if we reduced each presentation from twenty minutes to fifteen?
Let's raise the registration fee to cover the extra costs of renting a second hall.
exercises.explanation: Organizatörün 'Shorter talks' demesi, boşlukta sunum sürelerini kısaltan bir öneri olduğunu gösterir; 'What if we reduced each presentation...?' doğrudur. Kayıt ücretini artırmayı öneren şık da bir öneridir ama kısa konuşmalarla ilgisi yoktur; 'accept all of them without any review' ise hakem değerlendirmesini kaldırmayı önerir ve 'good idea' tepkisine uymaz.

exercises.passage:
Ben: I've written the introduction and the literature review. How's your part going?
Aylin: ----
Ben: Don't worry. If you send me what you have, I can help you with the analysis.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Great! I finished it yesterday and sent it to the professor along with the final graphs.
I think the introduction should be a bit shorter.
Our presentation is scheduled for next Monday.
I've never worked in a group before.
Not very well, I'm afraid. I'm having trouble interpreting the statistics.
exercises.explanation: Ben'in 'Don't worry' ve analiz konusunda yardım teklif etmesi, Aylin'in istatistikleri yorumlamada zorlandığını söylediğini gösterir; doğru şık 'I'm having trouble interpreting the statistics'. 'I finished it yesterday' işin bittiğini söyler ve yardım teklifini anlamsız kılar; 'I've never worked in a group before' bir endişe bildirir ama analizle bağlantı kurmaz.

exercises.passage:
Manager: The new software will be installed on all our computers over the weekend.
Kerem: ----
Manager: No, it will be done remotely, so you don't need to come in.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Does that mean we'll have to be in the office on Saturday?
I've already installed it on my laptop at home, so mine won't need updating.
How much did the company pay for it?
Will we get any training on how to use it?
My computer is quite old, actually.
exercises.explanation: Yöneticinin 'No ... you don't need to come in' cevabı, Kerem'in hafta sonu ofiste olması gerekip gerekmediğini sorduğunu gösterir; doğru şık 'Does that mean we'll have to be in the office on Saturday?'. 'Will we get any training...?' de bir evet/hayır sorusudur, ama 'uzaktan yapılacak, gelmenize gerek yok' cevabı eğitimle ilgili değildir; 'How much did the company pay for it?' ise 'No' ile cevaplanamaz.

exercises.passage:
Editor: One of the reviewers thinks your sample size is too small to support your conclusions.
Author: ----
Editor: That would certainly strengthen the paper. Please resubmit once you've done so.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: I completely disagree, so I won't change anything.
When will the paper be published?
I see. I could add data from the second phase of the study, which would double the sample.
The other reviewer liked the paper, didn't she?
My sample consisted mainly of university students, which is quite common in this field of research.
exercises.explanation: Editörün 'That would certainly strengthen the paper' ve 'once you've done so' demesi, yazarın yapılabilecek somut bir düzeltme önerdiğini gösterir; örneklemi iki katına çıkaran 'I could add data from the second phase' doğrudur. 'I won't change anything' diyen şık hiçbir şey değiştirmeyeceğini söyler, bu da 'once you've done so' ile çelişir.

exercises.passage:
Customer: I ordered the lab equipment three weeks ago, and it still hasn't arrived.
Sales representative: ----
Customer: Thank you. Please email me the tracking number as soon as you have it.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: We don't sell laboratory equipment, I'm afraid.
Our prices are going to rise next month.
Would you like to cancel the order and get a refund, or would you prefer a different model?
I apologise for the delay. Let me check where your order is right now.
I'm glad you're happy with the equipment.
exercises.explanation: Müşterinin takip numarası istemesi, temsilcinin siparişin nerede olduğunu kontrol edeceğini söylediğini gösterir; özür ve kontrol içeren 'I apologise for the delay. Let me check where your order is' doğrudur. İptal ve iade öneren şık yanlıştır; müşteri bunu kabul etseydi takip numarası istemezdi. 'I'm glad you're happy with the equipment' ise ürün henüz ulaşmadığı için anlamsızdır.

exercises.passage:
Student: Professor, could I have an extension for my essay? I've been ill for most of the week.
Professor Hale: ----
Student: Yes, I can get one from the health centre today.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Of course; you don't need to submit anything at all.
That should be possible, but I'll need a medical note.
The essay should be about 3,000 words long.
I'm sorry to hear that you didn't enjoy the course, but there's nothing I can do.
Your previous essay was excellent.
exercises.explanation: Öğrencinin 'I can get one from the health centre' demesi, profesörün sağlık merkezinden alınabilecek bir belge istediğini gösterir; 'one' = 'a medical note'. Doğru şık 'That should be possible, but I'll need a medical note'. 'you don't need to submit anything at all' ek süreyi kabul eder ama öğrencinin belge getirme cevabını açıklamaz ve ödevi tümden kaldırır.

nodes.title: Sınav düzeyi
nodes.description: İnce ton farkları, gönderimler ve sonraki repliğe dayalı zor diyaloglar

exercises.passage:
Researcher: Our survey suggests that people who cycle to work are happier than those who drive.
Journalist: ----
Researcher: That's a fair point. People who are already healthy and cheerful may simply be more likely to choose cycling.
Journalist: So you can't say for certain that cycling itself makes them happier.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: So the government should make cycling compulsory for everyone who lives near their workplace.
How many cars are there in the city at the moment?
That proves that driving causes unhappiness.
But couldn't it be the other way round, with happier people being more likely to cycle?
Did you ask the participants how far they live from work?
exercises.explanation: Araştırmacı 'That's a fair point' diyerek mutlu insanların bisikleti seçme olasılığının daha yüksek olabileceğini kabul ediyor; demek ki gazeteci neden-sonuç ilişkisinin tersine dönebileceğini sormuştur, doğru şık 'But couldn't it be the other way round...?'. İşe uzaklığı soran şık da akademik bir sorudur ama araştırmacının cevabı mesafeyle değil, nedenselliğin yönüyle ilgilidir; 'That proves that driving causes unhappiness' ise kesin bir iddiadır ve 'fair point' tepkisini almaz.

exercises.passage:
Derya: The committee has rejected our proposal for the second time.
Murat: ----
Derya: They said our budget was unrealistic, especially the travel costs.
Murat: Then let's revise those figures before the next deadline.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Did they explain what exactly they objected to?
Great! When do we start the project?
I told you we shouldn't have applied in the first place.
Who else is on the committee this year?
Our travel arrangements have already been booked.
exercises.explanation: Derya'nın cevabı komitenin itiraz gerekçesini açıklıyor ('They said...'); boşlukta bu gerekçeyi soran 'Did they explain what exactly they objected to?' olmalıdır. 'I told you we shouldn't have applied' tona uygun bir tepki gibi görünse de Derya'nın gerekçe açıklamasını tetiklemez; 'Who else is on the committee...?' ise 'Who' sorusudur ve cevapla uyuşmaz.

exercises.passage:
Professor Lin: Several students have complained that the online quizzes close too early.
Teaching assistant: ----
Professor Lin: In that case, they've had more than enough time. Let's leave the deadline as it is.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: You're right; let's extend the deadline by three days.
The quizzes were designed by an external software company, so we can't change their settings.
Should we make the quizzes a little more difficult?
Only a few students have complained so far, though.
Actually, they're open for a full week, and reminders are sent two days before they close.
exercises.explanation: Profesörün 'In that case, they've had more than enough time' sonucu, asistanın sınavların yeterince uzun süre açık kaldığını söylediğini gösterir; doğru cevap 'Actually, they're open for a full week…'. 'let's extend the deadline' diyen şık süreyi uzatmayı önerir ve 'leave the deadline as it is' kararıyla çelişir; 'Only a few students have complained' diyen şık şikâyet sayısından söz eder ama 'yeterli süre' sonucunu desteklemez.

exercises.passage:
Engineer: The bridge passed all its safety inspections, so I see no reason to close it.
Inspector: ----
Engineer: I wasn't aware of that. If the cracks have appeared since then, we certainly need another check.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: I agree; it's one of the safest bridges in the country.
The bridge was designed by a well-known architect.
The last inspection was eight months ago, though, and residents have recently reported new cracks.
Closing the bridge would cause serious traffic problems, especially during the morning and evening rush hours.
Inspections are usually carried out every five years.
exercises.explanation: Mühendisin 'I wasn't aware of that' demesi yeni bir bilgiye, 'the cracks' ve 'since then' ise boşlukta çatlaklardan ve bir tarihten söz edildiğine işaret eder; doğru şık 'The last inspection was eight months ago ... new cracks'. 'Inspections are usually carried out every five years' denetimlerle ilgilidir ama çatlakları anmaz; 'I agree; it's one of the safest bridges' ise onay bildirir ve yeni denetim kararına yol açmaz.

exercises.passage:
Elif: I'm thinking of doing a master's degree abroad, but I'm worried about the cost.
Can: ----
Elif: I didn't know that. Where can I find out more about them?
Can: The international office has a list on its website.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Studying abroad is a great way to learn a new language.
Many universities offer scholarships that cover tuition fees for international students.
Living costs in big cities are usually very high, especially for students who rent a flat alone.
You should ask your bank for a loan.
Most master's programmes last two years.
exercises.explanation: Elif'in sorusundaki çoğul 'them' ve Can'ın uluslararası ofisteki listeden söz etmesi, boşlukta burslardan (scholarships) bahsedildiğini gösterir; doğru şık 'Many universities offer scholarships...'. 'ask your bank for a loan' de maliyet sorununa bir çözümdür ama 'them' için çoğul bir gönderim sunmaz ve bir listeyle bağlantılı değildir; büyük şehirlerdeki yaşam maliyetini anan şık ise endişeyi artırır.

exercises.passage:
Manager: Productivity has risen since we introduced flexible hours, so I'd like to extend the scheme to every department.
HR officer: ----
Manager: Fair enough. Let's survey the staff before making a final decision.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: That's encouraging, but we should check whether employees are actually satisfied with it.
I disagree; productivity has fallen sharply since then, according to the figures we received last month.
Yes, let's extend it to all departments from tomorrow.
Our office opens at eight o'clock every morning.
How many people work in your department?
exercises.explanation: 'Fair enough' bir çekinceyi kabul eder; yöneticinin çalışanlara anket yapmaya karar vermesi, İK'nın çalışan memnuniyetini kontrol etmeyi önerdiğini gösterir, doğru şık 'we should check whether employees are actually satisfied'. 'productivity has fallen sharply' yöneticinin verdiği bilgiyle çelişir; 'let's extend it to all departments' ise tam onaydır ve anket yapma kararını gereksiz kılar.

exercises.passage:
Student: I've found an article that supports my argument, but it was published in 1985.
Supervisor: ----
Student: So I should look for more recent studies to see whether the findings still hold.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Never use any source that is more than five years old.
1985 was a very productive year for that journal.
Have you finished your bibliography yet?
Older sources aren't necessarily wrong, but you need to check whether later research has confirmed them.
Your argument doesn't need any support at all.
exercises.explanation: Öğrencinin 'So I should look for more recent studies to see whether the findings still hold' sonucu, danışmanın eski kaynağı reddetmeyip sonraki araştırmalarla karşılaştırmayı önerdiğini gösterir; doğru şık 'Older sources aren't necessarily wrong...'. 'Never use any source that is more than five years old' kaynağı tümden yasaklar; o zaman bulguların 'hâlâ geçerli olup olmadığını' kontrol etmeye gerek kalmazdı.

exercises.passage:
Tom: The city council wants to turn the old textile factory into a shopping centre.
Selin: ----
Tom: True, but restoring it would cost far more than building something new.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Great, we definitely need more shops in the city, especially in the old industrial district.
When was the factory closed down?
The council meets every Tuesday evening.
I've never been inside a shopping centre.
That's a pity. It's one of the few industrial buildings left from the nineteenth century.
exercises.explanation: Tom 'True, but' ile Selin'in görüşünü kısmen kabul edip restorasyonun maliyetine dikkat çekiyor; demek ki Selin binanın korunmaya değer olduğunu söylemiştir, doğru şık 'That's a pity. It's one of the few industrial buildings left'. 'we definitely need more shops' projeyi destekler; o zaman Tom'un restorasyondan söz etmesi anlamsız olurdu. 'When was the factory closed down?' ise bir sorudur ve 'True' ile cevaplanamaz.

exercises.passage:
Patient: The doctor told me to take these tablets twice a day, but I keep forgetting the evening dose.
Pharmacist: ----
Patient: That's a good idea. I always brush my teeth before bed, so I won't forget.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Then just take both tablets together in the morning.
Why not keep them next to your toothbrush, so you see them every night?
These tablets should be stored in a cool, dry place.
Have you noticed any side effects so far?
You can buy them without a prescription.
exercises.explanation: Hastanın 'I always brush my teeth before bed' cevabı, eczacının ilaçları diş fırçasının yanında tutmayı önerdiğini gösterir; doğru şık 'Why not keep them next to your toothbrush...?'. 'take both tablets together' de bir öneridir ama sağlık açısından yanlış olmasının yanı sıra diş fırçalama cevabıyla bağlantı kurmaz; 'stored in a cool, dry place' ise saklama bilgisidir, unutkanlığa çözüm değildir.

exercises.passage:
Professor Hale: The results of your experiment contradict those of three earlier studies.
Can: ----
Professor Hale: That might explain it. Make sure you discuss this difference in your paper.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: So my results must be wrong; I'll delete them.
I've read all three studies very carefully.
Perhaps that's because we used a much younger group of participants than they did.
Should I send the paper to a journal now?
The earlier studies were all published in English, in fairly well-known international journals.
exercises.explanation: 'That might explain it' bir açıklama önerisine, 'this difference' ise yöntemsel bir farka işaret eder; katılımcı yaşındaki farkı öne süren 'we used a much younger group of participants' doğrudur. 'I've read all three studies very carefully' ilgili görünür ama çelişkiyi açıklamaz; 'my results must be wrong; I'll delete them' ise profesörün farkı makalede tartışma önerisiyle çelişir.

nodes.title: Ünite testi
nodes.description: 17 soruluk ünite testi; geçmek için %80 doğru yap

exercises.question: The professor ---- the deadline by a week because many students had been ill.
options: extended
withdrew
resembled
deprived
concealed
exercises.explanation: Öğrenciler hasta olduğu için son tarih bir hafta 'uzatılmıştır'; 'extend a deadline by a week' doğal kalıptır, doğru şık 'extended'. 'Withdrew' (geri çekti) son tarihle kullanılmaz; 'concealed' (gizledi) ise anlamsızdır.

exercises.question: If the committee ---- our proposal, we would have started the project last year.
options: accepts
accepted
had accepted
has accepted
would accept
exercises.explanation: Ana cümledeki 'would have started' üçüncü tip koşulu gösterir; if-cümlesi past perfect olmalıdır: 'had accepted'. 'Accepted' ikinci tip koşula aittir ve 'would have + V3' ile uyuşmaz.

exercises.passage:
Waiter: Good evening. Are you ready to order, or would you like a few more minutes?
Customer: ----
Waiter: Certainly. I'll come back shortly.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Yes, I'll have the soup and a salad, please.
Could we have the bill, please? We're in a hurry because our train leaves soon.
Could we have a few more minutes, please? We haven't decided yet.
The food here is always excellent.
I booked a table for four people.
exercises.explanation: Garsonun 'I'll come back shortly' demesi müşterinin biraz daha süre istediğini gösterir; doğru cevap 'Could we have a few more minutes, please?'. 'I'll have the soup and a salad' diyen şık önceki soruya uyar ama sipariş verildiyse garsonun 'sonra gelirim' demesi anlamsız olur.

exercises.passage:
Ahmet: I've lost the notes from yesterday's lecture.
Leyla: ----
Ahmet: That would be great, thanks. I'll return them tomorrow.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Don't worry, you can borrow mine and make a copy.
I didn't attend the lecture either.
The lecture was about genetics.
You should be more careful next time.
The exam will be held in June.
exercises.explanation: Ahmet 'That would be great' diyerek bir teklifi kabul ediyor ve 'I'll return them' ile ödünç aldığı notları geri vereceğini söylüyor; doğru şık 'Don't worry, you can borrow mine'. 'You should be more careful next time' bir eleştiridir ve teşekkürle karşılanmaz; 'I didn't attend the lecture either' ise yardım teklif etmez.

exercises.passage:
Tom: The printer in our office has broken down again.
Ece: ----
Tom: I did, but they said the technician won't be available until Monday.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: I'll buy a new printer myself.
It's the third time this month.
Printers are much cheaper these days.
I never print anything anyway.
Have you reported it to the IT department?
exercises.explanation: 'I did, but they said...' bir 'Did you / Have you...?' sorusuna verilen cevaptır ve 'they' bir bölüme gönderme yapar; doğru şık 'Have you reported it to the IT department?'. 'It's the third time this month' duruma uygun bir yorumdur ama Tom'un 'I did' cevabını açıklamaz.

exercises.question: The research team decided to repeat the experiment ----.
options: although they had never conducted it before
so that they could check whether the original results were reliable
unless the results had already been published
because of the experiment was too expensive to run again in the same laboratory
as soon as they will receive more funding
exercises.explanation: Bir deneyi tekrarlamanın mantıklı amacı sonuçların güvenilirliğini kontrol etmektir; 'so that' amaç bildirir, doğru şık 'so that they could check whether the original results were reliable'. 'although they had never conducted it before' anlamca çelişir (hiç yapılmamış bir deney 'tekrarlanamaz'); 'because of the experiment was...' ve 'as soon as they will receive...' dilbilgisel olarak hatalıdır ('because of' + cümle, zaman bağlacından sonra 'will').

exercises.question: Araştırmacılar, sonuçların daha geniş bir örneklemle doğrulanması gerektiğini vurguluyor.
options: The researchers confirmed the results with a larger sample.
The researchers doubt that a larger sample would change the results of their study in any way.
According to the researchers, a larger sample was used to emphasise the results.
The researchers stress that the results need to be confirmed with a larger sample.
The researchers emphasised the results before the sample was enlarged.
exercises.explanation: 'vurgulamak' = stress, '-mesi gerektiği' = need to be confirmed (edilgen zorunluluk); doğru şık 'The researchers stress that the results need to be confirmed'. 'confirmed the results with a larger sample' doğrulamanın yapıldığını söyler, oysa Türkçe cümle bunun gerektiğini söyler; 'doubt that a larger sample would change' ise şüphe anlamı ekler.

exercises.passage:
Derya: I'm presenting my research at a conference next week, and I'm really nervous.
Professor Hale: ----
Derya: That's a good idea. Could I do it in your office on Friday?
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Conferences are usually quite expensive to attend, especially when they are held abroad.
Why don't you rehearse your talk in front of me first?
Don't present it; just send them your slides.
I gave my first conference talk many years ago.
Your research is about migration, isn't it?
exercises.explanation: 'That's a good idea' bir öneriye, 'Could I do it in your office' ise profesörün önünde yapılacak bir etkinliğe işaret eder; prova önerisi olan 'Why don't you rehearse your talk in front of me first?' doğrudur. 'Don't present it; just send them your slides' de bir öneridir ama profesörün ofisinde yapılacak bir şey değildir ve kaygıya sağlıklı bir çözüm sunmaz.

exercises.passage:
Customer: I'd like to return this laptop. The screen keeps flickering.
Shop assistant: ----
Customer: Yes, here it is. I bought it ten days ago.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: That model is our best-selling laptop.
I'm afraid we don't sell laptops anymore.
Would you like to buy a new keyboard as well, since we have a special offer today?
I'm sorry about that. Do you have the receipt?
Screens usually last for many years.
exercises.explanation: Müşterinin 'Yes, here it is' diyerek bir şey uzatması, boşlukta bir belge istendiğini gösterir; fiş soran 'Do you have the receipt?' doğrudur. 'Would you like to buy a new keyboard...?' de bir evet/hayır sorusudur ama 'here it is' cevabıyla uyuşmaz.

exercises.passage:
Manager: We need someone to represent the company at the trade fair in İzmir next month.
Can: ----
Manager: Excellent. I'll ask the office to book your flight.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: I'm afraid I'll be on holiday that week.
Trade fairs are usually a waste of money.
I'd be happy to go, if nobody else has volunteered.
İzmir is on the west coast of Turkey.
Who represented us there last year, and how successful was the trip?
exercises.explanation: Yöneticinin 'Excellent' deyip Can için uçak bileti ayırtması, Can'ın gönüllü olduğunu gösterir; doğru şık 'I'd be happy to go'. 'I'll be on holiday that week' reddeder ve bilet ayırtmayı anlamsız kılar; 'Who represented us there last year, and how successful was the trip?' bir sorudur, 'Excellent' ile cevaplanmaz.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The meeting was postponed not because the manager was ill but because the report had not been completed.
options: The manager was ill, so the report could not be completed and the meeting was postponed.
Although the report was ready, the meeting was postponed because of the manager's illness.
The meeting went ahead even though the report had not been finished.
Had the manager not been ill, the report would have been completed on time.
It was the unfinished report, rather than the manager's illness, that caused the meeting to be postponed.
exercises.explanation: 'not because X but because Y' yapısı gerçek nedenin Y (rapor) olduğunu söyler; 'It was ... rather than ... that' vurgu yapısı aynı anlamı verir, doğru şık 'It was the unfinished report, rather than the manager's illness...'. 'The manager was ill, so...' ve 'Had the manager not been ill...' hastalığı neden olarak sunar; 'Although the report was ready' ise raporun hazır olduğunu söyleyerek tam tersini anlatır.

exercises.passage:
Student: I don't understand why my essay received such a low mark.
Lecturer: ----
Student: I see. So I should have used more sources to back up my points.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Your ideas were interesting, but you didn't provide enough evidence to support them.
Your essay was actually the best in the class.
The essays were marked by a colleague of mine.
Well, at least you submitted it on time, which is more than some of your classmates did.
Marks will be published online next week.
exercises.explanation: Öğrencinin 'I should have used more sources to back up my points' sonucu, hocanın yetersiz kanıttan söz ettiğini gösterir; doğru şık 'you didn't provide enough evidence to support them'. 'marked by a colleague of mine' düşük notun nedenini açıklamaz; 'the best in the class' ise düşük notla çelişir.

exercises.passage: Freshwater mussels are sometimes described as the 'kidneys' of rivers. ---- A single adult can filter several litres of water an hour, removing algae, bacteria and fine particles as it feeds. Where mussel populations have declined, water quality often deteriorates noticeably, and other species that depend on clear water begin to disappear as well. Conservationists in several countries now breed young mussels in hatcheries and release them into rivers where populations have collapsed. Early results suggest that even small numbers of reintroduced mussels can noticeably improve water clarity within a few years.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: This is because they clean the water around them as they feed.
Mussels are also a popular food in many coastal countries.
Rivers are usually deeper in winter than in summer.
However, they have little effect on the water around them.
The kidneys filter waste products from the blood in the human body.
exercises.explanation: Boşluk, midyelerin neden 'nehrin böbrekleri' sayıldığını açıklamalı ve sonraki filtreleme cümlesine zemin hazırlamalıdır; doğru cevap 'This is because they clean the water…'. 'they have little effect on the water' diyen şık sonraki cümleyle çelişir; böbreklerin kandaki atıkları süzdüğünü söyleyen şık 'kidneys' kelimesini tekrar eden ama konuyu insan vücuduna kaydıran bir tuzaktır.

exercises.passage:
Selin: The new metro line was supposed to reduce traffic, but the roads seem just as busy.
Murat: ----
Selin: So it may take a while before we see any real change.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: That's because the metro project has been cancelled.
Actually, the roads were much quieter before the metro opened, according to local residents.
Metro tickets are very cheap compared with bus fares.
I always drive to work, so I wouldn't know.
It only opened last month, and many people haven't changed their habits yet.
exercises.explanation: Selin'in 'So it may take a while' sonucu, Murat'ın değişimin zaman alacağını düşündüren bir neden verdiğini gösterir: hat yeni açılmış ve alışkanlıklar henüz değişmemiştir, doğru şık 'It only opened last month...'. 'the metro project has been cancelled' diyen şık hattın iptal edildiğini söyler; o zaman 'bir süre sonra değişim görürüz' sonucu çıkmaz.

exercises.passage:
Researcher: Our funding runs out in June, but the experiment won't be finished until September.
Colleague: ----
Researcher: It's worth a try. I'll draft the request this week.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Then we should stop the experiment immediately.
Couldn't we apply to the foundation for a short extension?
Our results so far have been very promising, especially in the second group of tests.
June is usually the busiest month of the year.
Who funded the experiment originally?
exercises.explanation: 'It's worth a try' bir öneriye, 'draft the request' ise yazılı bir başvuruya işaret eder; vakfa ek süre başvurusu öneren 'Couldn't we apply to the foundation for a short extension?' doğrudur. 'stop the experiment immediately' de bir öneridir ama 'request' yazmayı gerektirmez; 'Who funded the experiment originally?' ise bir bilgi sorusudur ve 'denemeye değer' cevabını almaz.

exercises.passage: (I) Many universities now record their lectures and make them available online. (II) Supporters argue that this allows students to review difficult material at their own pace, which is particularly helpful for those studying in a second language. (III) Some of the oldest universities in Europe were founded nearly a thousand years ago. (IV) Critics, however, worry that attendance may drop if students know they can watch lectures later. (V) Recent studies suggest that attendance falls only slightly, while exam results tend to improve.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: Paragraf ders kayıtlarının çevrim içi paylaşılmasını, destekçilerin ve eleştirmenlerin görüşlerini ve araştırma bulgularını anlatır. III. cümle ise üniversitelerin kuruluş tarihine geçerek konudan kopar; doğru cevap III. IV. cümledeki 'however' II'deki destekçi görüşüne bağlandığı için akışın parçasıdır.

exercises.passage:
Journalist: Critics say your new parking policy will hurt small businesses in the city centre.
Mayor: ----
Journalist: But many shop owners say they were never asked for their opinion.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: I agree with them; we will cancel the policy tomorrow and apologise to the business owners.
Small businesses employ most people in the city.
The policy was introduced last spring.
On the contrary, we consulted small business owners at every stage of the planning.
I'm not sure who these critics are.
exercises.explanation: Gazetecinin 'But many shop owners say they were never asked' itirazı, belediye başkanının esnafa danışıldığını iddia ettiğini gösterir; doğru şık 'On the contrary, we consulted small business owners'. 'I agree with them; we will cancel the policy' eleştiriyi kabul eder; o zaman gazetecinin 'But' ile karşı çıkması anlamsız olurdu.

nodes.title: Ünite ödülü
nodes.description: Üniteyi bitir, bonus XP kazan

units.title: Restatement
units.description: Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümleyi bulma
units.guide:
## Strateji
Restatement (anlamca en yakın cümle) sorularında bir İngilizce kök cümle verilir ve beş şıktan bu cümleyi **başka yapılarla ama aynı anlamla** söyleyen bulunur. Doğru şık neredeyse hiçbir zaman kök cümledeki kelimeleri aynen tekrar etmez; bağlaç (*although → despite*), zaman (*has not been open since → has been closed ever since*), etken/edilgen, karşılaştırma ya da devrik yapı değiştirilerek yazılır. Bu yüzden kelimelere değil, **anlam bileşenlerine** bakmak gerekir: Kim? Ne yaptı? Ne zaman? Olumlu mu, olumsuz mu? Neden–sonuç mu, karşıtlık mı, koşul mu? Ne kadar kesin (*may, all, hardly*)? Doğru şık bu bileşenlerin hepsini korur; çeldiriciler genellikle bir tanesini değiştirir.

## Örnekler
- *Although it rained, the match went ahead.* = *Despite the rain, the match went ahead.* — Yağmura rağmen maç oynandı.
- *Unless funding increases, the clinic will close.* = *If funding does not increase, the clinic will close.* — Fon artmazsa klinik kapanacak.
- *Not all participants finished.* = *Some participants did not finish.* — Katılımcıların hepsi bitirmedi.
- *Had the warning come earlier, more people could have left.* = *Because the warning was late, fewer people were able to leave.* — Uyarı geç geldiği için daha az kişi ayrılabildi.
- *The new building uses half as much energy as the old one.* = *The old building used twice as much energy.* — Eski bina iki katı enerji kullanıyordu.

## Nasıl çözülür
1. Kök cümleyi oku ve **mantık ilişkisini** belirle: karşıtlık (*although, despite, much as*), neden (*because, due to*), koşul (*unless, provided that, had…*), zaman (*by the time, as soon as, not until*), karşılaştırma (*as…as, the more…the more*).
2. **Olumsuzluğu ve miktarı** işaretle: *not all, hardly, few if any, neither…nor, no other*. Bunlar şıkta birebir korunmalıdır.
3. **Zamanı ve sırayı** kontrol et: hangi olay önce oldu? Gerçekleşti mi, gerçekleşmedi mi (koşul cümlelerinde gerçeğin tersi anlatılır)?
4. Şıklarda ilişkiyi ters çeviren (karşıtlığı nedene çeviren), olumsuzluğu kaldıran, kesinliği artıran (*some → all*) ya da yeni bilgi ekleyen seçenekleri ele.
5. Kalan şıkkı kök cümleyle bileşen bileşen eşleştir; tek bir bileşen bile farklıysa ele.

**Örnek çözüm:** Kök: *The longer patients wait for treatment, the less likely they are to make a full recovery.*
Adım 1: *the …-er, the …-er* orantı bildirir. Adım 2: *less likely* olumsuz yönlü bir olasılıktır. Adım 4: *Patients recover fully no matter how long they wait* ilişkiyi yok eder; *The longer the treatment lasts, the better patients recover* bekleme süresini tedavi süresine çevirir. Adım 5: *Patients who receive treatment sooner have a better chance of recovering fully* aynı orantıyı ters yönden söyler: doğru cevap.

## Tuzaklar ve sık yapılan hatalar
- **Aynı kelimeleri içeren şıkkı seçmek:** Kök cümledeki kelimeleri en çok tekrar eden şık çoğu zaman anlamı bozan çeldiricidir.
- **Koşul cümlelerinde gerçeği karıştırmak:** *Had the warning been issued earlier* uyarının **geç** verildiğini anlatır. Türkçede *-seydi* yapısı da aynı şekilde gerçeğin tersidir; bunu unutan aday 'uyarı erken verildi' diyen şıkkı seçer.
- **Neden–sonuç yönünü ters çevirmek:** *X because Y* ile *Y because X* aynı kelimeleri içerir ama anlamı tamamen farklıdır.
- **Miktar ifadelerini abartmak:** *hardly any* (neredeyse hiç) ≠ *none* (hiç), *not all* (hepsi değil) ≠ *none* (hiçbiri). *Hardly* kelimesini 'zor' (hard) sanmak Türk adayların tipik hatasıdır.
- **Devrik yapıları soru sanmak:** *Not until…did*, *Scarcely had…when*, *Only by…can*, *So…did…that* yapıları soru değil, vurgulu olumlu cümlelerdir.
- **Karşılaştırmada yönü kaçırmak:** *half as much as* = yarısı kadar; *not as efficient as* = daha az verimli.

## Sınav ipucu
YDS'de genellikle 5 restatement sorusu gelir. Şıklar uzun olduğu için önce kök cümlenin Türkçe özetini zihninde tek cümleyle kur (ör. 'Hasta erken teşhis edilmediği için tümör yayıldı'). Sonra şıkları bu özetle karşılaştır; çoğu zaman üç şık ilk bakışta elenir. Son iki şık arasında kalırsan miktar, zaman ve olumsuzluk bileşenlerini kontrol et. Devrik yapıları (*Had, Were, Should, Not until, Only*) gördüğünde önce düz cümleye çevir; bu, anlamı netleştirmenin en hızlı yoludur.

nodes.title: Dönüşüm kalıpları
nodes.description: Restatement'ta yer değiştiren bağlaçlar ve yapı kelimeleri

exercises.question: ---- the medicine is effective, it is too expensive for most patients.
options: Unless
Because of
Although
Despite
So that
exercises.explanation: İki yan arasında karşıtlık vardır (etkili ama pahalı) ve boşluktan sonra tam bir cümle gelir; doğru şık 'Although'. 'Despite' ve 'Because of' isim ya da -ing ister, cümle almaz; 'Unless' koşul bildirir ve anlamı bozar.

exercises.question: The museum will close ---- it receives additional funding this year.
options: despite
although
so that
whereas
unless
exercises.explanation: Müze ek fon 'almazsa' kapanacaktır; 'unless' = 'if ... not'. Doğru şık 'unless'. 'Although' fon alındığı hâlde kapanacağını söyler ve mantıksızdır; 'despite' ise cümle almaz.

exercises.text: ___ the heavy rain, the match went ahead as planned.
exercises.translation: Şiddetli yağmura rağmen maç planlandığı gibi oynandı.

exercises.question: Northern regions receive plenty of rain, ---- southern regions suffer from frequent droughts.
options: whereas
because
unless
so that
provided
exercises.explanation: İki bölge karşılaştırılıyor: kuzey bol yağmur alır, güney kuraklık yaşar. Karşılaştırmalı karşıtlık bildiren 'whereas' doğrudur. 'Because' neden-sonuç kurar, oysa kuzeyin yağmuru güneyin kuraklığının nedeni değildir.

exercises.question: ---- having the best equipment, the team failed to complete the expedition.
options: Although
Because
Unless
In spite of
Whereas
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonra '-ing' (having) gelir ve en iyi ekipmana sahip olmakla başarısız olmak arasında karşıtlık vardır; 'In spite of' hem anlam hem yapı olarak uyar. 'Although' anlamca uygun olsa da tam cümle ister (although they had).

exercises.question: Participants may leave the study at any time ---- they inform the researchers in advance.
options: despite
provided that
whereas
even though
so as to
exercises.explanation: Katılımcılar araştırmacılara önceden haber vermek 'şartıyla' çalışmadan ayrılabilir; 'provided that' koşul bildirir. 'Even though' karşıtlık kurar ve haber vermeyi bir engel gibi gösterir; 'so as to' ise fiil ister, cümle almaz.

exercises.text: The trial will continue ___ no serious side effects are reported.
exercises.translation: Ciddi bir yan etki bildirilmediği sürece deneme devam edecek.

exercises.question: Scarcely ---- the lecture begun when the fire alarm went off.
options: did
was
has
does
had
exercises.explanation: 'Scarcely ... when' devrik yapısı past perfect ister: 'Scarcely had the lecture begun when...' (ders başlar başlamaz). 'Begun' üçüncü hâl olduğu için yardımcı fiil 'had' olmalıdır; 'did' yalın fiil ister.

exercises.question: Not only ---- the new method cheaper, but it is also more accurate.
options: it is
does
is
has
was being
exercises.explanation: 'Not only' cümle başında devrik yapı ister: yardımcı fiil özneden önce gelir, 'Not only is the new method cheaper'. 'It is' düz sıradır ve devrik yapıya uymaz; 'does' ise sıfat (cheaper) ile kullanılamaz.

nodes.title: Zaman, olumsuzluk, bağlaç
nodes.description: Zaman ve olumsuzluğu koruma; although ↔ despite, unless ↔ if…not dönüşümleri

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The museum has not been open to the public since the earthquake damaged its roof in 2019.
options: The museum was closed in 2019, but it reopened shortly after the earthquake.
The museum's roof was damaged in 2019, although the building itself remained open to the public throughout.
The museum has been closed to the public ever since its roof was damaged by the earthquake in 2019.
Before the earthquake in 2019, the museum had never been open to the public.
The museum will reopen to the public as soon as its roof is repaired.
exercises.explanation: 'has not been open since' = 2019'dan beri (hâlâ) kapalı; 'has been closed ever since' aynı süreği anlatır, doğru cevap 'has been closed to the public ever since'. 'it reopened shortly after' diyen şık müzenin yeniden açıldığını söyleyerek zamanı bozar; 'will reopen ... as soon as' diyen şık ise kök cümlede olmayan bir gelecek bilgisi ekler.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Not all of the participants completed the questionnaire.
options: Some of the participants did not complete the questionnaire.
None of the participants completed the questionnaire.
All of the participants completed the questionnaire.
Only one participant failed to complete the questionnaire in the given time.
The questionnaire was too long for most participants.
exercises.explanation: 'Not all' = hepsi değil, yani bazıları tamamlamadı; doğru cevap 'Some of the participants did not complete'. 'None of the participants' diyen şık olumsuzluğu abartır; 'Only one participant' diyen şık ise kök cümlede olmayan kesin bir sayı verir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

By the time the rescue team arrived, the fire had already destroyed most of the forest.
options: The rescue team arrived early enough to save most of the forest.
The fire started to destroy the forest only after the rescue team had arrived at the scene.
The rescue team destroyed most of the forest in order to stop the fire.
The fire would have destroyed the forest if the rescue team had not arrived.
Most of the forest had been destroyed by the fire before the rescue team got there.
exercises.explanation: 'By the time' + past perfect, ekip gelmeden önce yangının ormanın çoğunu yok ettiğini anlatır; edilgen yapıyla aynı sırayı koruyan 'Most of the forest had been destroyed by the fire' doğrudur. 'only after the rescue team had arrived' diyen şık olayların sırasını ters çevirir; 'early enough to save most of the forest' diyen şık ise ormanın kurtarıldığını söyleyerek sonucu değiştirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The new drug is hardly ever prescribed to children.
options: The new drug is prescribed to children more often than to adults.
Doctors very rarely prescribe the new drug to children.
The new drug is never prescribed to adults.
Children find it hard to take the new drug.
The new drug is prescribed to children only in hospital.
exercises.explanation: 'hardly ever' = neredeyse hiç, çok nadiren; doğru cevap 'Doctors very rarely prescribe'. 'Children find it hard' diyen şık 'hardly' kelimesini 'hard' (zor) ile karıştıran adayları hedefleyen tipik bir tuzaktır; 'never prescribed to adults' diyen şık ise yetişkinlerden söz ederek konuyu değiştirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Although the experiment was carefully designed, its results could not be replicated.
options: Because the experiment was carefully designed, its results were easy to replicate.
The experiment's results could not be replicated, so it must have been poorly designed.
If the experiment had been carefully designed, its results could have been replicated.
Despite the careful design of the experiment, its results could not be replicated.
The results of the experiment were replicated despite its poor design.
exercises.explanation: 'Although + cümle' karşıtlığı 'Despite + isim öbeği' ile aynen korunur: 'Despite the careful design'. Doğru cevap bu ifadeyle başlayan cümledir. 'Because the experiment was carefully designed' diyen şık karşıtlığı nedene çevirir; 'If the experiment had been carefully designed' diyen şık ise koşul yapısıyla deneyin dikkatli tasarlanmadığını ima eder, oysa kök cümlede dikkatli tasarlanmıştır.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Unless the government increases funding, many rural clinics will have to close.
options: Many rural clinics will have to close even if the government increases its funding next year.
If the government does not increase funding, many rural clinics will have to close.
The government will increase funding because many rural clinics have closed.
Many rural clinics have closed although the government increased funding.
The government will not increase funding unless rural clinics close.
exercises.explanation: 'Unless' = 'if ... not'; 'Unless the government increases' = 'If the government does not increase'. Doğru cevap 'If the government does not increase funding'. 'even if the government increases its funding' diyen şık fonun hiçbir şeyi değiştirmeyeceğini söyler; 'will not increase funding unless rural clinics close' diyen şık ise koşulu ters yöne çevirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Due to heavy snowfall, all flights from the city's airport were cancelled yesterday.
options: Heavy snow started to fall after all flights from the city's airport had been cancelled yesterday.
Although it snowed heavily, all flights departed on time yesterday.
The airport was closed yesterday, so it began to snow heavily.
Some flights were cancelled yesterday despite the light snowfall.
All flights from the city's airport were cancelled yesterday because it snowed heavily.
exercises.explanation: 'Due to + isim' neden bildirir ve 'because + cümle' ile aynı anlamı verir; doğru cevap 'were cancelled yesterday because it snowed heavily'. 'Although it snowed heavily' diyen şık neden ilişkisini karşıtlığa çevirir; 'so it began to snow heavily' diyen şık neden ile sonucu yer değiştirir; 'Some flights were cancelled' diyen şık ise 'all' yerine 'some' diyerek miktarı değiştirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Volunteers can take part in the study provided that they have no history of heart disease.
options: Volunteers can take part in the study as long as they have never had heart disease.
Volunteers with a history of heart disease are especially welcome to take part in the study.
The study aims to find out whether the volunteers have heart disease.
None of the volunteers can take part in the study because of heart disease.
Volunteers will develop heart disease if they take part in the study.
exercises.explanation: 'provided that' ve 'as long as' ikisi de 'şartıyla' anlamına gelir; 'have no history of' = 'have never had'. Doğru cevap 'as long as they have never had heart disease'. 'especially welcome' diyen şık şartı tersine çevirir; 'aims to find out whether' diyen şık ise çalışmanın amacını uydurur, kök cümlede amaç değil katılım şartı vardır.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Whereas urban populations are growing rapidly, many rural villages are losing residents.
options: Rural villages are growing more rapidly than urban populations in most parts of the country.
Because cities are growing, rural villages are also growing.
Many people are moving from cities to rural villages.
Urban populations are increasing quickly, while many rural villages are becoming smaller.
Both urban and rural populations are declining.
exercises.explanation: 'Whereas' iki durumu karşılaştırır: şehirler büyüyor, köyler nüfus kaybediyor. 'while' aynı karşılaştırmayı kurar ve 'losing residents' = 'becoming smaller'; doğru cevap 'while many rural villages are becoming smaller'. 'Rural villages are growing more rapidly' diyen şık karşılaştırmayı ters çevirir; 'moving from cities to rural villages' diyen şık ise göçün yönünü tersine çevirerek yeni ve yanlış bir bilgi ekler.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The instructions were so complicated that most users gave up before finishing the installation.
options: Most users finished the installation easily because the instructions were clear.
The instructions were complicated, but most users managed to finish the installation.
Because the instructions were extremely complex, most users stopped before completing the installation.
Most users ignored the instructions and asked for help with the installation.
The installation was so simple that the instructions were unnecessary.
exercises.explanation: 'so ... that' neden-sonuç bildirir: talimatlar çok karmaşık olduğu için kullanıcılar bıraktı. 'Because ... extremely complex' aynı ilişkiyi kurar ve 'gave up' = 'stopped'; doğru cevap 'most users stopped before completing'. 'but most users managed to finish' diyen şık sonucu tersine çevirir; 'asked for help' diyen şık ise yardım istemek gibi yeni bir bilgi ekler.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

As soon as the results were announced, the company's share price rose sharply.
options: The company's share price rose sharply immediately after the results were announced.
The results were announced because the company's share price had risen.
The company's share price fell when the results were announced.
The share price rose gradually in the weeks before the company's results were officially announced.
Although the results were announced, the share price did not change.
exercises.explanation: 'As soon as' = -ir -mez; 'immediately after' aynı zaman ilişkisini verir ve 'rose sharply' korunur, doğru cevap 'rose sharply immediately after the results were announced'. 'rose gradually in the weeks before' diyen şık hem zamanı (önce) hem hızı (gradually) değiştirir; 'were announced because ... had risen' diyen şık ise zaman ilişkisini neden ilişkisine çevirir ve yönü tersine döndürür.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Even if the bridge is repaired by the end of the year, heavy lorries will not be allowed to use it.
options: Heavy lorries will be allowed to use the bridge once it has been repaired.
Whether or not the bridge is repaired by the end of the year, heavy lorries will not be permitted on it.
The bridge cannot be repaired by the end of the year because of heavy lorries.
If heavy lorries stop using the bridge, it will be repaired by the end of the year.
The bridge will only be repaired if heavy lorries are banned from it.
exercises.explanation: 'Even if' (-se bile), onarımın sonucu değiştirmeyeceğini anlatır; 'Whether or not' (olsa da olmasa da) aynı anlamı verir, 'allowed' = 'permitted'. Doğru cevap 'Whether or not the bridge is repaired'. 'will be allowed ... once it has been repaired' diyen şık sonucu tersine çevirir; 'If heavy lorries stop using the bridge' ve 'only be repaired if heavy lorries are banned' diyen şıklar ise koşulu yasakla onarım arasında yanlış bir yöne bağlar.

nodes.title: Karşılaştırma, edilgen, devrik
nodes.description: as…as, the more…the more, edilgen yapılar ve devrik cümlelerle restatement

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

No other mineral in the region is as valuable as the one discovered last year.
options: Several minerals in the region are more valuable than the one discovered last year.
The mineral discovered last year is as common as the other minerals in the region.
A mineral was discovered last year that is less valuable than others in the region.
The mineral discovered last year is more valuable than any other in the region.
No valuable minerals have been discovered in the region since last year.
exercises.explanation: 'No other ... as valuable as' = başka hiçbiri onun kadar değerli değil, yani en değerlisi odur. 'more valuable than any other' aynı üstünlüğü verir ve doğru cevaptır. 'Several minerals ... are more valuable' ve 'less valuable than others' diyen şıklar karşılaştırmayı tersine çevirir; 'as common as' diyen şık ise 'valuable' yerine 'common' diyerek niteliği değiştirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The vaccine is believed to have saved thousands of lives during the outbreak.
options: The vaccine will save thousands of lives in future outbreaks.
People believe that the vaccine saved thousands of lives during the outbreak.
Thousands of people believed in the vaccine during the outbreak.
It is believed that thousands of lives were lost despite the vaccine.
The vaccine was developed after thousands of people had died in the outbreak.
exercises.explanation: 'is believed to have saved' = kurtardığına inanılıyor (geçmişteki bir eylem, şimdiki inanç); 'People believe that the vaccine saved' aynı anlamı etken yapıyla verir ve doğru cevaptır. 'The vaccine will save' diyen şık zamanı geleceğe taşır; 'believed in the vaccine' diyen şık 'believe in' ile inananları değiştirir; 'lives were lost despite the vaccine' diyen şık sonucu tersine çevirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Not until the 1990s did scientists realise how quickly the ice sheet was melting.
options: Scientists realised in the 1990s that the ice sheet had stopped melting.
Well before the 1990s, scientists already knew exactly how fast the ice sheet was melting.
The ice sheet started to melt quickly only in the 1990s.
Scientists in the 1990s refused to believe that the ice sheet was melting.
It was only in the 1990s that scientists understood how fast the ice sheet was melting.
exercises.explanation: 'Not until X did Y' = Y ancak X'te oldu; bilim insanları erimenin hızını ancak 1990'larda fark etti. 'It was only in the 1990s that' aynı vurguyu verir ve doğru cevaptır. 'scientists already knew exactly' diyen şık tam tersini söyler; 'started to melt quickly only in the 1990s' diyen şık ise fark etme zamanını erimenin başlama zamanına çevirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The longer patients wait for treatment, the less likely they are to make a full recovery.
options: Patients who receive treatment sooner have a better chance of recovering fully.
Patients recover fully no matter how long they have to wait before receiving treatment.
The longer the treatment lasts, the better patients recover.
Patients who recover fully usually wait longer for treatment.
Waiting for treatment has little effect on whether patients recover.
exercises.explanation: 'the longer ..., the less likely' orantısı: bekleme uzadıkça tam iyileşme olasılığı düşer; tersinden söylenince erken tedavi edilenlerin şansı daha yüksektir, doğru cevap 'Patients who receive treatment sooner'. 'The longer the treatment lasts' diyen şık bekleme süresini tedavi süresine çevirir; 'usually wait longer' diyen şık ilişkiyi tersine çevirir; 'no matter how long' ve 'has little effect' diyen şıklar ilişkiyi yok sayar.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The researchers had their findings checked by an independent laboratory before publication.
options: The researchers checked the findings of an independent laboratory before publishing them.
An independent laboratory published the researchers' findings without checking them.
Before the findings were published, the researchers arranged for an independent laboratory to check them.
The independent laboratory refused to check the findings before publication.
The findings were published before an independent laboratory could check them.
exercises.explanation: 'have something done' ettirgen yapıdır: araştırmacılar bulgularını bağımsız bir laboratuvara kontrol ettirdi. 'arranged for an independent laboratory to check them' aynı anlamı verir ve doğru cevaptır. 'The researchers checked the findings of an independent laboratory' diyen şık işi yapanı değiştirir; 'published before an independent laboratory could check them' diyen şık ise zaman sırasını ters çevirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Had the warning been issued earlier, more residents could have left the area before the flood.
options: Residents left the area early because the warning was issued in time.
More residents left the area than expected, although the warning was late.
The flood happened before the warning was issued, so nobody left the area.
If more residents had left the area, the warning would have been issued earlier.
Because the warning was not issued earlier, fewer residents were able to leave the area before the flood.
exercises.explanation: 'Had the warning been issued earlier' devrik üçüncü tip koşuldur ve gerçeğin tersini anlatır: uyarı geç verildi, bu yüzden daha az kişi ayrılabildi. Doğru cevap 'Because the warning was not issued earlier, fewer residents…'. 'the warning was issued in time' diyen şık uyarının zamanında verildiğini söyler; 'so nobody left the area' diyen şık 'nobody' diyerek abartır; 'If more residents had left…' diye başlayan şık koşul ile sonucu yer değiştirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Solar panels are not as efficient in cloudy regions as they are in sunny ones.
options: Solar panels work less efficiently in cloudy regions than in sunny regions.
Solar panels are equally efficient in all regions.
Sunny regions have fewer solar panels than cloudy regions.
Solar panels are more efficient in cloudy regions because they do not overheat.
Solar panels cannot be used in cloudy regions at all.
exercises.explanation: 'not as efficient as' = daha az verimli; 'less efficiently than' aynı karşılaştırmayı verir, doğru cevap 'Solar panels work less efficiently in cloudy regions'. 'equally efficient in all regions' diyen şık karşılaştırmayı yok eder; 'more efficient in cloudy regions because they do not overheat' diyen şık yönü tersine çevirip neden ekler; 'cannot be used ... at all' diyen şık ise aşırı bir genelleme yapar.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The results of the trial should not have been made public before they were reviewed.
options: The results of the trial were reviewed carefully before being made public.
Nobody should review the results of the trial before they are made public.
The trial results will not be made public until they have been reviewed by independent experts.
It was a mistake to make the trial results public before they had been reviewed.
The trial results were made public, but they did not need to be reviewed.
exercises.explanation: 'should not have been made public' geçmişteki bir hatayı eleştirir: sonuçlar incelenmeden açıklandı ve bu yanlıştı. 'It was a mistake to...' aynı eleştiriyi verir ve doğru cevaptır. 'reviewed carefully before being made public' diyen şık sonuçların incelendiğini söyler; 'will not be made public until…' diyen şık zamanı geleceğe taşır; 'they did not need to be reviewed' diyen şık incelemenin gereksiz olduğunu söyleyerek eleştiriyi yok eder.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Only by reducing emissions dramatically can countries limit the rise in global temperatures.
options: Countries have already limited the rise in temperatures by reducing emissions.
Countries can limit the rise in global temperatures only if they cut emissions dramatically.
Reducing emissions dramatically is just one of many possible ways to limit the rise in global temperatures.
Even if emissions are reduced, global temperatures will continue to rise rapidly.
Global temperatures will rise unless some countries increase their emissions.
exercises.explanation: 'Only by ... can' devrik yapısı tek yolu vurgular: sıcaklık artışı ancak salımlar büyük ölçüde azaltılırsa sınırlanabilir. 'only if they cut emissions dramatically' aynı koşulu verir ve doğru cevaptır. 'one of many possible ways' diyen şık 'only' anlamını yok eder; 'have already limited' diyen şık ise olmuş bir şeyden söz eder.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The new building uses half as much energy as the old one did.
options: The new building uses twice as much energy as the old one did.
The old building used slightly more energy than the new one does.
The old building consumed twice as much energy as the new one does.
Both buildings use the same amount of energy.
The new building produces half of the energy that was used by the old one.
exercises.explanation: 'half as much as' = yarısı kadar; yeni bina eskisinin yarısı kadar enerji kullanıyorsa eskisi yenisinin iki katını kullanıyordu; doğru cevap 'The old building consumed twice as much energy…'. 'The new building uses twice as much' diyen şık oranı ters çevirir; 'slightly more energy' diyen şık farkı küçültür; 'produces half of the energy' diyen şık 'uses' yerine 'produces' diyerek eylemi değiştirir.

nodes.title: Sınav düzeyi
nodes.description: Birden çok dönüşümün birleştiği uzun ve ince ayrımlı restatement soruları

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Contrary to what many economists had predicted, unemployment fell during the recession, albeit only slightly.
options: As many economists had predicted, unemployment rose sharply during the recession.
Although many economists had expected otherwise, unemployment decreased slightly during the recession.
Unemployment fell significantly during the recession, just as most economists had confidently predicted.
Economists predicted that unemployment would fall slightly after the recession.
The recession ended because unemployment fell more than economists had predicted.
exercises.explanation: Kök cümlede üç bileşen var: tahminin tersine (contrary to), işsizlik düştü, ama yalnızca biraz (albeit only slightly). Üçünü de koruyan 'Although many economists had expected otherwise, unemployment decreased slightly' doğrudur. 'fell significantly ..., just as most economists had confidently predicted' diyen şık düşüşü büyütür ve tahminle uyumlu gösterir; 'would fall slightly after the recession' diyen şık ise zamanı değiştirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

It was not until the bridge collapsed that the authorities acknowledged it had been poorly maintained.
options: The authorities had publicly warned that the bridge was poorly maintained long before it finally collapsed.
The bridge collapsed although the authorities had maintained it well.
The authorities maintained the bridge poorly because they did not expect it to collapse.
After the bridge collapsed, the authorities denied that it had been poorly maintained.
Only after the bridge had collapsed did the authorities admit that its maintenance had been inadequate.
exercises.explanation: 'It was not until X that Y' = Y ancak X'ten sonra oldu: yetkililer bakımın kötü olduğunu ancak köprü çöktükten sonra kabul etti. 'Only after ... did ... admit' aynı anlamı verir ve 'poorly maintained' = 'maintenance had been inadequate'; doğru cevap bu yapıyla kurulan cümledir. 'the authorities denied' diyen şık 'acknowledged' yerine 'denied' diyerek anlamı tersine çevirir; 'had publicly warned ... long before it finally collapsed' diyen şık ise kabulü çöküşten önceye taşır.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Few, if any, of the ancient manuscripts have survived in their original form.
options: Hardly any of the ancient manuscripts, and possibly none, have survived in their original form.
Most of the ancient manuscripts have survived, although few are in their original form.
Some of the ancient manuscripts have survived in a changed form, but none in their original form.
Only a few ancient manuscripts were written in their original form.
None of the ancient manuscripts have survived in any form.
exercises.explanation: 'Few, if any' = çok azı, belki de hiçbiri; 'Hardly any ..., and possibly none' aynı belirsizliği korur ve doğru cevaptır. 'survived in a changed form, but none in their original form' diyen şık 'none' diyerek kesinleştirir ve değişmiş nüshalar hakkında yeni bilgi ekler; 'None ... in any form' diyen şık kapsamı genişletir; 'Most of the ancient manuscripts have survived' diyen şık ise kök cümlede olmayan bir bilgi verir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Much as the committee admired the proposal, it could not approve it because of budget constraints.
options: The committee did not approve the proposal because it did not like it.
The committee approved the proposal despite budget constraints.
Because the committee admired the proposal, it found extra money to approve it.
Although the committee thought highly of the proposal, budget limits prevented it from approving it.
The committee admired the proposal mainly because it was cheap.
exercises.explanation: 'Much as' = 'although' (her ne kadar ... -se de): komite öneriyi beğendi ama bütçe yüzünden onaylayamadı. 'Although the committee thought highly of the proposal, budget limits prevented it' bu karşıtlığı ve nedeni korur. 'because it did not like it' diyen şık ret nedenini beğenmemeye bağlar; 'approved the proposal despite budget constraints' ve 'found extra money to approve it' diyen şıklar öneriyi onaylanmış gösterir; 'mainly because it was cheap' diyen şık ise yeni ve çelişkili bir neden ekler.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The fossils are thought to be at least 200,000 years older than any previously found in the region.
options: The fossils found in the region are thought to be exactly 200,000 years old.
Researchers think that the fossils are slightly younger than those found earlier in the region.
The fossils are believed to be older than all those previously discovered in the region by a minimum of 200,000 years.
The fossils were found in the region about 200,000 years ago.
Older fossils than these have previously been found in the region.
exercises.explanation: Kök cümle fosillerin bölgede daha önce bulunan tüm fosillerden en az 200.000 yıl daha yaşlı olduğunun düşünüldüğünü söyler; 'at least' = 'by a minimum of', 'any previously found' = 'all those previously discovered'. Doğru cevap bu ifadeleri içeren cümledir. 'exactly 200,000 years old' diyen şık yaş farkını mutlak yaşa çevirir; 'slightly younger' ve 'Older fossils than these' diyen şıklar karşılaştırmayı tersine çevirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Were it not for the support of local volunteers, the festival would have been cancelled long ago.
options: The festival has survived only because local volunteers have supported it.
The festival was cancelled long ago despite the support of local volunteers.
Local volunteers want the festival to be cancelled.
If the festival is cancelled, local volunteers will stop supporting it.
The festival would continue even without the support of local volunteers.
exercises.explanation: 'Were it not for X' = X olmasaydı; gönüllüler olmasaydı festival çoktan iptal edilmişti, yani festival gönüllüler sayesinde sürüyor. Doğru cevap 'has survived only because local volunteers have supported it'. 'was cancelled long ago' diyen şık festivalin iptal edildiğini söyleyerek gerçeği ters çevirir; 'would continue even without' diyen şık ise gönüllülerin desteğini önemsiz gösterir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

So rapidly did the disease spread that health officials had little time to prepare.
options: Health officials prepared carefully, so the disease spread slowly.
The disease spread rapidly because health officials did not prepare.
Although the disease spread rapidly, health officials still had plenty of time to prepare for it.
The disease spread so quickly that health officials hardly had any time to get ready.
Health officials prepared for a disease that never actually spread.
exercises.explanation: 'So rapidly did ... that' devrik 'so ... that' yapısıdır: hastalık o kadar hızlı yayıldı ki yetkililerin hazırlanmaya çok az vakti oldu. 'The disease spread so quickly that…' aynı neden-sonucu düz sırayla verir ve 'little time' = 'hardly any time'. 'because health officials did not prepare' diyen şık neden ile sonucu yer değiştirir; 'plenty of time' diyen şık sonucu tersine çevirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The study found no evidence that the supplement improves memory, nor did it find any harmful effects.
options: The study showed that the supplement improves memory without any harmful effects.
The study found neither evidence of improved memory nor any harmful effects from the supplement.
The study found that the supplement damages memory.
Although the supplement improves memory, it has some harmful effects.
The study could not be completed because of the supplement's harmful effects.
exercises.explanation: 'no evidence ..., nor did it find' iki olumsuzluğu birleştirir: ne bellek gelişimine kanıt ne de zararlı etki bulundu. 'neither ... nor' aynı yapıyı korur ve doğru cevaptır. 'improves memory without any harmful effects' diyen şık belleğin geliştiğini söyleyerek ilk olumsuzluğu kaldırır; 'Although the supplement improves memory, it has some harmful effects' diyen şık ise ikisini de tersine çevirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Scarcely had the researchers installed the sensors when a storm destroyed them.
options: The researchers installed the sensors after the storm had passed.
The storm was so weak that the sensors survived it.
The researchers rarely installed sensors during storms.
The sensors were destroyed by the storm before the researchers could install them properly.
A storm destroyed the sensors very soon after the researchers had installed them.
exercises.explanation: 'Scarcely had ... when' = tam ... -mişlerdi ki: algılayıcılar kurulur kurulmaz fırtına onları yok etti. Doğru cevap 'very soon after the researchers had installed them'. 'rarely installed sensors' diyen şık 'scarcely' kelimesini 'rarely' (nadiren) anlamında yorumlayan bir tuzaktır; 'destroyed by the storm before the researchers could install them' diyen şık ise olayların sırasını ters çevirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Whether the policy succeeds will depend less on its design than on how consistently it is implemented.
options: The policy's design will be more important than its implementation.
The policy will succeed regardless of how it is implemented.
Consistent implementation will matter more for the policy's success than its design will.
The policy has already been designed and implemented consistently.
The policy will fail because it was poorly designed.
exercises.explanation: 'depend less on X than on Y' = başarı X'ten çok Y'ye bağlı olacak; yani tutarlı uygulama tasarımdan daha önemlidir. Doğru cevap 'Consistent implementation will matter more'. 'design will be more important than its implementation' diyen şık karşılaştırmayı tersine çevirir; 'regardless of how it is implemented' diyen şık uygulamanın etkisini yok sayar; 'will fail because it was poorly designed' diyen şık ise kök cümlede olmayan bir başarısızlık öngörüsü ekler.

nodes.title: Ünite testi
nodes.description: 17 soruluk ünite testi; geçmek için %80 doğru yap

exercises.question: The new regional development policy is intended to ---- the gap between rich and poor provinces.
options: narrow
resign
postpone
imitate
betray
exercises.explanation: Bir kalkınma politikasının amacı zengin ve yoksul iller arasındaki farkı 'daraltmaktır'; 'narrow the gap' kalıplaşmış bir ifadedir. 'Postpone' (ertelemek) ve 'imitate' (taklit etmek) 'the gap' ile anlamlı bir öbek kurmaz.

exercises.question: The bridge, ---- in 1890, is still used by thousands of commuters every day.
options: which built
was built
building
built
has been built
exercises.explanation: Virgüller arasındaki bölüm kısaltılmış bir edilgen sıfat cümlesidir: 'which was built in 1890' → 'built in 1890'. Doğru şık 'built'. 'Which built' etken anlam verir (köprü bir şey inşa etti); 'was built' ise cümlede ikinci bir yüklem oluşturur.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The library will remain closed until the renovation work is completed.
options: The library is open while the renovation work continues.
The library was closed after the renovation work had been completed.
The library will not reopen before the renovation work is finished.
The renovation work will start as soon as the library closes.
The library may close if the renovation work is not completed.
exercises.explanation: 'remain closed until' = tamamlanana kadar kapalı kalacak, yani tamamlanmadan açılmayacak; doğru cevap 'will not reopen before the renovation work is finished'. 'was closed after the renovation work had been completed' diyen şık kapanmayı yenilemeden sonraya taşır; 'may close if' diyen şık ise kesin bir durumu olasılığa (may) ve koşula çevirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Neither the manager nor her assistant attended the meeting.
options: The manager attended the meeting, but her assistant did not come with her.
Either the manager or her assistant attended the meeting.
The assistant attended the meeting in place of the manager.
Only the manager's assistant was absent from the meeting.
Both the manager and her assistant were absent from the meeting.
exercises.explanation: 'Neither ... nor' iki kişiyi birden olumsuzlar: ne yönetici ne asistanı katıldı, yani ikisi de yoktu. Doğru cevap 'Both the manager and her assistant were absent'. 'The manager attended the meeting' ve 'in place of the manager' diyen şıklar birinin katıldığını söyler; 'Either the manager or her assistant' diyen şık birinin katıldığını ima ederek olumsuzluğu kaldırır.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

In spite of the rain, thousands of people attended the open-air concert.
options: Because it was raining, thousands of people stayed away from the concert.
Even though it was raining, thousands of people went to the open-air concert.
The open-air concert was cancelled because of the rain.
Thousands of people would have attended the open-air concert if it had not rained.
The rain started after thousands of people had left the concert.
exercises.explanation: 'In spite of + isim' karşıtlığı 'Even though + cümle' ile korunur; doğru cevap 'Even though it was raining, thousands of people went…'. 'Because it was raining…' diye başlayan şık karşıtlığı nedene çevirir ve sonucu tersine döndürür; 'would have attended … if it had not rained' diyen şık koşul yapısıyla insanların gelmediğini ima eder.

exercises.question: Many patients stop taking their antibiotics too early ----.
options: because they start to feel better after a few days
unless they had felt better
so that they had been cured
as if they will never be ill again in the rest of their lives
despite of feeling better
exercises.explanation: İlacı erken bırakmanın en mantıklı nedeni birkaç gün sonra kendini iyi hissetmektir; doğru cevap 'because they start to feel better after a few days'. 'unless they had felt better' ve 'so that they had been cured' zaman uyumsuzluğu taşır (geniş zamanlı ana cümleye past perfect); 'despite of feeling better' dilbilgisel olarak hatalıdır, çünkü 'despite' 'of' almaz.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The report must be submitted no later than Friday.
options: The report can be submitted at any time after Friday.
The report was submitted late last Friday.
Friday is the earliest day on which the report may be submitted.
Friday is the last day on which the report can be submitted.
The report does not have to be submitted until next week.
exercises.explanation: 'no later than Friday' = en geç cuma; yani cuma son teslim günüdür, doğru cevap 'Friday is the last day'. 'Friday is the earliest day' diyen şık anlamı tersine çevirir; 'at any time after Friday' ve 'not ... until next week' diyen şıklar son tarihi cumadan sonraya taşır.

exercises.passage:
Derya: I've been offered a research position in Canada, but it starts in two weeks.
Tom: ----
Derya: That's what worries me. I haven't even applied for a visa yet.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Canada is one of the largest countries in the world.
I've never been to Canada either.
That's great news, but isn't that rather soon?
Will you be teaching any courses there?
Congratulations! You must have worked hard for it.
exercises.explanation: Derya'nın 'That's what worries me' cevabı, Tom'un bir endişeyi dile getirdiğini, 'haven't applied for a visa yet' ise bu endişenin sürenin kısalığı olduğunu gösterir; doğru cevap 'isn't that rather soon?'.
