'Congratulations! You must have worked hard' de olumlu bir tepkidir ama bir endişe içermediği için 'That's what worries me' cevabına uymaz.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

It is estimated that the population of the city will double within twenty years.
options: The city's population is expected to be twice its current size in twenty years.
The population of the city doubled over the last twenty years.
The city's population will probably fall by half within twenty years.
It took twenty years to estimate the population of the city.
Experts are certain that the city will have twice as many people in twenty years.
exercises.explanation: 'It is estimated that ... will double' = iki katına çıkacağı tahmin ediliyor; 'is expected to be twice its current size' aynı tahmini verir ve doğru cevaptır. 'doubled over the last twenty years' diyen şık zamanı geçmişe taşır; 'fall by half' diyen şık oranı tersine çevirir; 'Experts are certain' diyen şık 'certain' diyerek tahmini kesinliğe dönüştürür.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The more carefully the data are collected, the more reliable the conclusions will be.
options: Reliable conclusions make data collection easier.
Data collection is less important than drawing conclusions.
The conclusions will be reliable however the data are collected.
Careless data collection is the only reason for unreliable conclusions.
Careful data collection leads to more reliable conclusions.
exercises.explanation: 'the more ..., the more' orantısı: veri ne kadar dikkatli toplanırsa sonuçlar o kadar güvenilir olur; 'Careful data collection leads to more reliable conclusions' bu ilişkiyi korur. 'Reliable conclusions make data collection easier' neden ile sonucu yer değiştirir; 'however the data are collected' diyen şık ilişkiyi yok sayar; 'the only reason' diyen şık aşırı bir genelleme yapar.

exercises.passage: Traditional maps of the ocean floor were produced by ships measuring depth with sound waves, a slow process that has covered only a small fraction of the seabed. ---- By measuring tiny variations in the height of the sea surface, which reflect the shape of the ground below, satellites can map large areas in a matter of weeks. Their images are less detailed than those produced by ships, but they cover regions that no vessel has ever visited. By combining the two methods, researchers hope to produce a complete map of the seabed within the next decade.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Sound waves travel faster in water than they do in air.
Satellite technology now offers a much faster alternative.
Ships are still the only way to measure the depth of the ocean.
Many sailors have been lost at sea over the centuries.
As a result, most of the seabed has now been mapped in great detail.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan önce gemilerle yapılan yavaş yöntem, sonra uydu ölçümleri anlatılır; araya uyduları hızlı bir alternatif olarak tanıtan 'Satellite technology now offers a much faster alternative' girmelidir. 'Ships are still the only way' diyen şık sonraki uydu cümlesiyle çelişir; 'most of the seabed has now been mapped' diyen şık ise ilk cümledeki 'only a small fraction' bilgisiyle çelişir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Under no circumstances should patients stop taking the medication without consulting their doctor.
options: Patients may stop the medication whenever they feel better.
Doctors should never prescribe this medication without consulting patients.
Patients should consult their doctor only if the medication has serious or unexpected side effects.
Patients must never stop their medication unless they have first consulted their doctor.
In some circumstances, patients can stop the medication on their own.
exercises.explanation: 'Under no circumstances should' = hiçbir koşulda ... -memeli; doktora danışmadan ilacı bırakmak kesinlikle yasaktır. 'must never ... unless they have first consulted' aynı yasağı verir ve doğru cevaptır. 'can stop the medication on their own' diyen şık yasağı kısmen kaldırır; 'Doctors should never prescribe ... without consulting patients' diyen şık ise kimin kime danışacağını tersine çevirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The professor, who rarely praises anyone, described Derya's thesis as outstanding.
options: The professor often praises her students, so she naturally called Derya's thesis outstanding.
Derya rarely receives praise because her thesis was not outstanding.
Even though she seldom praises anyone, the professor called Derya's thesis outstanding.
The professor did not praise Derya's thesis, although it was outstanding.
Derya described the professor's thesis as outstanding.
exercises.explanation: Kök cümlede örtük bir karşıtlık vardır: nadiren öven profesör tezi olağanüstü buldu. 'Even though she seldom praises anyone' bu karşıtlığı açıkça kurar ve 'rarely' = 'seldom'; doğru cevap bu ifadeyle başlayan cümledir. 'often praises her students' diyen şık bilgiyi tersine çevirir; 'did not praise Derya's thesis' diyen şık övgüyü ortadan kaldırır; 'Derya described the professor's thesis' diyen şık ise kimin kimi övdüğünü değiştirir.

exercises.passage: (I) Honeybees communicate the location of food sources through a series of movements known as the waggle dance. (II) The angle of the dance relative to the vertical indicates the direction of the food in relation to the sun. (III) The duration of each waggle run, meanwhile, tells other bees how far away the food is. (IV) Bees that observe these dances tend to find food more quickly than those that search on their own. (V) Honey has been used as a natural sweetener by many cultures for thousands of years.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: Paragraf arıların 'sallanma dansı' ile yiyecek kaynağının yerini nasıl ilettiğini anlatır: yön (II), uzaklık (III) ve dansın yararı (IV). V. cümle ise balın insanlar tarafından tatlandırıcı olarak kullanımına geçer ve iletişim konusundan kopar; doğru cevap V.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Had it not been for the new irrigation system, the harvest would have failed during the drought.
options: The harvest survived the drought thanks to the new irrigation system.
The harvest failed during the drought despite the new irrigation system.
The new irrigation system was installed because the harvest had failed.
If there is another drought, the new irrigation system will fail.
The drought was caused by the new irrigation system.
exercises.explanation: 'Had it not been for X' = X olmasaydı; sulama sistemi olmasaydı hasat başarısız olacaktı, demek ki sistem sayesinde hasat kurtuldu. Doğru cevap 'survived the drought thanks to the new irrigation system'. 'failed during the drought' diyen şık gerçeği tersine çevirir; 'installed because the harvest had failed' diyen şık neden-sonucu değiştirir; 'If there is another drought' diyen şık ise zamanı geleceğe taşır.

exercises.passage: In the mountain village of Edrin, a cooperative of 40 families began producing cheese from goat's milk in 2015. At first, it sold its products only at the weekly market in the nearest town. Sales rose sharply after 2019, when the cooperative opened an online shop and started delivering to customers in three major cities. Today, nearly 70 percent of its income comes from online orders, and the cooperative employs eight young people who had previously planned to move away from the village.
exercises.question: According to the passage, the cooperative's sales increased significantly after it ----.
options: moved its business to the nearest town
began selling its products online
started producing cheese from cow's milk
was joined by forty more families
closed its stall at the weekly market
exercises.explanation: 'Sales rose sharply after 2019, when the cooperative opened an online shop' cümlesi satış artışını çevrim içi mağazaya bağlar; doğru cevap 'began selling its products online'. 'moved its business to the nearest town' yanlıştır, kooperatif yalnızca o kasabadaki pazarda satış yapıyordu; 'closed its stall at the weekly market' ise metinde hiç geçmez.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The proposal was rejected not so much because it was expensive as because it lacked a clear timetable.
options: The proposal was rejected only because it was too expensive.
The proposal was accepted although it had no clear timetable.
Both its cost and its timetable were equally important reasons for rejecting the proposal.
The main reason the proposal was rejected was the absence of a clear timetable rather than its cost.
The proposal had a clear timetable, but it was rejected because of its cost.
exercises.explanation: 'not so much because X as because Y' = X'ten çok Y yüzünden; asıl neden net bir takvimin olmamasıdır. Doğru cevap 'the absence of a clear timetable rather than its cost'. 'only because it was too expensive' ve 'rejected because of its cost' diyen şıklar asıl nedeni maliyete kaydırır; 'equally important reasons' diyen şık iki nedeni eşit sayarak 'not so much ... as' karşılaştırmasını yok eder.

nodes.title: Ünite ödülü
nodes.description: Üniteyi bitir, bonus XP kazan

units.title: Paragraf tamamlama
units.description: Paragraftaki boşluğa akışı bozmayan cümleyi yerleştirme
units.guide:
## Strateji
Paragraf tamamlama sorularında 80–150 kelimelik bir paragrafın bir cümlesi çıkarılmış ve yerine ---- konmuştur. Boşluk **başta** (konu cümlesi), **ortada** (bağlantı cümlesi) veya **sonda** (sonuç cümlesi) olabilir. Doğru şık hem paragrafın **konusuna** uymalı hem de boşluğun **önündeki ve arkasındaki** cümlelerle mantıksal ve dilbilgisel olarak bağlanmalıdır. ÖSYM'nin çeldiricileri genellikle konuyla ilgili ama akışı bozan cümlelerdir: paragraftaki bir kelimeyi tekrar eden, bir bilgiyle çelişen ya da konuyu başka yöne çeviren cümleler. Bu yüzden şıkları tek başına 'doğru mu' diye değil, 'buraya oturuyor mu' diye değerlendirmek gerekir.

## Örnekler
- *However, the results were later shown to be wrong.* — Ancak sonuçların daha sonra yanlış olduğu gösterildi. (önceki cümleye karşıtlık ekler)
- *As a result, many farmers returned to the old variety.* — Bunun sonucunda birçok çiftçi eski çeşide geri döndü. (sonuç cümlesi)
- *Sea turtles, for instance, crawl inland on lit beaches.* — Örneğin deniz kaplumbağaları ışıklı kumsallarda karaya doğru sürünür. (örnekleme)
- *Instead, evidence points to a long drought.* — Bunun yerine kanıtlar uzun bir kuraklığı işaret ediyor. (*Instead* öncesinde reddedilen bir görüş olmalı)
- *This is achieved through natural ventilation.* — Bu, doğal havalandırmayla sağlanır. (*This* önceki cümledeki olguyu gösterir)

## Nasıl çözülür
1. Boşluğun **yerini** belirle. Başta ise genel bir konu cümlesi, sonda ise sonuç/özet/öneri, ortada ise iki cümleyi bağlayan bir köprü ara.
2. Paragrafı boşluğu atlayarak oku ve **ana konuyu** tek cümleyle özetle.
3. Boşluğun **hemen önündeki** ve **hemen arkasındaki** cümlelere odaklan. Arkadaki cümlede *Instead, For example, This, They, However, As a result* gibi bir bağlaç ya da zamir varsa, boşluk bu kelimenin göndermesini karşılamalıdır.
4. Şıklardaki bağlaçları kontrol et: *However* karşıtlık, *Therefore / As a result* sonuç, *Moreover / In addition* ekleme, *For instance* örnek ister. Bağlaç önceki cümleyle uyuşmuyorsa şıkkı ele.
5. Konudan sapan, paragraftaki bir bilgiyle çelişen ve yalnızca bir anahtar kelimeyi tekrar eden şıkları ele; kalan şıkkı boşluğa koyup paragrafı baştan sona tekrar oku.

**Örnek çözüm:** *Octopuses can match the colour of rocks within a second. ---- Instead, scientists believe they detect light directly through their skin.*
Adım 1: Boşluk ortada, köprü cümlesi gerekiyor. Adım 3: Arkadaki cümle *Instead* ile başlıyor; demek ki boşlukta reddedilen bir varsayım ya da bir engel olmalı. Adım 4–5: *Their eyes allow them to see colours more clearly than humans do* şıkkı *Instead* ile çelişir. *Surprisingly, however, octopuses appear to be colour-blind* hem bir engel sunar hem de *Instead* için zemin hazırlar: doğru cevap budur.

## Tuzaklar ve sık yapılan hatalar
- **Kelime tekrarı tuzağı:** Paragraftaki bir kelimeyi (ör. *sardines, mirrors, bridge*) içeren ama genel bilgi veren cümle (*Sardines are rich in oil*) konuyu ilerletmez.
- **Çelişki tuzağı:** Paragrafın verdiği bilgiyi tersine çeviren şık (*However, the temperature has remained stable*). Özellikle *As a result* ile başlayan çelişkili sonuçlara dikkat et.
- **Zamirin karşılıksız kalması:** Şıkta *This, They, Such* varsa, gösterdiği şey boşluğun önünde bulunmalıdır. Başta boşluk varken *This is why…* ile başlayan şık neredeyse her zaman yanlıştır.
- **Bağlaç körlüğü:** Türkçede bağlaçlar bazen atlanabilir; İngilizce akademik metinde *however, therefore, instead* cümleler arası mantığı taşır. Bağlacın anlamını şıkkı seçmeden önce mutlaka kontrol et.
- **Sonda abartılı sonuç:** Paragraf temkinli bir dille (*may, suggests*) ilerliyorsa *every city should immediately…* gibi kesin sonuçlar yanlıştır.

## Sınav ipucu
YDS'de genellikle 5 paragraf tamamlama sorusu gelir. Önce boşluğun konumuna bak, sonra şıklarda bağlaç ve zamirleri tara; çoğu zaman iki üç şık yalnızca bağlaç uyumsuzluğundan elenir. Başta boşluk sorularında en genel ve diğer cümleleri kapsayan şıkkı ara; sonda boşluk sorularında paragrafın 'Peki ne olmuş?' sorusuna cevap veren cümleyi seç. Kararsız kaldığın iki şıkkı sırayla boşluğa yerleştirip paragrafı sesli okur gibi oku; akışı bozan cümle hemen hissedilir.

nodes.title: Bağlantı kelimeleri
nodes.description: Paragraf akışını taşıyan bağlaçlar ve metinlerde geçen akademik kelimeler

exercises.question: The first model was cheap but unreliable. ----, the second model was reliable but far too expensive.
options: Therefore
In contrast
For instance
Similarly
As a result
exercises.explanation: İki model zıt özellikleriyle karşılaştırılıyor (ucuz ama güvenilmez / güvenilir ama pahalı); 'In contrast' doğrudur. 'Similarly' benzerlik bildirir, oysa modeller birbirinin tersidir; 'Therefore' ve 'As a result' ise ikinci modeli birincinin sonucu gibi gösterir.

exercises.question: Many bird species have returned to the restored wetlands. ----, three species that had not been seen for fifty years were recorded there last spring.
options: However
Nevertheless
In contrast
In fact
Otherwise
exercises.explanation: İkinci cümle birinci cümledeki olumlu bilgiyi daha da güçlendirir; 'In fact' (hatta, aslında) bu pekiştirmeyi sağlar. 'However', 'Nevertheless' ve 'In contrast' karşıtlık bildirir, oysa iki cümle aynı yönde ilerler.

exercises.text: The tax raised the price of soft drinks; ___, sales fell sharply.
exercises.translation: Vergi gazlı içeceklerin fiyatını artırdı; sonuç olarak satışlar keskin biçimde düştü.

exercises.question: The survey was carried out in only one small town. ----, its results should be treated with caution.
options: Consequently
Nevertheless
Moreover
For example
In contrast
exercises.explanation: Anketin tek bir küçük kasabada yapılması, sonuçlara temkinle yaklaşılmasının nedenidir; sonuç bildiren 'Consequently' doğrudur. 'Nevertheless' karşıtlık kurar ve mantığı tersine çevirir; 'For example' ise ikinci cümleyi bir örnek gibi gösterir.

exercises.question: Electric scooters produce no exhaust fumes while they are being ridden. ----, their manufacture and daily collection generate considerable emissions.
options: Therefore
For instance
Similarly
In addition
However
exercises.explanation: Birinci cümle bir avantajı, ikinci cümle bir dezavantajı anlatır; karşıtlık bildiren 'However' doğrudur. 'In addition' aynı yönde bilgi ekler ve olumluya olumsuz ekleyemez; 'Therefore' ise egzoz olmamasını salımın nedeni gibi gösterir.

exercises.text: Sardines prefer cooler water. Squid, ___, thrive in warmer seas.
exercises.translation: Sardalyalar daha soğuk suyu tercih eder. Buna karşılık kalamarlar daha sıcak denizlerde gelişir.

exercises.question: Light pollution harms many animals. Sea turtles, ----, often crawl inland instead of towards the sea on brightly lit beaches.
options: however
therefore
for example
in contrast
otherwise
exercises.explanation: Deniz kaplumbağaları, ışık kirliliğinden zarar gören hayvanlara bir örnektir; 'for example' doğrudur. 'However' ve 'in contrast' karşıtlık kurar, oysa ikinci cümle birinciyi destekler; 'otherwise' (aksi takdirde) ise anlamsızdır.

exercises.question: The new archaeological evidence ---- the long-held view that the city had been destroyed by invaders.
options: undermined
accumulated
harvested
illuminated
migrated
exercises.explanation: Yeni kanıt, şehrin istilacılar tarafından yıkıldığı yönündeki köklü görüşü 'sarsmıştır'; 'undermine a view' doğal bir eşdizimdir. 'Accumulated' (biriktirdi) ve 'harvested' (hasat etti) bir görüşle kullanılmaz; 'migrated' ise nesne almaz.

exercises.question: The researchers warn against drawing broad conclusions from a single, relatively small ----.
options: harvest
layout
outbreak
sample
chimney
exercises.explanation: Genel sonuçlar çıkarmak için küçük bir 'örneklem' (sample) yetersizdir; doğru şık 'sample'. 'Outbreak' (salgın) ve 'harvest' (hasat) araştırma sonucu çıkarılan bir veri kümesi anlamı taşımaz.

nodes.title: Sonda ve ortada boşluk
nodes.description: Sonuç cümlesi bulma; bağlaç ve zamirlerle köprü cümlesi kurma

exercises.passage: In the coastal town of Marlow Point, local fishermen noticed in 2016 that catches of sardines had fallen by almost half. Marine biologists studying the area found that the water temperature had risen by nearly two degrees over the previous decade. Sardines prefer cooler water, and the researchers tracked large shoals moving about 80 kilometres further north. Meanwhile, species that are more common in warmer seas, such as certain types of squid, began appearing in local nets for the first time. ----
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Sardines are rich in oil and are often sold in tins.
Cold water generally holds more oxygen than warm water does.
Many fishermen have therefore started adapting their equipment to catch these new species.
However, the water temperature in the area has remained stable for decades, according to official records.
The town was founded by fishermen in the eighteenth century.
exercises.explanation: Paragraf sardalyaların kuzeye göçünü ve ağlara yeni türlerin girmesini anlatır; sonuç olarak balıkçıların bu yeni türlere uyum sağlaması mantıklı bir kapanıştır, doğru cevap 'Many fishermen have therefore started adapting their equipment'. 'the water temperature in the area has remained stable' diyen şık ikinci cümledeki iki derecelik ısınmayla çelişir; 'Sardines are rich in oil' diyen şık ise 'sardines' kelimesini tekrar eden ama konuyu ilerletmeyen bir tuzaktır.

exercises.passage: A group of psychologists at the University of Westholm asked 300 students to study a short text either on paper or on a tablet screen. When tested immediately afterwards, both groups remembered the main facts equally well. A week later, however, the paper group recalled significantly more details and was better able to explain how the ideas in the text were connected. The researchers suggest that the physical layout of a printed page helps readers build a mental map of the text, whereas scrolling makes it harder to remember where information appeared. ----
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Tablets are becoming cheaper and more widely available every year.
Both groups found the text extremely difficult to understand.
As a result, the screen group performed better after a week.
Some students prefer listening to audiobooks instead of reading.
They therefore recommend that students print important material when preparing for exams that require deep understanding.
exercises.explanation: Paragraf basılı metnin uzun süreli hatırlamaya daha iyi geldiğini açıklar; sonda araştırmacıların bu bulguya dayanan önerisi gelir ('They' = the researchers), doğru cevap 'They therefore recommend that students print important material'. 'the screen group performed better' diyen şık bulguyu tersine çevirir; 'Tablets are becoming cheaper' diyen şık ise 'tablet' kelimesini tekrar eden ama sonuç bildirmeyen bir cümledir.

exercises.passage: For centuries, the farmers of the Velder Valley grew a single variety of wheat that was well suited to the region's dry summers. In the 1960s, however, most of them switched to a new high-yield variety promoted by the government. Harvests increased dramatically for two decades. But the new wheat needed large amounts of water and fertiliser, and when a series of droughts struck in the 1990s, yields collapsed. Many families were left with debts they could not repay, and some abandoned their land altogether. ----
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Today, a growing number of farmers are returning to the traditional variety, which survives dry years far better.
Wheat is one of the oldest cultivated crops in the world.
The government has never encouraged farmers to change their crops.
Fertiliser prices fell sharply in the 1960s.
Consequently, the high-yield variety became even more popular after the droughts.
exercises.explanation: Kuraklıkta yeni çeşidin verimi çöktüyse, kuraklığa dayanıklı eski çeşide geri dönülmesi doğal bir sonuçtur; doğru cevap 'farmers are returning to the traditional variety'. 'Consequently, the high-yield variety became even more popular' diyen şık mantıksız bir sonuç kurar; 'The government has never encouraged farmers' diyen şık ise devletin yeni çeşidi teşvik ettiği bilgisiyle çelişir.

exercises.passage: Hospitals have traditionally measured their success by counting how many patients they treat. A pilot programme in the region of Ostmark has taken a different approach. Instead of being paid for each operation or visit, participating hospitals receive a fixed annual budget for every resident in their area and keep any savings they make by preventing illness. Within three years, hospital admissions for diabetes and heart disease fell by 12 percent, as hospitals invested in nutrition classes and home visits. ----
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Diabetes is caused by high levels of sugar in the blood.
Hospitals in Ostmark are still paid separately for each operation they perform.
Most patients prefer to be treated by doctors they already know.
If these results are confirmed, the model could be extended to the rest of the country.
However, admissions for heart disease rose sharply during the same period in most participating hospitals.
exercises.explanation: Pilot programın olumlu sonuçlarından sonra, bu modelin ülke geneline yayılabileceğini söyleyen 'the model could be extended to the rest of the country' mantıklı bir kapanıştır. 'Hospitals in Ostmark are still paid separately' diyen şık programın işleyişiyle çelişir; 'admissions for heart disease rose sharply' diyen şık ise kalp hastalığı yatışlarının düştüğü bilgisini tersine çevirir.

exercises.passage: Many cities have tried to reduce traffic by building new roads, only to find that congestion soon returns to its previous level. Transport researchers call this effect 'induced demand': when travel becomes easier, people make more journeys by car, and the new space quickly fills up. The opposite also appears to be true. When a major bridge in the city of Tarnby was closed for repairs for six months, traffic in the surrounding area did not increase as officials had feared; many drivers simply switched to buses, changed their routes or made fewer trips. ----
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: The bridge was originally built in the nineteenth century.
This suggests that reducing road space does not necessarily cause traffic chaos.
As a result, the city decided to build three new bridges.
Buses are usually slower than private cars in city centres.
Therefore, building new roads is the best way to reduce congestion in crowded city centres.
exercises.explanation: Köprü kapandığında trafiğin artmaması, yol alanını azaltmanın kaos yaratmadığını gösterir; 'This suggests' ile bu çıkarımı yapan cümle doğrudur. 'building new roads is the best way' diyen şık paragrafın ilk cümlesiyle (yeni yollar sıkışıklığı çözmez) çelişir; 'build three new bridges' diyen şık ise metinden çıkmayan bir sonuç ekler.

exercises.passage: Language researchers in the island nation of Pelora studied how children learn to count in two local languages. In Pelorese, the names of numbers above ten follow a regular pattern, so that 'eleven' is literally 'ten-one' and 'twenty-three' is 'two-ten-three'. In the island's second language, Varish, number names are irregular, much like in English. The researchers found that Pelorese-speaking children learned to count to one hundred almost a year earlier than Varish-speaking children of the same age. The difference remained even after the children's schooling and family background were taken into account. ----
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: English is spoken as a foreign language by many people on the island.
The structure of a language's number words, it seems, can affect how quickly children grasp numbers.
Varish-speaking children, however, learned to count much earlier.
Most children on the island start school at the age of six.
Pelora's economy depends mainly on tourism and fishing.
exercises.explanation: Düzenli sayı adlarına sahip dili konuşan çocukların daha erken saymayı öğrenmesi, dilin yapısının öğrenme hızını etkileyebileceği sonucunu doğurur; doğru cevap 'The structure of a language's number words ... can affect'. 'Varish-speaking children, however, learned to count much earlier' diyen şık bulguyu tersine çevirir; 'English is spoken as a foreign language' diyen şık 'English' kelimesini tekrar eden ama konudan sapan bir cümledir.

exercises.passage: Octopuses are known for their remarkable ability to change colour. They can match the shade and texture of rocks, sand or coral within a fraction of a second. ---- Instead, scientists believe they may detect light directly through their skin, which contains some of the same light-sensitive proteins found in the eye. This would allow an octopus to sense its surroundings with its whole body and adjust its appearance accordingly. Researchers are now investigating whether similar abilities exist in squid and cuttlefish.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
This is why they always hunt during the day.
Their eyes allow them to see colours far more clearly than humans do.
Surprisingly, however, octopuses appear to be colour-blind, so they cannot simply copy the colours they see.
Most octopuses live for only one or two years.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonraki 'Instead' reddedilen bir olasılık ister: ahtapotlar renk körüyse gördükleri renkleri kopyalayamazlar, bunun yerine ışığı derileriyle algılarlar. Doğru cevap 'octopuses appear to be colour-blind'. 'see colours far more clearly than humans' diyen şık 'Instead' ile çelişir, çünkü gözler renkleri iyi görseydi deriye gerek kalmazdı; 'three hearts and blue blood' ve 'live for only one or two years' diyen şıklar ise konudan sapar.

exercises.passage: In 2012, the city of Brannock introduced a tax on sugary soft drinks, adding about 20 percent to their price. Within a year, sales of these drinks had fallen by a quarter. ---- Sales of bottled water and unsweetened tea, for example, rose by roughly 15 percent over the same period. Health officials now hope that the tax will lead to lower rates of obesity and tooth decay among children in the coming years. Critics of the tax, however, argue that it places a heavier burden on low-income families.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: At the same time, many consumers appear to have switched to healthier alternatives.
However, the tax was abolished after only three months.
Sugar was first brought to Europe in the Middle Ages.
As a result, soft drink companies raised their prices even further in the following months.
Children are especially fond of sweet foods and drinks.
exercises.explanation: Sonraki cümle 'for example' ile su ve şekersiz çay satışlarının arttığını söyler; bu, boşlukta tüketicilerin sağlıklı alternatiflere yöneldiğini bildiren genel bir cümle olmasını gerektirir. Doğru cevap 'many consumers appear to have switched to healthier alternatives'. 'the tax was abolished after only three months' diyen şık 'within a year' ve sağlık yetkililerinin beklentisiyle çelişir; 'Children are especially fond of sweet foods' diyen şık ise 'for example' ile verilen örneklerle bağlanmaz.

exercises.passage: For decades, the Gorran wetlands were drained to create farmland. By the 1990s, less than a fifth of the original marshes remained, and several bird species had disappeared from the area. In 2005, a conservation group bought a large section of farmland and allowed it to flood again. ---- Within ten years, more than 120 bird species had been recorded there, including three that had not been seen in the region for half a century. The project is now regarded as a model for wetland restoration across the country.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Farmers in the region grow mainly potatoes and barley.
Unfortunately, the birds never returned to the area.
The wetlands had been drained by hand before machines were introduced.
Many conservation groups rely on donations from the public.
The results exceeded even the most optimistic expectations.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonra 120'den fazla kuş türünün kaydedildiği anlatılır; bu ayrıntıları özetleyen ve sonuçların beklentileri aştığını söyleyen 'The results exceeded even the most optimistic expectations' köprü görevi görür. 'the birds never returned' diyen şık sonraki cümleyle doğrudan çelişir; 'conservation groups rely on donations' diyen şık ise 'conservation group' ifadesini tekrar eden ama akışa katkı sağlamayan bir tuzaktır.

exercises.passage: Most people assume that creativity declines with age. A long-term study of 900 professional artists, writers and scientists, however, paints a more complex picture. ---- Those whose work depended on bold, sudden ideas, such as poets and theoretical physicists, tended to produce their most celebrated work before the age of forty. By contrast, novelists, historians and experimental scientists, whose work relies on accumulated knowledge and careful observation, often peaked in their fifties or even later. The authors conclude that the idea of a single creative peak in life is misleading.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Most of the participants lived in large cities.
It confirmed that all creative people do their best work when they are young.
It found that the age at which people do their best work depends largely on the type of work they do.
Creativity is notoriously difficult to measure in a scientific way.
Poets usually earn less than novelists.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonra iki grup karşılaştırılır: ani fikirlere dayanan işler erken, birikime dayanan işler geç zirve yapar. Bunu özetleyen 'depends largely on the type of work they do' doğrudur ('It' = the study). 'all creative people do their best work when they are young' diyen şık 'more complex picture' ifadesiyle ve sonraki karşılaştırmayla çelişir; 'Creativity is notoriously difficult to measure' diyen şık ise konuyla ilgili ama bulguları tanıtmaz.

exercises.passage: Termite mounds in the dry grasslands of southern Kavara can reach five metres in height. Despite outside temperatures that range from near freezing at night to over 40°C during the day, the temperature inside the nest stays remarkably constant. ---- Warm air rises through a central chimney and escapes through small openings near the top, while cooler air is drawn in through tunnels at the base. Architects have studied this design in an effort to build offices that need less air conditioning.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: This is achieved through a sophisticated system of natural ventilation.
Termites feed mainly on dead wood and dry grass.
In winter, however, the termites leave the mound completely.
The mounds are often damaged by heavy rain.
As a result, temperatures inside the mound change dramatically between day and night.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan önce sıcaklığın sabit kaldığı söylenir, sonra hava akışı anlatılır; 'This' ile sabitliği gösterip doğal havalandırmayı tanıtan 'This is achieved through a sophisticated system of natural ventilation' iki cümleyi bağlar. 'temperatures inside the mound change dramatically' diyen şık önceki cümleyle çelişir; 'Termites feed mainly on dead wood' diyen şık ise konudan sapar.

exercises.passage: The ancient city of Kethra-Vel was abandoned around 900 AD, and for a long time historians blamed a foreign invasion. Recent excavations, however, have found no signs of fighting, such as burned buildings or weapons. ---- Sediment cores from a nearby lake show that rainfall dropped sharply during the ninth century and remained low for nearly eighty years. Without reliable water supplies, the city's farms could no longer feed its population. Many residents probably moved to the coast, where rivers provided a more dependable source of water.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: The invaders destroyed the city's walls and temples.
Many tourists visit the ruins every summer.
Historians have always agreed on why the city was abandoned.
Instead, the evidence points to a long period of drought.
The city's population was larger than that of any modern town in the region.
exercises.explanation: İstila kanıtı bulunamamış, sonraki cümle ise yağışın azaldığını gösteriyor; 'Instead' ile istila yerine kuraklığı öne süren 'the evidence points to a long period of drought' köprü cümlesidir. 'The invaders destroyed the city's walls' diyen şık savaş izi bulunmadığı bilgisiyle çelişir; 'Historians have always agreed' diyen şık ise tarihçilerin görüşünün değiştiğini anlatan paragrafa aykırıdır.

nodes.title: Başta boşluk: konu cümlesi
nodes.description: Paragrafın tamamını kapsayan genel giriş cümlesini bulma

exercises.passage: ---- Some species, such as the Arctic tern, travel tens of thousands of kilometres a year between their breeding and feeding grounds. Others, like certain warblers, cross deserts and seas without stopping to eat or drink. To navigate, they appear to rely on several cues, including the position of the sun and stars, the Earth's magnetic field and even familiar smells. How young birds on their first journey combine these signals is still not fully understood. Scientists hope that tracking devices small enough for songbirds will soon provide answers.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: However, most birds never leave the area where they were born.
Migratory birds are capable of extraordinary journeys.
This is why they are able to find their way so easily.
Deserts cover about a third of the Earth's land surface.
Smell is the least important sense for most animals.
exercises.explanation: Paragraf göçmen kuşların uzun yolculuklarını ve yön bulma yöntemlerini anlatır; hepsini kapsayan genel giriş 'Migratory birds are capable of extraordinary journeys' cümlesidir. 'However, most birds never leave the area' diyen şık 'However' ile başlar, ama başta karşıtlık kurulacak bir önceki cümle yoktur; 'This is why they are able' diyen şıktaki 'This' de gösterecek bir şey bulamaz.

exercises.passage: ---- In the past, a sample had to be sent to a specialised laboratory, and results could take up to two weeks. The new handheld device developed by researchers at the Corran Institute analyses a single drop of blood in about fifteen minutes and costs very little to use. Doctors in remote clinics, where laboratories are often hundreds of kilometres away, say it could save many lives by allowing treatment to begin the same day. Large-scale trials are planned for next year.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Coffee is the most popular hot drink in many countries.
These results, however, were later shown to be inaccurate by researchers at another institute.
Doctors in large cities have plenty of laboratories nearby.
Blood is made up of red cells, white cells and plasma.
A new test could make diagnosing blood infections much faster and cheaper.
exercises.explanation: Paragraf eski yavaş yöntemle yeni hızlı ve ucuz cihazı karşılaştırır; konuyu tanıtan 'A new test could make diagnosing blood infections much faster and cheaper' doğru giriştir. 'These results, however' diyen şıktaki 'These results' gösterecek bir sonuç bulamaz; 'Blood is made up of red cells' diyen şık ise 'blood' kelimesini tekrar eden ama konuyu tanıtmayan genel bir bilgidir.

exercises.passage: ---- In one experiment at a supermarket, shoppers who were offered 30 varieties of olive oil to taste were far less likely to buy a bottle than those offered only five. Similarly, employees given dozens of pension plans to choose from were more likely to postpone the decision altogether. Psychologists suggest that when faced with too many options, people worry about making the wrong choice and therefore avoid choosing at all. Some retailers have therefore reduced the number of products on their shelves.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Olive oil has been produced around the Mediterranean for thousands of years.
Shoppers always prefer stores that offer a wide variety of products.
Having more options does not always make people more likely to choose.
As a result, pension plans have become more popular.
However, psychologists have found that more options always increase sales.
exercises.explanation: İki örnek de seçenek arttıkça insanların karar vermekten kaçındığını gösterir; bunu genel bir ilke olarak sunan 'Having more options does not always make people more likely to choose' doğrudur. 'Shoppers always prefer ... a wide variety' ve 'more options always increase sales' diyen şıklar paragrafın bulgularıyla çelişir; 'Olive oil has been produced' diyen şık ise örnekteki bir kelimeyi tekrar eden ilgisiz bir bilgidir.

exercises.passage: ---- Its streets were laid out in a regular grid, its houses were connected to a covered drainage system, and its granaries could store enough grain to feed the population for a year. Even its public wells were placed at regular intervals, so that no house was more than a short walk from water. Archaeologists believe that such careful planning required a strong central authority, although no palace or royal tomb has yet been found at the site. Its rulers, it seems, remain a mystery.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: The ancient city of Dhorvan was remarkably well organised.
Grain was the main crop in most ancient societies.
Unlike other cities of the period, Dhorvan had no clear plan.
Many palaces and royal tombs have been discovered at Dhorvan.
This system was later copied by modern engineers.
exercises.explanation: Sonraki cümlelerdeki 'Its' bir şehre gönderme yapar ve ızgara sokaklar, kanalizasyon, ambarlar şehrin düzenli olduğunu gösterir; doğru cevap 'The ancient city of Dhorvan was remarkably well organised'. 'Dhorvan had no clear plan' diyen şık bu düzenle çelişir; 'Many palaces and royal tombs have been discovered' diyen şık ise son cümledeki 'no palace or royal tomb has yet been found' bilgisine aykırıdır.

exercises.passage: ---- They work longer hours, have fewer paid holidays and are more likely to be self-employed than their parents were at the same age. Yet surveys suggest that they value flexibility more than job security and are more willing to change careers several times during their working lives. Economists are still debating whether this reflects a genuine change in attitudes or simply a response to an uncertain job market. What is clear is that employers who offer flexible arrangements find it easier to attract young staff.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Paid holidays were first introduced in some countries in the early twentieth century, mainly for factory workers.
This is why young people rarely change careers.
Economists agree that attitudes towards work have not changed.
Young workers today face very different working conditions from those of previous generations.
Self-employment is especially common in the agricultural sector.
exercises.explanation: İkinci cümledeki 'They' ve 'their parents' kuşak karşılaştırması yapıldığını gösterir; bu nedenle genç çalışanları önceki kuşaklarla karşılaştıran 'Young workers today face very different working conditions' doğru giriştir. 'This is why young people rarely change careers' diyen şık paragraftaki kariyer değiştirme isteğiyle çelişir; 'Economists agree that attitudes towards work have not changed' diyen şık ise ekonomistlerin hâlâ tartıştığı bilgisine aykırıdır.

exercises.passage: ---- When a forest is cleared, the shade disappears and the ground dries out quickly. Without tree roots to hold it in place, the soil is easily washed away by heavy rain, carrying nutrients into rivers. In some tropical regions, land cleared for farming becomes so poor within a few years that it has to be abandoned, and more forest is cut down to replace it. The cycle can continue until large areas are left almost bare. Restoring such land can take decades.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Tropical forests are home to a large share of the world's species, including many insects.
Rivers carry water from the mountains to the sea.
Deforestation damages not only trees but also the soil beneath them.
As a result, farmers in tropical regions rarely cut down trees.
However, cleared land usually becomes more fertile over time.
exercises.explanation: Paragrafın tamamı orman kesiminin toprağa verdiği zararı anlatır; konuyu tanıtan 'Deforestation damages not only trees but also the soil' doğrudur. 'Tropical forests are home to a large share of the world's species' doğru bir bilgi olsa da paragraf türlerden değil topraktan söz eder; 'cleared land usually becomes more fertile' diyen şık ise paragrafın ana fikriyle çelişir.

exercises.passage: ---- Viewers in the 1950s typically watched whatever was being broadcast at a particular time, often with the whole family gathered around a single set. Today, people choose what to watch, when to watch it and on which device, from phones to laptops. As a result, the shared experience of watching the same programme at the same moment has become increasingly rare. Some media researchers argue that this has weakened one of the few experiences that once united entire nations. Others point out, however, that social media now allows viewers to discuss programmes together even when they watch them at different times.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Phones and laptops are now cheaper than ever before.
Television was invented in the early twentieth century.
Families today spend more time together than they did in the past, according to recent surveys.
Most viewers in the 1950s preferred radio to television.
The way people watch television has changed dramatically over the past seventy years.
exercises.explanation: Paragraf 1950'lerle bugünün televizyon izleme alışkanlıklarını karşılaştırır; bu değişimi tanıtan 'The way people watch television has changed dramatically' doğru konu cümlesidir. 'Television was invented in the early twentieth century' televizyonla ilgili ama değişimi anlatmaz; 'Most viewers in the 1950s preferred radio' diyen şık ise 1950'lerdeki izleyicilerin televizyonun başında toplandığı bilgisiyle çelişir.

exercises.passage: ---- Researchers at the Lindqvist Centre tracked 2,000 office workers for ten years and found that those who sat for more than eight hours a day had a significantly higher risk of heart disease, even if they exercised regularly. However, the risk fell considerably among workers who stood up and moved for a few minutes every half hour. The researchers now recommend that employers encourage regular short breaks rather than relying only on gym memberships or sports programmes. Even short walks to a colleague's desk, they say, can make a difference.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Exercise is the only way to prevent heart disease.
Sitting for long periods may be harmful even for people who exercise regularly.
Office workers usually spend their evenings at the gym.
Heart disease is more common in some countries than in others, especially among older men.
These workers were later given standing desks by their employers.
exercises.explanation: Çalışmanın ana bulgusu, düzenli spor yapanlarda bile uzun süre oturmanın kalp hastalığı riskini artırmasıdır; bunu genel olarak tanıtan 'Sitting for long periods may be harmful even for people who exercise regularly' doğrudur. 'Exercise is the only way' diyen şık bulgularla çelişir (spor tek başına yeterli değil); 'These workers were later given standing desks' diyen şıktaki 'These workers' ise başta gönderme yapacak bir isim bulamaz.

exercises.passage: ---- First, the ink has to be removed from used paper with chemicals and large amounts of water. The fibres are then cleaned, but they become shorter each time they are recycled, so after five to seven cycles they are too weak to be used again. For this reason, new wood fibres must constantly be added to keep the paper industry going. Recycling still saves energy and reduces waste compared with producing paper from new wood alone. However, experts stress that using less paper in the first place remains the most effective way to protect forests.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Paper is used for books, packaging and many other products.
Wood fibres never lose their strength, however often they are used in the recycling process.
This is why recycled paper is stronger than new paper.
Recycling paper is neither as simple nor as endless as many people assume.
Most countries have banned the use of chemicals in recycling.
exercises.explanation: 'First' ile başlayan süreç anlatımı ve liflerin sınırlı sayıda geri dönüştürülebilmesi, kâğıt geri dönüşümünün sanıldığı kadar basit ve sonsuz olmadığını gösterir; doğru cevap 'neither as simple nor as endless as many people assume'. 'Wood fibres never lose their strength' diyen şık liflerin kısaldığı bilgisiyle çelişir; 'This is why recycled paper is stronger' diyen şıktaki 'This is why' ise başta karşılıksız kalır.

exercises.passage: ---- In the town of Hessby, a council project gave 200 elderly residents tablets with simple video-calling software. After a year, participants reported feeling much less lonely, and many said they now spoke to their grandchildren every week. Unexpectedly, the number of visits to local doctors also fell, possibly because participants felt more connected and less anxious. The council is now planning to extend the scheme to the surrounding villages, where public transport is limited. Officials say the cost of the tablets is small compared with the savings in healthcare.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Technology can help to reduce loneliness among older people.
Elderly people usually refuse to use new technology.
Grandchildren rarely visit their grandparents nowadays.
As a result, the council stopped the project after only a month of testing.
Doctors recommend that elderly people avoid using screens.
exercises.explanation: Paragraf tabletlerin yaşlıların yalnızlığını azalttığını gösteren bir projeyi anlatır; bu ana fikri genel olarak sunan 'Technology can help to reduce loneliness among older people' doğrudur. 'Elderly people usually refuse to use new technology' diyen şık katılımcıların tabletleri kullandığı bilgisiyle çelişir; 'the council stopped the project after only a month' diyen şık ise projenin bir yıl sürdüğü ve genişletileceği bilgisine aykırıdır.

nodes.title: Sınav düzeyi
nodes.description: Başta, ortada ve sonda boşluk; ince bağlaç ve gönderim farkları

exercises.passage: Mist frogs, found only in the cloud forests of the Arvelo highlands, have translucent skin through which their internal organs can be seen. For years, biologists assumed that this transparency was a simple form of camouflage that worked equally well at all times. ---- When a mist frog sleeps, it removes most of the red blood cells from its circulation and stores them in its liver, which is covered by a reflective membrane. As a result, its body becomes far more transparent, making it extremely hard for predators to spot during the day.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Mist frogs lay their eggs on leaves that hang above streams.
Consequently, mist frogs are rarely eaten by predators at night.
Red blood cells carry oxygen to all parts of the body.
This theory has since been confirmed: the frogs are equally transparent at all times.
A recent study, however, has revealed an unexpected mechanism behind it.
exercises.explanation: Önceki cümle eski bir varsayımı verir, sonraki cümle uyurken kanı karaciğerde saklama gibi yeni bir mekanizmayı anlatır; 'however' ile bu geçişi sağlayan 'A recent study, however, has revealed an unexpected mechanism' doğrudur ('it' = transparency). 'This theory has since been confirmed' diyen şık yeni bulguyla çelişir, çünkü saydamlık uykuda artmaktadır; 'Red blood cells carry oxygen' diyen şık ise 'red blood cells' ifadesini tekrar eden genel bir bilgidir.

exercises.passage: When the town of Kelso Ridge introduced a four-day working week for its municipal employees, critics warned that public services would suffer. A two-year evaluation found the opposite. Waiting times at the town hall fell, sick leave dropped by a third, and staff reported higher job satisfaction. Moreover, the council did not need to hire extra workers, since employees completed the same tasks in fewer hours. Nevertheless, the evaluation's authors caution against drawing broad conclusions from a single small town with a relatively simple range of services. ----
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Therefore, every city in the country should adopt the four-day week immediately, whatever its size.
Larger cities, they argue, should test the model carefully before adopting it on a wide scale.
Critics were proved right, as public services declined.
Sick leave is a major cost for many employers.
Kelso Ridge was founded as a mining town in the nineteenth century.
exercises.explanation: Son cümle yazarların temkinli uyarısıdır; sonda bu uyarıyı somutlaştıran, büyük şehirlerin modeli dikkatle denemesini öneren 'Larger cities, they argue, should test the model carefully' gelmelidir ('they' = the authors). 'every city ... should adopt the four-day week immediately' diyen şık uyarıyla çelişen aşırı bir sonuçtur; 'Critics were proved right' diyen şık ise değerlendirmenin bulgularını tersine çevirir.

exercises.passage: ---- Until recently, most studies on the subject were carried out on university students in wealthy countries, who make up only a small fraction of humanity. When researchers repeated classic experiments on fairness and cooperation in small farming and fishing communities, they often obtained very different results. Some communities, for example, rejected offers that seemed generous to Western participants, viewing them as attempts to create a debt. Such findings suggest that many supposedly universal features of human behaviour may in fact be shaped by culture.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: University students are often paid to take part in experiments, usually in their first or second year.
Fishing communities depend heavily on cooperation between families.
As a result, psychologists now study only university students.
Psychologists have increasingly questioned whether their findings apply to all human beings.
Fairness is valued more highly in wealthy countries than elsewhere.
exercises.explanation: Paragraf, yalnızca zengin ülkelerdeki öğrencilerle yapılan araştırmaların tüm insanlara genellenip genellenemeyeceğini sorgular; bunu tanıtan 'Psychologists have increasingly questioned whether their findings apply to all human beings' doğru konu cümlesidir. 'psychologists now study only university students' diyen şık hem 'As a result' ile başta karşılıksız kalır hem de paragrafın mesajıyla çelişir; 'Fairness is valued more highly in wealthy countries' diyen şık ise metinde olmayan bir karşılaştırma yapar.

exercises.passage: Light pollution is usually discussed as a problem for astronomers, who find it increasingly difficult to observe faint stars from urban areas. Its effects, however, extend far beyond astronomy. ---- Newly hatched sea turtles, for instance, find the ocean by moving towards the brightest horizon, and on lit coastlines they often crawl inland instead. Migrating birds may circle illuminated buildings until they are exhausted. Even trees exposed to street lights have been observed keeping their leaves longer in autumn. Some cities have begun dimming their street lights late at night in response.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Artificial light at night can disrupt the behaviour of a wide range of living things.
Astronomers have therefore moved most telescopes to the countryside.
Sea turtles are found in most of the world's tropical and temperate oceans.
Fortunately, most animals quickly adapt to artificial light, even when it is very bright at night.
Street lights were first powered by gas in the nineteenth century.
exercises.explanation: Sonraki cümleler 'for instance' ile kaplumbağa, kuş ve ağaç örnekleri verir; boşlukta bu örnekleri kapsayan genel bir iddia gerekir: yapay ışık birçok canlının davranışını bozar. Doğru cevap 'Artificial light at night can disrupt the behaviour of a wide range of living things'. 'most animals quickly adapt to artificial light' diyen şık örneklerle çelişir; 'Astronomers have therefore moved most telescopes' diyen şık ise önceki cümleye dönerek astronomiye odaklanır, oysa paragraf 'far beyond astronomy' der.

exercises.passage: Bilingual dictionaries have long been criticised for encouraging learners to look for one-to-one equivalents between words. A word such as 'home', for example, carries emotional associations that its closest translation in another language may lack, while a single word in one language may correspond to several different words in another depending on the context. Learners who rely too heavily on such dictionaries often produce sentences that are grammatically correct but sound unnatural. Such sentences may be understood, but they immediately mark the speaker as a non-native user of the language. ----
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Bilingual dictionaries are therefore the most reliable tool for advanced learners.
The word 'home' has been used in English for over a thousand years.
For this reason, many teachers recommend that advanced learners use monolingual dictionaries, which explain words through definitions and examples.
Grammar is more important than vocabulary in learning a language.
However, most learners never use dictionaries at all.
exercises.explanation: Paragraf iki dilli sözlüklerin sakıncalarını anlatır; sonda bu sakıncalara çözüm olarak tek dilli sözlükleri öneren 'many teachers recommend that advanced learners use monolingual dictionaries' mantıklı kapanıştır. 'Bilingual dictionaries are therefore the most reliable tool' diyen şık 'therefore' ile paragrafın eleştirisine ters bir sonuç çıkarır; 'The word 'home' has been used' diyen şık ise 'home' örneğini tekrar eden ilgisiz bir bilgidir.

exercises.passage: In 2009, the city of Feldmark moved the start of lessons in all its secondary schools from 7:45 to 9:00. The change was controversial: parents complained about childcare arrangements, and bus companies had to redesign their routes. ---- Average attendance rose by 6 percent, and the number of students falling asleep in class, as reported by teachers, dropped sharply. Exam results in the first lessons of the day improved most noticeably, suggesting that teenagers had simply been too tired to learn early in the morning.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: As a result, the city soon returned to the earlier start time of 7:45.
Teenagers usually go to bed earlier than younger children.
Bus companies in the city are mostly privately owned.
Within two years, however, the benefits had become hard to ignore.
Parents, however, were delighted with the change from the start.
exercises.explanation: Önceki cümle değişikliğe yönelik itirazları, sonraki cümle olumlu sonuçları anlatır; 'however' ile itirazlardan yararlara geçen 'Within two years, however, the benefits had become hard to ignore' köprü cümlesidir. 'Parents, however, were delighted' diyen şık da 'however' içerir ama velilerin şikâyet ettiği bilgisiyle çelişir; 'the city soon returned to the earlier start time' diyen şık ise sonraki olumlu sonuçlarla bağdaşmaz.

exercises.passage: ---- Unlike most trees, which shed their leaves gradually or in a single season, the Morvan pine of the northern islands keeps each needle for up to forty years. This allows it to survive on extremely poor soils, since it does not need to replace its foliage regularly. The disadvantage is that the tree grows very slowly; a specimen only two metres tall may already be a century old. Foresters have therefore warned that if the islands' pine forests are cut down, they will take many generations to recover.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: One tree species has developed an unusual strategy for coping with a harsh environment.
All pine trees lose their needles every autumn.
The northern islands have the richest soils in the region.
This explains why the tree grows so quickly.
Foresters plant thousands of new pine trees on the islands every year to replace those cut down.
exercises.explanation: Paragraf, iğne yapraklarını kırk yıl tutarak fakir topraklarda yaşayan bir çam türünü anlatır; bunu 'olağanüstü bir uyum stratejisi' olarak tanıtan 'One tree species has developed an unusual strategy' doğrudur. 'The northern islands have the richest soils' diyen şık 'extremely poor soils' bilgisiyle, 'This explains why the tree grows so quickly' diyen şık ağacın çok yavaş büyüdüğü bilgisiyle çelişir; bu son cümledeki 'This' de başta karşılıksız kalır.

exercises.passage: Crowdfunding platforms, which allow individuals to raise money from large numbers of small donors, have been praised for giving inventors and artists an alternative to banks and investors. A study of 3,000 campaigns on the platform FundLane, however, found that only about a third reached their funding goals. Successful projects tended to have a video, a detailed budget and frequent updates, and their creators usually had large social media networks before launching. Projects launched by first-time creators with few online followers, by contrast, rarely raised even half of their target. ----
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Banks have completely stopped lending money to inventors.
Social media was originally designed to help artists raise money.
Therefore, most campaigns on FundLane reach their goals easily.
Online video is one of the most popular forms of entertainment.
Crowdfunding, it seems, rewards those who are already well connected and skilled at self-promotion, rather than simply those with good ideas.
exercises.explanation: Başarılı kampanyaların sahiplerinin zaten geniş sosyal ağlara sahip olması, kitlesel fonlamanın iyi fikirden çok bağlantıları ödüllendirdiği sonucunu doğurur; doğru cevap 'Crowdfunding, it seems, rewards those who are already well connected…'. 'most campaigns on FundLane reach their goals easily' diyen şık kampanyaların yalnızca üçte birinin başarılı olduğu bilgisiyle çelişir; 'Online video is one of the most popular…' cümlesi 'video' kelimesini tekrar eden bir tuzaktır.

exercises.passage: Chronic pain affects roughly one in five adults, yet it remains poorly understood. For many years, doctors assumed that pain always reflected damage to the body, and that treating the injury would make the pain disappear. ---- In some patients, the nervous system continues to send pain signals long after an injury has healed, as if an alarm had become stuck in the 'on' position. This insight has led to new treatments that target the nervous system itself, including certain forms of physical therapy and psychological training.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: This is why painkillers are always effective against chronic pain.
Most injuries heal completely within a few weeks.
Research now suggests that the relationship between damage and pain is far less direct.
Doctors were therefore right to focus only on treating injuries, as most of them had always done in the past.
One in five adults works in a job that involves physical labour.
exercises.explanation: Önceki cümle eski varsayımı (ağrı = hasar), sonraki cümle iyileşmiş yaralanmalarda bile ağrının sürdüğünü anlatır; ikisi arasında eski görüşü sorgulayan 'the relationship between damage and pain is far less direct' köprü olur. 'Doctors were therefore right' diyen şık eski görüşü onaylayarak sonraki bulguyla çelişir; 'One in five adults works in a job' diyen şık ise 'one in five' ifadesini tekrar eden bir tuzaktır.

exercises.passage: ---- Most of the island's 1,200 residents once earned their living from fishing, but declining fish stocks forced many to leave in the 1980s. Since then, the islanders have built a small but thriving tourism industry based on bird-watching, walking trails and locally produced wool. Visitor numbers are deliberately limited to protect the fragile landscape, and profits are reinvested in the community through a cooperative owned by the residents. Several families who left in the 1980s have since returned to the island.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Bird-watching has become a popular hobby in many countries.
Over the past forty years, the island of Skarra has transformed its economy.
Fishing remains the main source of income on Skarra, as it has been for centuries.
As a result, visitor numbers on Skarra are unlimited.
Wool is one of the warmest natural materials.
exercises.explanation: Sonraki cümledeki 'the island's' bir adanın daha önce adı geçmiş olmasını gerektirir ve paragraf balıkçılıktan turizme geçişi anlatır; doğru cevap 'the island of Skarra has transformed its economy'. 'Fishing remains the main source of income' diyen şık balıkçılığın gerilediği bilgisiyle, 'visitor numbers on Skarra are unlimited' diyen şık ziyaretçi sayısının sınırlandığı bilgisiyle çelişir; 'Bird-watching has become a popular hobby' diyen şık ise ada adını vermediği için 'the island's' karşılıksız kalır.

nodes.title: Ünite testi
nodes.description: 17 soruluk ünite testi; geçmek için %80 doğru yap

exercises.question: The researchers had to ---- their conclusions after new evidence came to light.
options: resemble
reside
rely
revise
refuse
exercises.explanation: Yeni kanıt ortaya çıkınca araştırmacıların sonuçlarını 'gözden geçirip değiştirmesi' gerekir; doğru şık 'revise'. 'Rely' (güvenmek) 'on' ister; 'reside' (ikamet etmek) ve 'resemble' (benzemek) sonuçlarla anlamlı bir öbek kurmaz.

exercises.question: All of the data ---- by the time the deadline arrived.
options: had been analysed
has analysed
analysed
were analysing
will be analysed
exercises.explanation: 'By the time' + geçmiş zaman (arrived), ondan önce tamamlanmış bir eylemi gerektirir; veriler analiz edilen şey olduğu için edilgen past perfect gerekir: 'had been analysed'. 'Analysed' etken anlam verir (veriler bir şeyi analiz etti); 'will be analysed' ise zaman uyumsuzdur.

exercises.passage: Many people believe that eating late at night leads to weight gain. A study at the Ardley Nutrition Unit followed 400 adults for two years and recorded both what they ate and when they ate it. It found that the total number of calories consumed during the day was strongly linked to weight gain, while the timing of meals made almost no difference. Participants who ate late but consumed fewer calories overall did not gain more weight than those who ate early. ----
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Therefore, people should never eat after eight o'clock in the evening.
Calories are a unit used to measure the energy in food.
What matters most, then, appears to be how much people eat rather than when they eat it.
Most participants preferred to eat dinner with their families.
Late-night eaters, however, gained far more weight than early eaters, regardless of their calorie intake.
exercises.explanation: Araştırma toplam kalorinin önemli, öğün saatinin önemsiz olduğunu gösterir; bunu özetleyen 'how much people eat rather than when they eat it' doğru sonuç cümlesidir. 'people should never eat after eight o'clock' ve 'Late-night eaters ... gained far more weight' diyen şıklar bulgularla çelişir; 'Calories are a unit used to measure' diyen şık ise 'calories' kelimesini tekrar eden genel bir bilgidir.

exercises.passage: ---- In the 1950s, a typical household in the region of Tarlow produced less than one bag of rubbish a week, since food was bought loose, bottles were returned and broken items were repaired. Today, the average household throws away about four bags a week, much of it plastic packaging. Local authorities are now trying to revive some of the older habits by opening refill shops and repair cafés. Early results are encouraging: in areas with repair cafés, the amount of household waste has fallen by about 10 percent.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Plastic was first produced on a large scale in the twentieth century.
Repair cafés are especially popular among young people.
Households in Tarlow have always produced large amounts of rubbish, especially plastic packaging and old furniture.
This is why local authorities have closed all the refill shops.
The amount of waste produced by households has increased dramatically over the past seventy years.
exercises.explanation: Paragraf 1950'lerle bugün arasındaki çöp miktarını karşılaştırır; bu artışı tanıtan 'The amount of waste produced by households has increased dramatically' doğru konu cümlesidir. 'Households in Tarlow have always produced large amounts of rubbish' diyen şık 1950'lerde çok az çöp üretildiği bilgisiyle çelişir; 'This is why local authorities have closed all the refill shops' diyen şıktaki 'This is why' başta karşılıksız kalır ve son cümleye aykırıdır.

exercises.question: Unless the reservoir wall is repaired before the rainy season, ----.
options: the town would have been flooded
the surrounding villages may be flooded
the villages had already been evacuated
it was repaired last year
the rain stopped early
exercises.explanation: 'Unless' + geniş zaman birinci tip koşul kurar; ana cümle gelecek ya da olasılık bildirmelidir: 'may be flooded'. 'would have been flooded' üçüncü tip koşula ait bir yapı kullanır; 'had already been evacuated', 'was repaired last year' ve 'the rain stopped early' geçmiş zaman olduğu için koşulla mantıksal ve dilbilgisel olarak uyuşmaz.

exercises.passage:
Tom: I've been asked to give a talk to first-year students about study skills.
Aylin: ----
Tom: Good point. I'll focus on time management and note-taking, then.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Keep it practical; they'll remember concrete tips better than general advice.
Study skills aren't really important at university.
I gave a similar talk last year, actually, but hardly anyone came to listen to it.
When is the deadline for your essay?
First-year students usually live in the dormitories.
exercises.explanation: Tom 'Good point' diyip somut konulara (zaman yönetimi, not alma) odaklanmaya karar veriyor; bu, Aylin'in pratik ipuçları önerdiğini gösterir, doğru cevap 'Keep it practical'. 'I gave a similar talk last year' bir bilgi verir ama 'Good point' ile somut konulara geçişi açıklamaz; 'Study skills aren't really important' ise konuşmayı anlamsızlaştırır.

exercises.passage: Many companies now use algorithms to screen job applications. Supporters argue that software is faster and less biased than human recruiters. ---- A system tested by one large retailer, for example, was found to rate applicants from certain postcodes lower, because it had learned from past hiring decisions in which such candidates had rarely been chosen. Experts therefore recommend that such systems be checked regularly for hidden bias. Some governments are also considering laws that would require companies to explain how their systems reach decisions.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: As a result, human recruiters are no longer needed.
Retailers employ more young people than any other sector.
Software is usually more expensive than human labour.
Critics, however, point out that algorithms can reproduce the prejudices contained in the data they are trained on.
These systems have never been found to make mistakes.
exercises.explanation: Önceki cümle destekçilerin görüşünü verir, sonraki cümle 'for example' ile önyargılı bir sistemi örnekler; arada eleştirmenlerin önyargı uyarısını yapan 'algorithms can reproduce the prejudices' köprü olur. 'These systems have never been found to make mistakes' diyen şık sonraki örnekle çelişir; 'human recruiters are no longer needed' diyen şık ise önceki görüşten aşırı bir sonuç çıkarır.

exercises.passage: The village of Ardmore lies in a narrow valley that receives almost no direct sunlight between November and February. The surrounding mountains are so steep that the sun does not rise above them for nearly four months. For generations, its residents simply accepted the dark winters, although many elderly people rarely left their homes during those months and local shops reported far fewer customers. In 2013, the village installed three large computer-controlled mirrors on a nearby hillside, which track the sun throughout the day and reflect its light onto the village square. ----
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Mirrors have been used by people since ancient times.
Since then, the square has become a lively meeting place even in mid-winter.
Unfortunately, the valley receives too much sunlight in summer for crops to grow well.
As a result, the village shops closed permanently.
Many valleys in the region are used for sheep farming.
exercises.explanation: Aynaların meydana güneş ışığı yansıtması, karanlık kışlarda insanların evden çıkmaması sorununa çözüm sunar; sonuç olarak meydanın kışın da canlanması mantıklıdır, doğru cevap 'Since then, the square has become a lively meeting place…'. 'the village shops closed permanently' diyen şık projenin amacına ters bir sonuç verir; 'Mirrors have been used by people since ancient times' 'mirrors' kelimesini tekrar eden genel bir bilgidir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Hardly anyone in the village had heard of the festival until it was featured on national television.
options: Everyone in the village already knew all about the festival long before it appeared on national television.
The festival was cancelled because few villagers had heard of it.
It was only after the festival appeared on national television that most villagers learned about it.
Villagers found it hard to watch the festival on television.
National television featured the festival because the villagers were famous.
exercises.explanation: 'Hardly anyone ... until' = televizyonda gösterilene kadar neredeyse kimse duymamıştı; yani köylülerin çoğu festivali ancak televizyondan sonra öğrendi. Doğru cevap 'It was only after the festival appeared on national television…'. 'Everyone in the village already knew…' diyen şık anlamı tersine çevirir; 'found it hard to watch' diyen şık 'hardly' kelimesini 'hard' ile karıştıran tipik bir tuzaktır.

exercises.passage: Saltmarsh grasses on the coast of Wenlow play an important role in protecting the shoreline. Their dense roots bind the mud together, making it far more resistant to erosion. ---- During storms, a wide band of grass can reduce the height of waves by up to half before they reach the sea walls behind it. Engineers have therefore begun to see saltmarshes not as wasteland but as a cheap and effective form of flood defence. Restoring a marsh, they note, can cost a fraction of the price of raising a sea wall.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Their stems, meanwhile, slow down the movement of water.
Saltmarsh grass is sometimes used to feed cattle.
As a result, the marshes are badly damaged by every storm.
However, the roots are too weak to hold any soil.
Sea walls are usually built from concrete or stone.
exercises.explanation: Önceki cümle köklerin, sonraki cümle dalgaların yavaşlatılmasının anlatıldığı bir koruma işlevini verir; 'meanwhile' ile köklerden gövdelere geçip suyun yavaşladığını söyleyen 'Their stems, meanwhile, slow down…' köprü olur. 'the roots are too weak to hold any soil' diyen şık önceki cümleyle çelişir; 'Sea walls are usually built…' cümlesi 'sea walls' ifadesini tekrar eden bir tuzaktır.

exercises.passage: ---- Researchers at the Elmstead Institute gave volunteers a series of difficult puzzles after a full night's sleep and again after they had stayed awake for 24 hours. When sleep-deprived, the volunteers not only solved fewer puzzles but also rated their own performance more highly than before. In other words, they became worse at the task while believing they were doing better. The researchers warn that this overconfidence could be dangerous for people such as doctors and drivers who work long shifts.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Puzzles are a popular way of relaxing after work.
Volunteers in the study slept better after solving puzzles in the evening.
As a result, the volunteers solved more puzzles when tired.
Most adults need about seven or eight hours of sleep a night.
Lack of sleep may impair our ability to judge our own performance.
exercises.explanation: Paragrafın ana bulgusu uykusuzluğun kişinin kendi performansını değerlendirme yeteneğini bozmasıdır; bunu tanıtan 'Lack of sleep may impair our ability to judge our own performance' doğru konu cümlesidir. 'the volunteers solved more puzzles when tired' diyen şık bulgularla çelişir ve 'As a result' başta karşılıksız kalır; 'Most adults need about seven or eight hours' diyen şık doğru bir bilgi olsa da paragrafın konusunu tanıtmaz.

exercises.passage: (I) The town of Lessing has introduced a scheme that pays residents to return used batteries to collection points. (II) Batteries contain metals that can contaminate soil and water if they are thrown away with ordinary rubbish. (III) Under the scheme, residents receive a small credit on their electricity bill for every kilogram of batteries they return. (IV) Electricity prices have risen across the country over the past decade. (V) In its first year, the scheme collected three times as many batteries as the previous voluntary programme.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: Paragraf pil iade programını, nedenini, işleyişini ve sonucunu anlatır. IV. cümle III'teki 'electricity bill' ifadesine yüzeysel olarak bağlanır ama elektrik fiyatlarına geçerek konudan kopar; doğru cevap IV. V. cümle programın sonucunu verdiği için akışın parçasıdır.

exercises.passage: The Hallin language, spoken by about 2,000 people in a remote mountain area, has no words for 'left' and 'right'. Instead, speakers describe the position of objects using directions such as 'uphill', 'downhill' and 'across the valley', even when they are indoors. In experiments, Hallin speakers were able to point accurately towards their home village from unfamiliar locations, a task that speakers of the national language found much harder. The researchers are now investigating whether this ability is learned mainly through language or through daily life in the mountains.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that the way Hallin speakers describe space ----.
options: makes it impossible for them to work indoors
is identical to that of the national language
may help them stay oriented in unfamiliar places
was invented by researchers for the experiment
depends on the position of their own bodies
exercises.explanation: Sürekli coğrafi yönlerle konuşan Hallin dilinin konuşurları yabancı yerlerden köylerinin yönünü doğru gösterebilmiştir; bu, konuşma biçimlerinin yön bulmalarına yardım edebileceğini düşündürür, doğru cevap 'may help them stay oriented in unfamiliar places'. 'depends on the position of their own bodies' tam tersidir, çünkü sol/sağ bedene göre yön bildirir ve bu dilde yoktur; 'is identical to that of the national language' ise ulusal dille yapılan karşılaştırmayla çelişir.

exercises.passage: Historians have long debated why the merchants of the medieval port of Calvessa kept such detailed records. Recent research suggests that the answer lies in the city's unusual legal system. Unlike other ports of the period, Calvessa allowed merchants to take each other to court over even small debts, and judges accepted only written evidence. A merchant without careful accounts could therefore lose a case simply because he could not prove what he was owed. Court records from the period show that such cases were extremely common. ----
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Keeping detailed records, in other words, was a practical necessity rather than a cultural habit.
Calvessa was one of the largest ports in the medieval world.
Merchants in Calvessa rarely went to court.
Judges in Calvessa accepted spoken evidence in most cases, especially when the debts involved were small.
Paper was very expensive in the medieval period.
exercises.explanation: Paragraf ayrıntılı kayıt tutmanın nedenini hukuk sistemine bağlar; sonda 'in other words' ile bunun pratik bir zorunluluk olduğunu özetleyen 'a practical necessity rather than a cultural habit' gelir. 'Judges ... accepted spoken evidence' diyen şık yalnızca yazılı kanıt kabul edildiği bilgisiyle, 'Merchants ... rarely went to court' diyen şık ise küçük borçlar için bile dava açılabildiği bilgisiyle çelişir.

exercises.passage: Electric scooters have spread rapidly in many cities as a quick and cheap way to travel short distances.
